```cpp
// rag/ivf_index.hpp — IVF-Flat approximate nearest-neighbour index
// (spherical k-means coarse quantiser + contiguous inverted lists).
//
// Built offline from a snapshot of the VectorStore (cold path, allocates);
// queried without allocation. Each inverted list stores its vectors
// *contiguously* (CSR layout, rows copied and reordered), so probing a list
// is a sequential stream the hardware prefetcher handles perfectly — no
// pointer chasing, no gathers.
//
// Query cost ~ nlist*D (centroids, L1/L2 resident) + (nprobe/nlist)*N*D.
//
// Storage options (IvfStorage):
//   Fp32 — lists hold reordered fp32 rows; probes are exact.
//   Int8 — lists hold the store's int8 rows + scales (IVF-SQ8): 4x fewer bytes
//          per probed vector. Probes yield an approximate shortlist that the
//          caller reranks in fp32 against the original rows.
//   Both — for side-by-side comparison (benchmarks).
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <numeric>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/common.hpp"
#include "rag/simd.hpp"
#include "rag/topk.hpp"
#include "rag/vector_store.hpp"

namespace rag {

enum class IvfStorage : std::uint8_t { Fp32, Int8, Both };

struct IvfParams {
  std::uint32_t nlist = 0;           // 0 => ~sqrt(n), rounded to a multiple of 4
  std::uint32_t train_iters = 10;
  std::uint32_t max_train_points_per_list = 256;
  std::uint64_t seed = 0x5EED;
  IvfStorage storage = IvfStorage::Fp32;
};

template <std::size_t D>
  requires ValidDim<D>
class IvfIndex {
 public:
  static constexpr std::uint32_t kMaxProbe = 256;

  // Index rows [0, n) of `store`. Cold path.
  void build(const VectorStore<D>& store, std::uint32_t n, IvfParams p = {}) {
    if (n == 0) { *this = IvfIndex{}; return; }  // drop any earlier build's lists and storage too
    nlist_ = p.nlist ? p.nlist : std::max<std::uint32_t>(4, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::sqrt(double(n))) & ~3u);
    nlist_ = std::min(nlist_, n);
    centroids_ = make_aligned_array<float>(std::size_t{nlist_} * D, Init::Lazy);
    train(store, n, p);

    // Assign every row to its nearest centroid, then lay lists out as CSR.
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> assign(n);
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) assign[i] = nearest(store.row(i));
    offsets_.assign(nlist_ + 1, 0);
    for (auto a : assign) ++offsets_[a + 1];
    std::partial_sum(offsets_.begin(), offsets_.end(), offsets_.begin());
    ids_.resize(n);
    const bool f32 = p.storage != IvfStorage::Int8, i8 = p.storage != IvfStorage::Fp32;
    // Lazy: every element is written below, before the index is published.
    vecs_ = f32 ? make_aligned_array<float>(std::size_t{n} * D, Init::Lazy) : AlignedArray<float>{};
    qvecs_ = i8 ? make_aligned_array<std::int8_t>(std::size_t{n} * D, Init::Lazy) : AlignedArray<std::int8_t>{};
    qscales_ = i8 ? make_aligned_array<float>(n, Init::Lazy) : AlignedArray<float>{};
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> cursor(offsets_.begin(), offsets_.end() - 1);
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
      const std::uint32_t slot = cursor[assign[i]]++;
      ids_[slot] = i;
      if (f32) std::copy_n(store.row(i), D, vecs_.get() + std::size_t{slot} * D);
      if (i8) {
        std::copy_n(store.qrow(i), D, qvecs_.get() + std::size_t{slot} * D);
        qscales_[slot] = store.qscale(i);
      }
    }
    covered_ = n;
  }

  // Probe the `nprobe` closest lists of fp32 storage. Pushes (score, original row id).
  template <class TK>
  void search(const float* q, std::uint32_t nprobe, TK& out) const noexcept {
    if (nlist_ == 0 || !vecs_) return;
    TopK<kMaxProbe> probes(std::min({nprobe, nlist_, kMaxProbe}));
    score_centroids(q, probes);
    for (const Hit& pr : probes.sorted()) {
      std::uint32_t i = offsets_[pr.id];
      const std::uint32_t e = offsets_[pr.id + 1];
      float s[4];
      for (; i + 4 <= e; i += 4) {
        simd::dot4(q, vecs_.get() + std::size_t{i} * D, D, D, s);
        out.push(s[0], ids_[i]); out.push(s[1], ids_[i + 1]);
        out.push(s[2], ids_[i + 2]); out.push(s[3], ids_[i + 3]);
      }
      // dot1, not dot: a row's score must not depend on where it fell in its list.
      for (; i < e; ++i) out.push(simd::dot1(q, vecs_.get() + std::size_t{i} * D, D), ids_[i]);
    }
  }

  // Probe int8 storage: `q` (fp32) picks the lists, `qq` (int8) scores rows.
  // Pushes approximate (dequantised) scores; rerank the shortlist in fp32.
  template <class TK>
  void search_int8(const float* q, const std::int8_t* qq, std::uint32_t nprobe, TK& out) const noexcept {
    if (nlist_ == 0 || !qvecs_) return;
    TopK<kMaxProbe> probes(std::min({nprobe, nlist_, kMaxProbe}));
    score_centroids(q, probes);
    for (const Hit& pr : probes.sorted()) {
      const std::uint32_t e = offsets_[pr.id + 1];
      for (std::uint32_t i = offsets_[pr.id]; i < e; ++i) {
        const std::int8_t* row = qvecs_.get() + std::size_t{i} * D;
        RAG_PREFETCH(row + 8 * D);
        out.push(static_cast<float>(simd::dot_i8(qq, row, D)) * qscales_[i], ids_[i]);
      }
    }
  }

  // Persistence (see rag/io.hpp). load() validates the CSR structure and ids
  // against `max_rows` (rows the caller's VectorStore holds) before use.
  template <class W>
  void save(W& w) const {
    w.pod(nlist_);
    w.pod(covered_);
    w.pod(static_cast<std::uint8_t>((vecs_ ? 1 : 0) | (qvecs_ ? 2 : 0)));
    if (nlist_ == 0) return;
    w.bytes(centroids_.get(), std::size_t{nlist_} * D * sizeof(float));
    w.vec(offsets_);
    w.vec(ids_);
    if (vecs_) w.bytes(vecs_.get(), std::size_t{covered_} * D * sizeof(float));
    if (qvecs_) {
      w.bytes(qvecs_.get(), std::size_t{covered_} * D);
      w.bytes(qscales_.get(), std::size_t{covered_} * sizeof(float));
    }
  }
  template <class R>
  void load(R& r, std::uint32_t max_rows) {
    const auto nlist = r.template pod<std::uint32_t>();
    const auto covered = r.template pod<std::uint32_t>();
    const auto flags = r.template pod<std::uint8_t>();
    if (nlist == 0) {
      if (covered != 0 || flags != 0) throw std::runtime_error("IvfIndex::load: inconsistent empty index");
      *this = IvfIndex{};
      return;
    }
    if (covered > max_rows || nlist > covered || flags == 0 || flags > 3) throw std::runtime_error("IvfIndex::load: bad header");
    auto read_array = [&](auto& arr, std::size_t count, auto tag) {
      using T = decltype(tag);
      if (count * sizeof(T) > r.remaining()) throw std::runtime_error("IvfIndex::load: truncated");
      arr = make_aligned_array<T>(count, Init::Lazy);  // filled by the read below
      r.bytes(arr.get(), count * sizeof(T));
    };
    IvfIndex x;
    x.nlist_ = nlist;
    x.covered_ = covered;
    read_array(x.centroids_, std::size_t{nlist} * D, float{});
    x.offsets_ = r.template vec<std::uint32_t>();
    x.ids_ = r.template vec<std::uint32_t>();
    if (x.offsets_.size() != std::size_t{nlist} + 1 || x.offsets_.front() != 0 || x.offsets_.back() != covered ||
        !std::is_sorted(x.offsets_.begin(), x.offsets_.end()) || x.ids_.size() != covered)
      throw std::runtime_error("IvfIndex::load: bad list layout");
    for (auto id : x.ids_)
      if (id >= covered) throw std::runtime_error("IvfIndex::load: row id out of range");
    if (flags & 1) read_array(x.vecs_, std::size_t{covered} * D, float{});
    if (flags & 2) {
      read_array(x.qvecs_, std::size_t{covered} * D, std::int8_t{});
      read_array(x.qscales_, covered, float{});
    }
    *this = std::move(x);
  }

  [[nodiscard]] bool has_fp32() const noexcept { return static_cast<bool>(vecs_); }
  [[nodiscard]] bool has_int8() const noexcept { return static_cast<bool>(qvecs_); }
  [[nodiscard]] std::size_t list_bytes() const noexcept {
    return std::size_t{covered_} * ((vecs_ ? D * sizeof(float) : 0) + (qvecs_ ? D + sizeof(float) : 0));
  }
  [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t covered() const noexcept { return covered_; }
  [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t nlist() const noexcept { return nlist_; }
  [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t list_size(std::uint32_t l) const noexcept { return offsets_[l + 1] - offsets_[l]; }

 private:
  template <class TK>
  void score_centroids(const float* q, TK& out) const noexcept {
    std::uint32_t c = 0;
    float s[4];
    for (; c + 4 <= nlist_; c += 4) {
      simd::dot4(q, centroids_.get() + std::size_t{c} * D, D, D, s);
      for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) out.push(s[j], c + j);
    }
    for (; c < nlist_; ++c) out.push(simd::dot(q, centroids_.get() + std::size_t{c} * D, D), c);
  }

  std::uint32_t nearest(const float* v) const noexcept {
    TopK<1> best(1);
    score_centroids(v, best);
    return best.sorted()[0].id;
  }

  static std::uint64_t splitmix(std::uint64_t& s) noexcept {
    std::uint64_t z = (s += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull);
    z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9ull;
    z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBull;
    return z ^ (z >> 31);
  }

  // Spherical k-means (Lloyd iterations on the unit sphere) over a sample.
  void train(const VectorStore<D>& store, std::uint32_t n, const IvfParams& p) {
    std::uint64_t rng = p.seed;
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> perm(n);
    std::iota(perm.begin(), perm.end(), 0u);
    // At least one sample per list (nlist_ <= n): the seeding below reads
    // perm[0, nlist_), and the empty-cluster reseed divides by m.
    const auto m = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::clamp<std::uint64_t>(
        std::uint64_t{nlist_} * p.max_train_points_per_list, nlist_, n));
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < m; ++i) std::swap(perm[i], perm[i + splitmix(rng) % (n - i)]);  // partial Fisher-Yates
    for (std::uint32_t c = 0; c < nlist_; ++c) std::copy_n(store.row(perm[c]), D, centroids_.get() + std::size_t{c} * D);

    std::vector<float> sums(std::size_t{nlist_} * D);
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> counts(nlist_);
    for (std::uint32_t it = 0; it < p.train_iters; ++it) {
      std::fill(sums.begin(), sums.end(), 0.f);
      std::fill(counts.begin(), counts.end(), 0u);
      for (std::uint32_t j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
        const float* v = store.row(perm[j]);
        const std::uint32_t c = nearest(v);
        ++counts[c];
        float* sc = sums.data() + std::size_t{c} * D;
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < D; ++d) sc[d] += v[d];
      }
      for (std::uint32_t c = 0; c < nlist_; ++c) {
        float* dst = centroids_.get() + std::size_t{c} * D;
        if (counts[c] == 0) {  // empty cluster: reseed from a random sample point
          std::copy_n(store.row(perm[splitmix(rng) % m]), D, dst);
          continue;
        }
        std::copy_n(sums.data() + std::size_t{c} * D, D, dst);
        simd::normalize(dst, D);
      }
    }
  }

  std::uint32_t nlist_ = 0;
  std::uint32_t covered_ = 0;
  AlignedArray<float> centroids_;
  std::vector<std::uint32_t> offsets_;  // nlist + 1, read-only after build
  std::vector<std::uint32_t> ids_;      // slot -> original row id
  AlignedArray<float> vecs_;            // fp32 rows reordered by list (Fp32/Both)
  AlignedArray<std::int8_t> qvecs_;     // int8 rows reordered by list (Int8/Both)
  AlignedArray<float> qscales_;         // per-slot dequantisation scale
};

}  // namespace rag
```

```cpp
// rag/orderflow/features.hpp — order-flow features from a tick stream.
//
// Feed it trades and quotes in time buckets (the simulator's steps, or
// recorded ticks grouped into the same bucket width):
//
//   FeatureBuilder fb(0.1);                 // 100 ms buckets
//   for each bucket: fb.add_trade(t)...; fb.end_bucket(quote);
//   const auto& x = fb.values();            // kFeatures numbers, each scaled to ~unit size
//
// Every feature is divided by a running RMS of itself (EWMA over
// `norm_seconds`), so the same code works on simulated and recorded ES
// without hand-tuned scales, and values are clipped to +-kClip.
//
//   0  delta 5 s        signed aggressor volume (buys - sells)
//   1  delta 30 s
//   2  delta 120 s
//   3  OFI 5 s          order-flow imbalance at the touch (Cont, Kukanov &
//   4  OFI 30 s         Stoikov 2014): includes limit-order adds/cancels
//   5  volume 30 s      log(volume / its running mean)
//   6  imbalance L1     (bid size - ask size) / (sum), best level
//   7  imbalance L1-5   the same over 5 levels
//   8  return 5 s       mid change, ticks
//   9  return 30 s
//  10  return 120 s
//  11  VWAP distance    mid - session VWAP
//  12  absorption       hidden liquidity absorbed at the touch: while the
//                       best bid holds, sell volume traded there beyond the
//                       size that was displayed when it became best; minus
//                       the same at the ask (> 0: a hidden buyer is
//                       absorbing sellers). Ordinary selling into a deep
//                       queue doesn't count; refills (icebergs) do.
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/orderflow/simulator.hpp"

namespace rag::orderflow {

inline constexpr std::size_t kFeatures = 13;
inline constexpr double kClip = 4.0;

class FeatureBuilder {
 public:
  explicit FeatureBuilder(double bucket_seconds = 0.1, double norm_seconds = 600)
      : dt_(bucket_seconds), norm_alpha_(std::min(1.0, bucket_seconds / norm_seconds)) {
    n5_ = buckets(5);
    n30_ = buckets(30);
    n120_ = buckets(120);
    len_ = {n5_, n30_, n120_};
    ring_.resize(n120_ + 1);
    rms_.fill(1.0);
  }

  void add_trade(const Trade& t) {
    cur_.delta += sign(t.aggressor) * t.size;
    cur_.volume += t.size;
    if (t.aggressor == Side::Sell && t.price == last_.bid) run_sold_ += t.size;
    if (t.aggressor == Side::Buy && t.price == last_.ask) run_bought_ += t.size;
    vwap_num_ += static_cast<double>(t.price) * t.size;
    vwap_den_ += t.size;
  }

  void end_bucket(const Quote& q) {
    // OFI contribution of this quote change (best level only).
    if (have_quote_) {
      double e = 0;
      if (q.bid >= last_.bid) e += q.bid_size[0];
      if (q.bid <= last_.bid) e -= last_.bid_size[0];
      if (q.ask <= last_.ask) e -= q.ask_size[0];
      if (q.ask >= last_.ask) e += last_.ask_size[0];
      cur_.ofi = e;
      // Absorption: volume beyond what was displayed, while the level holds.
      if (q.bid != last_.bid) {
        run_sold_ = 0;
        bid_shown_ = q.bid_size[0];
      }
      if (q.ask != last_.ask) {
        run_bought_ = 0;
        ask_shown_ = q.ask_size[0];
      }
      absorb_ = std::max(0.0, run_sold_ - bid_shown_) - std::max(0.0, run_bought_ - ask_shown_);
    }
    cur_.mid = 0.5 * (q.bid + q.ask);
    ring_[head_] = cur_;
    head_ = (head_ + 1) % ring_.size();
    count_ = std::min(count_ + 1, ring_.size());
    // Running window sums: add the new bucket, drop the one that left.
    for (std::size_t w = 0; w < 3; ++w) {
      win_[w].add(cur_, 1);
      if (count_ > len_[w]) win_[w].add(at(len_[w]), -1);
    }
    cur_ = {};
    last_ = q;
    have_quote_ = true;
    compute(q);
  }

  [[nodiscard]] const std::array<double, kFeatures>& values() const noexcept { return x_; }
  [[nodiscard]] std::array<double, kFeatures> raw() const noexcept { return raw_; }
  // Enough history for the longest window.
  [[nodiscard]] bool warm() const noexcept { return count_ > n120_; }
  [[nodiscard]] double vwap() const noexcept { return vwap_den_ > 0 ? vwap_num_ / vwap_den_ : 0; }

 private:
  struct Bucket {
    double delta = 0, volume = 0, ofi = 0, sold_at_bid = 0, bought_at_ask = 0, mid = 0;
  };
  struct Sums {
    double delta = 0, volume = 0, ofi = 0, absorb = 0;
    void add(const Bucket& b, double w) {
      delta += w * b.delta;
      volume += w * b.volume;
      ofi += w * b.ofi;
      absorb += w * (b.sold_at_bid - b.bought_at_ask);
    }
  };
  [[nodiscard]] std::size_t buckets(double seconds) const { return std::max<std::size_t>(1, static_cast<std::size_t>(std::lround(seconds / dt_))); }
  // The bucket `back` steps before the newest (0 = newest).
  [[nodiscard]] const Bucket& at(std::size_t back) const { return ring_[(head_ + ring_.size() - 1 - back) % ring_.size()]; }
  [[nodiscard]] double ret(std::size_t n) const { return count_ > n ? at(0).mid - at(n).mid : 0.0; }

  void compute(const Quote& q) {
    const Sums &w5 = win_[0], &w30 = win_[1], &w120 = win_[2];
    const double vol30 = w30.volume;
    vol_mean_ += (vol30 - vol_mean_) * norm_alpha_;
    double bid5 = 0, ask5 = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kDepth; ++i) {
      bid5 += q.bid_size[i];
      ask5 += q.ask_size[i];
    }
    const double b1 = q.bid_size[0], a1 = q.ask_size[0];
    raw_ = {w5.delta,
            w30.delta,
            w120.delta,
            w5.ofi,
            w30.ofi,
            std::log((vol30 + 1) / (vol_mean_ + 1)),
            b1 + a1 > 0 ? (b1 - a1) / (b1 + a1) : 0,
            bid5 + ask5 > 0 ? (bid5 - ask5) / (bid5 + ask5) : 0,
            ret(n5_),
            ret(n30_),
            ret(n120_),
            vwap_den_ > 0 ? 0.5 * (q.bid + q.ask) - vwap() : 0,
            absorb_};
    for (std::size_t k = 0; k < kFeatures; ++k) {
      // Imbalances and the volume ratio are already unit-free.
      const bool scaled = !(k == 5 || k == 6 || k == 7);
      if (scaled) {
        rms_[k] = std::sqrt(rms_[k] * rms_[k] + (raw_[k] * raw_[k] - rms_[k] * rms_[k]) * norm_alpha_);
        x_[k] = std::clamp(raw_[k] / std::max(1e-9, rms_[k]), -kClip, kClip);
      } else {
        x_[k] = std::clamp(k == 5 ? raw_[k] : 2 * raw_[k], -kClip, kClip);
      }
    }
  }

  double dt_, norm_alpha_;
  std::size_t n5_ = 1, n30_ = 1, n120_ = 1;
  std::array<std::size_t, 3> len_{};
  std::array<Sums, 3> win_{};
  std::vector<Bucket> ring_;
  std::size_t head_ = 0, count_ = 0;
  Bucket cur_;
  Quote last_{};
  bool have_quote_ = false;
  double vwap_num_ = 0, vwap_den_ = 0, vol_mean_ = 0;
  double run_sold_ = 0, run_bought_ = 0, bid_shown_ = 0, ask_shown_ = 0, absorb_ = 0;
  std::array<double, kFeatures> raw_{}, x_{}, rms_{};
};

}  // namespace rag::orderflow
```

```cpp
// rag/orderflow/replay_env.hpp — the scalping environment on recorded ticks
// (backtesting), with the same observations and actions as ScalpEnv, so an
// agent trained in the simulator runs unchanged on real data.
//
//   TickTape tape = TickTape::from_csv("es_ticks.csv", {.time_unit = "ns"});
//   ReplayScalpEnv env(tape, {.window_seconds = 600});
//   env.seek(k);              // episode k = the k-th consecutive window (else reset() picks one at random)
//
// Fills: a market order reaches the book one bucket later (latency) and fills
// at the recorded best ask (buy) or bid (sell); an order larger than the
// recorded touch size walks the recorded depth, one tick per level. Fees per
// contract per side as in ScalpEnv.
//
// What a replay cannot do: the strategy's own orders don't move the recorded
// market (fine for 1-lot market orders in ES, whose touch holds hundreds of
// lots), and passive queue fills can't be replayed faithfully without
// order-by-order (MBO) data, so only directional market-order strategies are
// backtested here.
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/agent/env.hpp"
#include "rag/orderflow/features.hpp"
#include "rag/orderflow/scalp_env.hpp"
#include "rag/orderflow/tick_csv.hpp"

namespace rag::orderflow {

// A recorded tick stream, bucketed: the trades of each bucket and the quote at its end.
class TickTape {
 public:
  struct Bucket {
    std::vector<Trade> trades;
    Quote quote;
  };
  static TickTape from_csv(const std::string& path, const TickCsvOptions& o = {}) {
    TickTape t;
    t.bucket_seconds_ = o.bucket_seconds;
    Collector c{&t, {}};
    t.stats_ = replay_tick_csv(path, c, o);
    return t;
  }
  static TickTape from_stream(std::istream& in, const TickCsvOptions& o = {}) {
    TickTape t;
    t.bucket_seconds_ = o.bucket_seconds;
    Collector c{&t, {}};
    t.stats_ = replay_tick_csv(in, c, o);
    return t;
  }
  [[nodiscard]] std::size_t size() const noexcept { return buckets_.size(); }
  [[nodiscard]] const Bucket& operator[](std::size_t i) const { return buckets_[i]; }
  [[nodiscard]] double bucket_seconds() const noexcept { return bucket_seconds_; }
  [[nodiscard]] const TickCsvStats& stats() const noexcept { return stats_; }

 private:
  struct Collector {
    TickTape* t;
    std::vector<Trade> pending;
    void add_trade(const Trade& tr) { pending.push_back(tr); }
    void end_bucket(const Quote& q) {
      t->buckets_.push_back({std::move(pending), q});
      pending.clear();
    }
  };
  std::vector<Bucket> buckets_;
  double bucket_seconds_ = 0.1;
  TickCsvStats stats_;
};

struct ReplayParams {
  double decide_seconds = 1.0;
  double window_seconds = 600;   // one episode
  double warmup_seconds = 150;   // features warm up on the tape before the window
  std::uint32_t latency_buckets = 1;
  std::uint32_t contracts = 1;
  double fee_dollars = 1.5;
};

class ReplayScalpEnv {
 public:
  using Observation = ScalpObs;
  static constexpr std::size_t kNumActions = ScalpEnv::kNumActions;
  static constexpr std::size_t kStateDims = ScalpEnv::kStateDims;
  static constexpr auto kLo = ScalpEnv::kLo;
  static constexpr auto kHi = ScalpEnv::kHi;

  ReplayScalpEnv(std::shared_ptr<const TickTape> tape, const ReplayParams& p = {}) : tape_(std::move(tape)), p_(p) {
    if (!tape_ || tape_->size() == 0) throw std::invalid_argument("ReplayScalpEnv: empty tape");
  }

  // Consecutive windows that fit on the tape after the warm-up.
  [[nodiscard]] std::size_t windows() const noexcept {
    const std::size_t need = buckets(p_.window_seconds);
    const std::size_t warm = buckets(p_.warmup_seconds);
    return tape_->size() > warm + need ? (tape_->size() - warm) / need : 0;
  }
  // Episode k = window k (0-based), for walk-forward evaluation.
  Observation seek(std::size_t k) {
    if (k >= windows()) throw std::out_of_range("ReplayScalpEnv: no such window");
    return start_at(k * buckets(p_.window_seconds));
  }
  // A random window (training on recorded data).
  Observation reset(rag::agent::Rng& rng) {
    const std::size_t w = windows();
    if (w == 0) throw std::out_of_range("ReplayScalpEnv: tape shorter than warm-up + window");
    return seek(rng.below(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(w)));
  }

  rag::agent::Step<Observation> step(rag::agent::Action a, rag::agent::Rng&) {
    const int target = (static_cast<int>(a) - 1) * static_cast<int>(p_.contracts);
    double fees = 0;
    const std::size_t n = buckets(p_.decide_seconds);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n && pos_ < end_; ++i) {
      advance();
      if (i + 1 == std::min<std::size_t>(n, p_.latency_buckets) && target != position_) fees += trade_to(target);
    }
    if (p_.latency_buckets == 0 && target != position_) fees += trade_to(target);
    const bool done = pos_ >= end_;
    if (done && position_ != 0) fees += trade_to(0);
    const double eq = cash_ + position_ * mid();
    const double reward = eq - equity_ - fees;
    equity_ = eq;
    return {obs(done), reward, done};
  }

  [[nodiscard]] std::array<double, kStateDims> features(const Observation& o) const noexcept {
    std::array<double, kStateDims> x{};
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kFeatures; ++i) x[i] = o.f[i];
    x[kFeatures] = static_cast<double>(o.position) / static_cast<double>(p_.contracts);
    x[kFeatures + 1] = std::clamp(o.open_pnl / 4.0, -kClip, kClip);
    x[kFeatures + 2] = o.time_left;
    return x;
  }

  [[nodiscard]] double net_pnl_ticks() const noexcept { return equity_ - fees_; }
  [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t orders() const noexcept { return orders_; }
  [[nodiscard]] double fees_ticks() const noexcept { return fees_; }

 private:
  [[nodiscard]] std::size_t buckets(double seconds) const {
    return std::max<std::size_t>(1, static_cast<std::size_t>(std::lround(seconds / tape_->bucket_seconds())));
  }
  [[nodiscard]] double mid() const { return 0.5 * (quote().bid + quote().ask); }
  [[nodiscard]] const Quote& quote() const { return (*tape_)[pos_ == 0 ? 0 : pos_ - 1].quote; }
  void advance() {
    const auto& b = (*tape_)[pos_++];
    for (const auto& t : b.trades) fb_.add_trade(t);
    fb_.end_bucket(b.quote);
  }
  Observation start_at(std::size_t window_start) {
    fb_ = FeatureBuilder(tape_->bucket_seconds());
    pos_ = window_start;
    const std::size_t warm_end = window_start + buckets(p_.warmup_seconds);
    while (pos_ < warm_end) advance();
    end_ = std::min(tape_->size(), warm_end + buckets(p_.window_seconds));
    position_ = 0;
    cash_ = equity_ = fees_ = entry_ = 0;
    orders_ = 0;
    start_ = pos_;
    return obs(false);
  }
  // Fill against the recorded book: the touch, then one tick worse per level.
  double trade_to(int target) {
    const int diff = target - position_;
    std::uint32_t left = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::abs(diff));
    const Quote& q = quote();
    double notional = 0;
    for (std::size_t lvl = 0; left > 0; ++lvl) {
      const std::int32_t price = diff > 0 ? q.ask + static_cast<std::int32_t>(lvl) : q.bid - static_cast<std::int32_t>(lvl);
      const std::uint32_t shown = lvl < kDepth ? (diff > 0 ? q.ask_size[lvl] : q.bid_size[lvl]) : 0;
      // Without depth in the data (sizes 0), assume the touch holds the order.
      const std::uint32_t take = (shown == 0 && lvl == 0) || lvl + 1 >= kDepth ? left : std::min(left, shown);
      notional += static_cast<double>(take) * price;
      left -= take;
    }
    const std::uint32_t qty = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::abs(diff));
    const double avg = notional / qty;
    cash_ -= (diff > 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0) * qty * avg;
    const int before = position_;
    position_ = target;
    if (position_ != 0 && (before == 0 || (before > 0) != (position_ > 0))) entry_ = avg;
    if (position_ == 0) entry_ = 0;
    ++orders_;
    const double fee = qty * p_.fee_dollars / kTickValue;
    fees_ += fee;
    return fee;
  }
  [[nodiscard]] Observation obs(bool done) const {
    Observation o;
    o.f = fb_.values();
    o.position = position_;
    o.open_pnl = position_ != 0 ? position_ * (mid() - entry_) : 0;
    const double total = static_cast<double>(end_ - start_);
    o.time_left = done || total <= 0 ? 0 : std::max(0.0, static_cast<double>(end_ - pos_) / total);
    return o;
  }

  std::shared_ptr<const TickTape> tape_;
  ReplayParams p_;
  FeatureBuilder fb_{0.1};
  std::size_t pos_ = 0, end_ = 0, start_ = 0;
  int position_ = 0;
  double cash_ = 0, equity_ = 0, fees_ = 0, entry_ = 0;
  std::uint32_t orders_ = 0;
};

static_assert(rag::agent::Environment<ReplayScalpEnv>);

}  // namespace rag::orderflow

```

```cpp
// rag/orderflow/scalp_env.hpp — directional order-flow scalping on the ES
// simulator, as an Environment for rag::agent learners.
//
// Every `decide_seconds` the strategy picks a target position (short, flat
// or long `contracts`); a change is sent as a market order that reaches the
// book `latency_steps` simulator steps later, pays the spread through its
// fills, and pays `fee_dollars` per contract per side. The reward is the
// change in mark-to-market equity (marked at the mid) in ticks, net of fees;
// the episode ends flat (a final market order closes any position).
//
// Observation: the 13 order-flow features (features.hpp), the position, the
// open P&L and the time left. Each episode is a fresh market (a new
// simulator seed and a random time of day), warmed up so every window is
// full before the first decision.
#pragma once

#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <stdexcept>

#include "rag/agent/env.hpp"
#include "rag/orderflow/features.hpp"
#include "rag/orderflow/simulator.hpp"

namespace rag::orderflow {

struct ScalpParams {
  SimParams sim;
  double decide_seconds = 1.0;
  double episode_seconds = 600;
  double warmup_seconds = 150;
  double start_second = -1;  // session time of the warm-up start; < 0: random each episode
  std::uint32_t latency_steps = 1;  // 100 ms at the default dt
  std::uint32_t contracts = 1;
  double fee_dollars = 1.5;  // per contract per side (exchange, clearing, broker)
};

struct ScalpObs {
  std::array<double, kFeatures> f{};
  int position = 0;        // contracts
  double open_pnl = 0;     // ticks, marked at the mid
  double time_left = 1;    // fraction of the episode
};

class ScalpEnv {
 public:
  using Observation = ScalpObs;
  static constexpr std::size_t kNumActions = 3;  // 0 short, 1 flat, 2 long
  static constexpr std::size_t kStateDims = kFeatures + 3;
  static constexpr std::array<double, kStateDims> kLo = [] {
    std::array<double, kStateDims> a{};
    a.fill(-kClip);
    a[kFeatures] = -1;
    a[kFeatures + 1] = -kClip;
    a[kFeatures + 2] = 0;
    return a;
  }();
  static constexpr std::array<double, kStateDims> kHi = [] {
    std::array<double, kStateDims> a{};
    a.fill(kClip);
    a[kFeatures] = 1;
    a[kFeatures + 1] = kClip;
    a[kFeatures + 2] = 1;
    return a;
  }();

  // value_impact > 0 (the v2 / v3 discovery presets): own market orders fill
  // at pre-impact prices and then move fair value by value_impact per lot, so
  // a block round trip earns from its own impact (of10_discovery --impact:
  // v3, buy N lots, sell 10 s later, +0.15 tick/lot at N = 30, +1.4 at 60).
  // Multi-lot ScalpEnv use is blocked there until own impact is fixed.
  explicit ScalpEnv(const ScalpParams& p = {}) : p_(p) {
    if (p_.contracts > 1 && p_.sim.value_impact > 0)
      throw std::invalid_argument("ScalpEnv: contracts > 1 with value_impact > 0 lets block round trips profit from their own impact");
  }

  // An episode's market before its warm-up: a fresh simulator seeded from
  // `rng` at a random time of day (or start_second). reset() and the
  // diagnostics probe (of10_discovery's episode regime) both build episodes
  // with it, so they see the same markets.
  [[nodiscard]] static EsSimulator make_market(const ScalpParams& p, rag::agent::Rng& rng) {
    const MarketDraw d = draw_market(p, rng);
    return EsSimulator(p.sim, d.seed, d.start);
  }
  // make_market's draws (u, then the simulator seed): the second the warm-up
  // starts and the simulator seed. The probe's ground-truth path (a longer
  // burn before the same window) shares them.
  struct MarketDraw {
    double start;
    std::uint64_t seed;
  };
  [[nodiscard]] static MarketDraw draw_market(const ScalpParams& p, rag::agent::Rng& rng) {
    const double latest_start = std::max(0.0, p.sim.session_seconds - p.episode_seconds - p.warmup_seconds);
    const double u = rng.uniform();  // drawn either way: episode seeds don't depend on the setting
    const std::uint64_t seed = rng.next();
    return {p.start_second >= 0 ? p.start_second : u * latest_start, seed};
  }

  Observation reset(rag::agent::Rng& rng) {
    sim_.emplace(make_market(p_, rng));
    fb_ = FeatureBuilder(p_.sim.dt);
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < steps(p_.warmup_seconds); ++i) advance();
    position_ = 0;
    cash_ = 0;
    equity_ = 0;
    entry_mid_ = 0;
    elapsed_ = 0;
    trades_ = 0;
    fees_ticks_ = 0;
    return obs();
  }

  rag::agent::Step<Observation> step(rag::agent::Action a, rag::agent::Rng&) {
    const int target = (static_cast<int>(a) - 1) * static_cast<int>(p_.contracts);
    const std::uint32_t n = steps(p_.decide_seconds);
    double fees = 0;
    if (p_.latency_steps == 0 && target != position_) fees += trade_to(target);
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
      advance();
      if (p_.latency_steps > 0 && i + 1 == std::min(n, p_.latency_steps) && target != position_) fees += trade_to(target);
    }
    elapsed_ += p_.decide_seconds;
    const bool done = elapsed_ >= p_.episode_seconds - 1e-9;
    if (done && position_ != 0) fees += trade_to(0);
    const double eq = cash_ + position_ * sim_->mid();
    const double reward = eq - equity_ - fees;
    equity_ = eq;
    return {obs(), reward, done};
  }

  [[nodiscard]] std::array<double, kStateDims> features(const Observation& o) const noexcept {
    std::array<double, kStateDims> x{};
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kFeatures; ++i) x[i] = o.f[i];
    x[kFeatures] = static_cast<double>(o.position) / static_cast<double>(p_.contracts);
    x[kFeatures + 1] = std::clamp(o.open_pnl / 4.0, -kClip, kClip);
    x[kFeatures + 2] = o.time_left;
    return x;
  }

  // Episode statistics and the market, for evaluation and oracles.
  [[nodiscard]] double net_pnl_ticks() const noexcept { return equity_ - fees_ticks_; }  // marked at the mid, after fees
  [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t round_trips() const noexcept { return trades_ / 2; }
  [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t orders() const noexcept { return trades_; }
  [[nodiscard]] double fees_ticks() const noexcept { return fees_ticks_; }
  [[nodiscard]] const EsSimulator& market() const noexcept { return *sim_; }
  [[nodiscard]] const FeatureBuilder& feature_builder() const noexcept { return fb_; }
  [[nodiscard]] const ScalpParams& params() const noexcept { return p_; }

 private:
  [[nodiscard]] std::uint32_t steps(double seconds) const {
    return std::max<std::uint32_t>(1, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::lround(seconds / p_.sim.dt)));
  }
  void advance() {
    sim_->step();
    for (const auto& t : sim_->trades()) fb_.add_trade(t);
    fb_.end_bucket(sim_->quote());
  }
  // Market order to reach `target`; returns the fee in ticks.
  double trade_to(int target) {
    const int diff = target - position_;
    const auto qty = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::abs(diff));
    const Fill f = sim_->market_order(diff > 0 ? Side::Buy : Side::Sell, qty);
    cash_ -= (diff > 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0) * f.filled * f.avg_price;
    const int before = position_;
    position_ += diff > 0 ? static_cast<int>(f.filled) : -static_cast<int>(f.filled);
    if (position_ != 0 && (before == 0 || (before > 0) != (position_ > 0))) entry_mid_ = f.avg_price;  // new or flipped position
    if (position_ == 0) entry_mid_ = 0;
    ++trades_;
    const double fee = f.filled * p_.fee_dollars / kTickValue;
    fees_ticks_ += fee;
    return fee;
  }
  [[nodiscard]] Observation obs() const {
    Observation o;
    o.f = fb_.values();
    o.position = position_;
    o.open_pnl = position_ != 0 ? position_ * (sim_->mid() - entry_mid_) : 0;
    o.time_left = std::max(0.0, 1 - elapsed_ / p_.episode_seconds);
    return o;
  }

  ScalpParams p_;
  std::optional<EsSimulator> sim_;  // by value: environments are copied (evaluate(), Agent)
  FeatureBuilder fb_{0.1};
  int position_ = 0;
  double cash_ = 0, equity_ = 0, entry_mid_ = 0, elapsed_ = 0, fees_ticks_ = 0;
  std::uint32_t trades_ = 0;
};

static_assert(rag::agent::Environment<ScalpEnv>);

}  // namespace rag::orderflow
```

```cpp
// rag/orderflow/scalp_run.hpp — pieces the ScalpEnv programs share
// (examples/of_train.cpp, examples/of_trace.cpp, experiments/of2_baselines.cpp,
// of6_scalp_stress.cpp, of8_scalp_days.cpp, of10_discovery.cpp): the
// --warmup option, the record of_train writes next to each network (so a
// stress, day or trace run can check it uses the network's market and
// warm-up), OF8's session starts and OF6's stress scenarios.
//
// --warmup S (OF10 iteration 3, opt-in; default 150 s = ScalpParams{}):
// seconds the simulator runs before an episode's first decision. On the v3
// discovery market a 150 s burn leaves the meta-order population ~5% short
// of the long-window level (of10_warmup_check.txt); 1050 s matches it, so RL
// reruns on discovery use --warmup 1050. A longer warm-up also moves the
// episodes: ScalpEnv::draw_market starts the warm-up uniformly in
// [0, session - episode - warm-up], so every episode starts >= S s into the
// session (and ends by the close). S may be at most session - episode
// (22,800 s): beyond that no episode fits (warmup_error).
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <system_error>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/orderflow/scalp_env.hpp"

namespace rag::orderflow {

inline constexpr double kDefaultWarmup = 150;  // ScalpParams{}.warmup_seconds: every committed result

// A --warmup value: a finite number of seconds >= 0 (the whole string), else nullopt.
inline std::optional<double> parse_warmup(const std::string& v) {
  char* end = nullptr;
  errno = 0;
  const double x = std::strtod(v.c_str(), &end);
  if (v.empty() || *end != '\0' || errno == ERANGE || !std::isfinite(x) || x < 0) return std::nullopt;
  return x;
}

// Empty if p's warm-up leaves room for an episode before the close
// (warm-up <= session - episode), else the reason. Larger values would put
// every episode after the close (draw_market clamps the latest start to 0).
inline std::string warmup_error(const ScalpParams& p) {
  const double room = p.sim.session_seconds - p.episode_seconds;
  if (!(p.warmup_seconds >= 0) || p.warmup_seconds > room) {
    char b[160];
    std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, "warm-up %g s leaves no room for a %g s episode in a %g s session (at most %g s)", p.warmup_seconds,
                  p.episode_seconds, p.sim.session_seconds, room);
    return b;
  }
  return {};
}

// The ScalpParams of a run: the market preset, warmed up `warmup` seconds.
inline ScalpParams scalp_params(const std::string& market, double warmup = kDefaultWarmup) {
  ScalpParams p;
  p.sim = market_preset(market);
  p.warmup_seconds = warmup;
  return p;
}

// of_train's per-network record: DIR/seedK.txt next to DIR/seedK.net
// (key=value lines: market, warmup_seconds, then the training options and the
// seed). One record per network, written right after that network is saved
// (the old record removed first), so a record never vouches for a network
// another run left in the same directory: a seed with no champion in a rerun
// keeps its old network AND its old record.
inline std::string record_path_of_net(const std::string& net_path) {
  const std::size_t slash = net_path.find_last_of("/\\");
  const std::size_t dot = net_path.find_last_of('.');
  const bool ext = dot != std::string::npos && (slash == std::string::npos || dot > slash);
  return (ext ? net_path.substr(0, dot) : net_path) + ".txt";
}

// Removes the record of `net_path` (before the network is overwritten).
inline void remove_net_record(const std::string& net_path) {
  std::error_code ec;
  std::filesystem::remove(record_path_of_net(net_path), ec);
}

// Writes the record of `net_path`: market, warmup_seconds, then `extra` (more
// key=value lines, each ending in '\n'). False if the file can't be written.
inline bool write_net_record(const std::string& net_path, const std::string& market, double warmup, const std::string& extra = {}) {
  std::FILE* f = std::fopen(record_path_of_net(net_path).c_str(), "w");
  if (!f) return false;
  std::fprintf(f, "market=%s\nwarmup_seconds=%.17g\n%s", market.c_str(), warmup, extra.c_str());
  return std::fclose(f) == 0;
}

// The value of `key` in the record of `net_path`; nullopt if there is no
// record (networks from of3_rl or an older of_train) or no such key.
inline std::optional<std::string> net_record_value(const std::string& net_path, const std::string& key) {
  std::ifstream in(record_path_of_net(net_path));
  if (!in) return std::nullopt;
  for (std::string line; std::getline(in, line);) {
    if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
    if (line.size() > key.size() && line.compare(0, key.size(), key) == 0 && line[key.size()] == '=') return line.substr(key.size() + 1);
  }
  return std::nullopt;
}

// Empty if `net_path` may run on `market` with `warmup` seconds of warm-up,
// else the reason. A network with no record is a legacy one (of3_rl, an older
// of_train): trained with ScalpEnv's default 150 s warm-up, so it is refused
// at any other warm-up; its market is unknown and not checked. A recorded
// network is refused on another warm-up or another market.
inline std::string check_net(const std::string& net_path, const std::string& market, double warmup) {
  char b[200];
  if (!std::filesystem::exists(record_path_of_net(net_path))) {
    if (warmup == kDefaultWarmup) return {};
    std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, ": no of_train record (%s): a legacy network, trained with the default %g s warm-up; this run uses %g s (--warmup)",
                  record_path_of_net(net_path).c_str(), kDefaultWarmup, warmup);
    return net_path + b;
  }
  const auto v = net_record_value(net_path, "warmup_seconds");
  const auto w = v ? parse_warmup(*v) : std::nullopt;
  if (!w) return net_path + ": missing or unreadable warmup_seconds in " + record_path_of_net(net_path);
  if (*w != warmup) {
    std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, ": trained with a %g s warm-up (%s), this run uses %g s (--warmup)", *w, record_path_of_net(net_path).c_str(), warmup);
    return net_path + b;
  }
  if (const auto m = net_record_value(net_path, "market"); m && *m != market)
    return net_path + ": trained on market " + *m + " (" + record_path_of_net(net_path) + "), this run uses market " + market + " (--market)";
  return {};
}

// OF8's k-th 10-minute session of a day: the session second the warm-up
// starts. The episode stays where a 150 s warm-up puts it (k * 600 + 150 s)
// and the warm-up starts `warmup` s before it, never before the open (then
// the episode starts `warmup` s into the session: with 1050 s, sessions 0 and
// 1 both start at 1050 s). With 150 s this is k * 600 exactly.
inline double day_session_start(unsigned k, double warmup = kDefaultWarmup) {
  return std::max(0.0, k * 600.0 + (kDefaultWarmup - warmup));
}

// OF6 stress scenarios: a change of the episode's ScalpParams.
struct StressScenario {
  std::string name;
  std::function<void(ScalpParams&)> change;
};

// The legacy list (default and efficient markets; OF6's committed results)
// and, for the v3 discovery market, a list FIXED HERE BEFORE ANY v3 RL
// NETWORK EXISTED (OF10 iteration 3, pre-registered). On discovery v3 three
// legacy stresses are empty or weak: quote fading x2 is a no-op (fade = 0;
// measured: output byte-identical to nominal), volatility x1.5 scales only
// value_vol (~22% of the 10 s value change; ~77% is flow impact; measured:
// R^2 0.31 +- 0.015 vs 0.34, 1-min sd 3.90 vs 3.96, sd(g) 0.332 vs 0.334),
// informed flow x0.5 acts on ~4% of the volume (measured: informed volume
// 2.1% vs 3.8%, gap statistics unchanged). The discovery list keeps nominal,
// the latencies, fees, uninformed flow x1.5 and the (cold) session open, and
// replaces those three with five stresses that bite there.
// Measured on diagnostic seeds 22-24, before any v3 network existed:
//   of_discovery --markets discovery --seeds 22-24 --episodes 400 --long off
//                --scalp-warmup 1050 --set <the change>
// episode regime (ScalpEnv episodes, 1050 s warm-up), 1,200 windows, pooled
// value (+- jackknife SE where the probe gives one), nominal -> stressed.
// Nominal: sd(g) 0.334, corr(g, r 30 s) - ideal floor 0.018, race to the tick
// median 0.30 s, event corr(I1, next mid change) 0.209 +- 0.003, leak
// corr(I1, g) 0.362 +- 0.004, markout 1 s 0.252 +- 0.008, R^2(10 s mid
// change ~ delta) 0.340 +- 0.008, flow-impact share of the 10 s value change
// 0.78, 1-min sd 3.96 +- 0.07, kurtosis 5.6 +- 0.6, trades/s 18.5, mean L1
// 106 lots, informed volume share 3.8%, active meta-orders 11.2.
// Informed meta-orders x2 (also measured) was too weak to keep: informed
// volume 6.4%, active meta-orders 16.3, but the market barely moved (sd(g)
// 0.330, race median 0.295 s, event corr(I1, next change) 0.209, markout
// 1 s 0.260 +- 0.009, kurtosis 5.2): x4 is the smallest factor tried that
// moves the facts.
// "Session open" (both lists) is a cold open: the simulator starts at the
// open with ScalpEnv's default 150 s burn, so the episode runs 150 .. 750 s
// whatever the run's --warmup. With the default warm-up this is exactly the
// legacy scenario (start_second = 0; OF6's committed results unchanged). It
// does NOT keep the run's warm-up: with 1050 s, start_second = 0 alone would
// put the episode at 1050 .. 1650 s, the earliest window training already
// draws (in distribution, hardly a stress). Activity (intraday factor
// 1 + 1.5 exp(-t / 1800 s) + exp(-(session - t) / 1800 s), episode mean):

// training windows; the 150 s burn also leaves the discovery meta-order
// population ~5% short (of10_warmup_check.txt), as a real open would. Not
// measured with the probe (of_discovery cannot place a window at the open):
// computed, not tuned.
inline void session_open(ScalpParams& p) {
  p.start_second = 0;
  p.warmup_seconds = kDefaultWarmup;
}

inline std::vector<StressScenario> stress_scenarios(bool discovery) {
  if (!discovery)
    return {
        {"nominal", [](ScalpParams&) {}},
        {"latency 300 ms", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.latency_steps = 3; }},
        {"latency 1 s", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.latency_steps = 10; }},
        {"fees $3/side", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.fee_dollars = 3.0; }},
        {"informed flow x0.5", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.sim.informed_meta_rate *= 0.5; }},
        {"uninformed flow x1.5", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.sim.uninformed_meta_rate *= 1.5; }},
        {"volatility x1.5", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.sim.value_vol *= 1.5; }},
        {"quote fading x2", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.sim.fade *= 2; }},
        {"session open", session_open},
    };
  return {
      {"nominal", [](ScalpParams&) {}},
      {"latency 300 ms", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.latency_steps = 3; }},
      {"latency 1 s", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.latency_steps = 10; }},
      {"fees $3/side", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.fee_dollars = 3.0; }},
      {"uninformed flow x1.5", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.sim.uninformed_meta_rate *= 1.5; }},
      // Stale quotes leave at half the rate, half as much of them sniped:
      // race to the tick median 0.30 -> 0.40 s, time in a race 6.4% -> 9.0%,
      // sd(g) 0.334 -> 0.353, corr(g, r 30 s) - floor 0.018 -> 0.026, sniper
      // volume 7.7% -> 3.2%, event corr(I1, next change) 0.209 -> 0.236,
      // markout 1 s 0.252 -> 0.223, trades/s 18.5 -> 16.6.
      {"slower discovery x0.5", [](ScalpParams& p) {
         p.sim.reprice_cancel *= 0.5;
         p.sim.reprice_take *= 0.5;
       }},
      // Taker flow moves value 1.5x as much: flow-impact share 0.78 -> 0.89,
      // 1-min sd 3.96 -> 5.70, R^2 0.340 -> 0.396, markout 1 s 0.252 -> 0.326,
      // sd(g) 0.334 -> 0.367, mid changes/min 18.4 -> 25.8, leak corr(I1, g)
      // 0.362 -> 0.410.
      {"flow impact x1.5", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.sim.value_impact *= 1.5; }},
      // Three times the news jumps: flow-impact share 0.78 -> 0.54, R^2
      // 0.340 -> 0.258, 1-min sd 3.96 -> 4.66, kurtosis 5.6 -> 8.8, event
      // corr(I1, next change) 0.209 -> 0.171, corr(I1, r 30 s) 0.076 -> 0.051,
      // markout 1 s 0.252 -> 0.308.
      {"news x3", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.sim.jump_rate *= 3; }},
      // Four times the informed meta-order starts: informed volume 3.8% ->

      // kurtosis 5.6 -> 9.1, race median 0.30 -> 0.27 s, leak corr(I1, g)
      // 0.362 -> 0.327, trades/s 18.5 -> 20.0.
      {"informed meta-orders x4", [](ScalpParams& p) { p.sim.informed_meta_rate *= 4; }},
      // Half the maker arrivals (a thinner book; attacks the depletion
```
