```cpp
// of_calibrate — compare the ES simulator with recorded ES ticks, and fit its
// parameters so the simulated market has the same stylized facts.
//
//   of_calibrate sim [seconds=10800] [market]        facts of the simulator (market: default, efficient, discovery)
//   of_calibrate facts <ticks.csv> [options]         facts of recorded ticks
//   of_calibrate fit   <ticks.csv> [options]         fit the simulator to them (needs NLopt)
//   of_calibrate export <out.csv> [seconds=3600] [informed_scale=1] [market seed=7 start_second=3600]
//                                                    write simulator ticks in the CSV format
//                                                    (sample data; calibration self-tests). Without a
//                                                    market: SimParams{}, seed 7, start 3600 (as before);
//                                                    e.g. export s.csv 23400 1 discovery 960012001 0 writes
//                                                    one whole 6.5 h session from the open (OF12)
//
// options: --tick 0.25  --time ns|us|ms|s  --evals 150  --seconds 10800
//          --seeds 2 (simulator runs averaged per evaluation, in parallel
//          threads: the facts of one short run are noisy, and the fit chases
//          the noise; on a 24-thread machine use e.g. --seeds 12 --seconds 21600)
// The CSV format is documented in rag/orderflow/tick_csv.hpp.
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/orderflow/stylized.hpp"
#include "rag/orderflow/tick_csv.hpp"
#if defined(RAG_HAVE_NLOPT)
#include "rag/agent/tuning.hpp"
#endif

using namespace rag::orderflow;

namespace {

void print_facts(const char* label, const StylizedFacts& f) {
  std::printf("%s (%.1f hours)\n", label, f.seconds / 3600);
  std::printf("  activity     %.1f trades/s, %.2f contracts/trade, %.0f contracts/min\n", f.trades_per_sec, f.mean_trade_size, f.volume_per_min);
  std::printf("  book         spread = 1 tick %.1f%%, mean best-level size %.0f\n", 100 * f.spread1_share, f.mean_l1_size);
  std::printf("  returns      1-min sd %.2f ticks, excess kurtosis %.2f, lag-1 autocorr %+.3f, |r| lag-1 %+.3f\n", f.ret1m_sd, f.ret1m_kurtosis,
              f.ret1m_ac1, f.absret1m_ac1);
  std::printf("  trade signs  autocorr lag 1 %+.3f, lag 10 %+.3f, lag 100 %+.3f\n", f.sign_ac1, f.sign_ac10, f.sign_ac100);
  std::printf("  order flow   R^2(10 s mid change ~ 10 s delta) %.3f, corr(30 s delta, next 30 s) %+.3f\n", f.impact_r2, f.delta_predict);
  std::printf("  markouts     after an aggressive print: 1 s %+.3f, 5 s %+.3f, 30 s %+.3f ticks; mid changes %.1f per minute\n", f.markout_1s,
              f.markout_5s, f.markout_30s, f.mid_changes_per_min);
}

struct Options {
  double tick = 0.25, seconds = 10800;
  std::string time = "ns";
  int evals = 150, seeds = 2;
};

Options parse(int argc, char** argv, int from) {
  Options o;
  for (int i = from; i + 1 < argc; i += 2) {
    const std::string k = argv[i];
    if (k == "--tick") o.tick = std::atof(argv[i + 1]);
    else if (k == "--time") o.time = argv[i + 1];
    else if (k == "--evals") o.evals = std::atoi(argv[i + 1]);
    else if (k == "--seconds") o.seconds = std::atof(argv[i + 1]);
    else if (k == "--seeds") o.seeds = std::max(1, std::atoi(argv[i + 1]));
  }
  return o;
}

StylizedFacts read_facts(const std::string& path, const Options& o) {
  StylizedMeter m(0.1);
  const auto st = replay_tick_csv(path, m, TickCsvOptions{.tick_size = o.tick, .time_unit = o.time});
  std::printf("read %zu lines: %zu trades, %zu quotes, %zu buckets of 100 ms, %zu skipped, %zu session gaps\n", st.lines, st.trades, st.quotes,
              st.buckets, st.skipped, st.gaps);
  return m.facts();
}

#if defined(RAG_HAVE_NLOPT)
// Relative squared error on the facts that matter for trading, weighted.
double loss(const StylizedFacts& sim, const StylizedFacts& real) {
  auto rel = [](double a, double b, double floor) { const double d = (a - b) / std::max(std::abs(b), floor); return d * d; };
  auto abs2 = [](double a, double b, double scale) { const double d = (a - b) / scale; return d * d; };
  return 1.0 * rel(sim.trades_per_sec, real.trades_per_sec, 1) + 1.0 * rel(sim.volume_per_min, real.volume_per_min, 100) +
         1.0 * rel(sim.mean_l1_size, real.mean_l1_size, 10) + 2.0 * rel(sim.ret1m_sd, real.ret1m_sd, 0.5) +
         1.0 * abs2(sim.spread1_share, real.spread1_share, 0.05) + 1.0 * abs2(sim.sign_ac1, real.sign_ac1, 0.05) +
         1.0 * abs2(sim.sign_ac100, real.sign_ac100, 0.05) + 2.0 * abs2(sim.impact_r2, real.impact_r2, 0.05) +
         4.0 * abs2(sim.delta_predict, real.delta_predict, 0.03) + 2.0 * abs2(sim.markout_5s, real.markout_5s, 0.1) +
         1.0 * abs2(sim.markout_1s, real.markout_1s, 0.1) + 1.0 * abs2(sim.markout_30s, real.markout_30s, 0.2) +
         1.0 * rel(sim.mid_changes_per_min, real.mid_changes_per_min, 1) +
         0.5 * abs2(std::log1p(std::max(0.0, sim.ret1m_kurtosis)), std::log1p(std::max(0.0, real.ret1m_kurtosis)), 0.5) +
         1.0 * abs2(sim.ret1m_ac1, real.ret1m_ac1, 0.05);
}
// Facts averaged over several simulator seeds, run in parallel threads (on
// a many-core machine more seeds cost no extra wall-clock time).
StylizedFacts averaged_facts(const SimParams& p, double seconds, int seeds, std::uint64_t first_seed) {
  std::vector<StylizedFacts> runs(static_cast<std::size_t>(seeds));
  std::vector<std::thread> pool;
  for (int i = 0; i < seeds; ++i)
    pool.emplace_back([&, i] { runs[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] = simulate_facts(p, seconds, first_seed + static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i)); });
  for (auto& t : pool) t.join();
  StylizedFacts a;
  for (const auto& f : runs) {
    a.seconds += f.seconds;
    a.trades_per_sec += f.trades_per_sec / seeds;
    a.mean_trade_size += f.mean_trade_size / seeds;
    a.volume_per_min += f.volume_per_min / seeds;
    a.spread1_share += f.spread1_share / seeds;
    a.mean_l1_size += f.mean_l1_size / seeds;
    a.ret1m_sd += f.ret1m_sd / seeds;
    a.ret1m_kurtosis += f.ret1m_kurtosis / seeds;
    a.ret1m_ac1 += f.ret1m_ac1 / seeds;
    a.absret1m_ac1 += f.absret1m_ac1 / seeds;
    a.sign_ac1 += f.sign_ac1 / seeds;
    a.sign_ac10 += f.sign_ac10 / seeds;
    a.sign_ac100 += f.sign_ac100 / seeds;
    a.impact_r2 += f.impact_r2 / seeds;
    a.delta_predict += f.delta_predict / seeds;
    a.markout_5s += f.markout_5s / seeds;
    a.markout_1s += f.markout_1s / seeds;
    a.markout_30s += f.markout_30s / seeds;
    a.mid_changes_per_min += f.mid_changes_per_min / seeds;
  }
  return a;
}
#endif

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  const std::string mode = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "";
  if (mode == "export" && argc > 2) {
    const double seconds = argc > 3 ? std::atof(argv[3]) : 3600;
    SimParams p;
    if (argc > 5) {  // opt-in market preset (and seed, start second); without it the export is unchanged
      try {
        p = market_preset(argv[5]);
      } catch (const std::invalid_argument& e) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", e.what());
        return 2;
      }
    }
    if (argc > 4) p.informed_meta_rate *= std::atof(argv[4]);  // a market with a different informed share
    const std::uint64_t seed = argc > 6 ? std::strtoull(argv[6], nullptr, 10) : 7;
    const double start_second = argc > 7 ? std::atof(argv[7]) : 3600;  // 0 = a whole session from the open
    EsSimulator sim(p, seed, start_second);
    std::FILE* out = std::fopen(argv[2], "w");
    if (!out) return 1;
    write_sim_ticks(sim, static_cast<std::size_t>(seconds / p.dt), [out](const char* s, std::size_t n) { std::fwrite(s, 1, n, out); });
    std::fclose(out);
    return 0;
  }
  if (mode == "sim") {
    const double seconds = argc > 2 ? std::atof(argv[2]) : 10800;
    const std::string market = argc > 3 ? argv[3] : "default";
    SimParams p;
    try {
      p = market_preset(market);
    } catch (const std::invalid_argument& e) {
      std::fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", e.what());
      return 2;
    }
    print_facts(("simulator, " + market + " parameters").c_str(), simulate_facts(p, seconds));
    return 0;
  }
  if ((mode == "facts" || mode == "fit") && argc > 2) {
    const Options o = parse(argc, argv, 3);
    const StylizedFacts real = read_facts(argv[2], o);
    print_facts("recorded ticks", real);
    print_facts("simulator, default parameters", simulate_facts(SimParams{}, o.seconds));
    if (mode == "facts") return 0;
#if defined(RAG_HAVE_NLOPT)
    using rag::agent::tuning::Param;
    const std::vector<Param> space = {{"noise_rate", 0.3, 10, true, false},        {"informed_meta_rate", 0.05, 3, true, false},
                                      {"uninformed_meta_rate", 0.05, 3, true, false}, {"value_vol", 0.05, 1.5, true, false},
                                      {"maker_rate", 1, 40, true, false},            {"cancel_rate", 0.02, 0.5, true, false},
                                      {"fade", 0, 2, false, false},                  {"momentum_rate", 0.05, 4, true, false}};
    auto apply = [&](const std::vector<double>& v) {
      SimParams p;
      p.noise_rate = v[0];
      p.informed_meta_rate = v[1];
      p.uninformed_meta_rate = v[2];
      p.value_vol = v[3];
      p.maker_rate = v[4];
      p.cancel_rate = v[5];
      p.fade = v[6];
      p.momentum_rate = v[7];
      p.taker_size_mean = std::max(1.0, real.mean_trade_size);
      return p;
    };
    const SimParams d;
    const std::vector<double> start = {d.noise_rate, d.informed_meta_rate, d.uninformed_meta_rate, d.value_vol,
                                       d.maker_rate, d.cancel_rate,        d.fade,                 d.momentum_rate};
    std::printf("\nfitting %zu parameters with %d simulator runs of %.1f h each...\n", space.size(), o.evals, o.seconds / 3600);
    const auto r = rag::agent::tuning::maximize_global(
        space, start, [&](const std::vector<double>& v) { return -loss(averaged_facts(apply(v), o.seconds, o.seeds, 1), real); }, o.evals * 2 / 3,
        o.evals - o.evals * 2 / 3, 1);
    const SimParams best = apply(r.best);
    std::printf("loss %.3f -> %.3f (%s)\n", loss(averaged_facts(SimParams{}, o.seconds, o.seeds, 1), real), -r.best_score, r.status.c_str());
    const StylizedFacts check = averaged_facts(best, o.seconds, o.seeds, 1000);
    std::printf("loss on fresh seeds: %.3f\n", loss(check, real));
    print_facts("simulator, fitted parameters (fresh seeds)", check);
    std::printf("\nSimParams fitted;\n");
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < space.size(); ++i) std::printf("fitted.%s = %.6g;\n", space[i].name.c_str(), r.best[i]);
    std::printf("fitted.taker_size_mean = %.6g;\n", best.taker_size_mean);
    return 0;
#else
    std::fprintf(stderr, "fit needs NLopt (build with libnlopt-cxx-dev / RAG_OPTLIBS); facts mode works without it\n");
    return 1;
#endif
  }
  std::fprintf(stderr, "usage: of_calibrate sim [seconds] | facts <ticks.csv> [--tick 0.25 --time ns] | fit <ticks.csv> [--evals 150 --seconds 10800]\n");
  return 2;
}
```

```cpp
// of_trace — step-by-step trace of saved scalping agents, for visualization
// (tools/of_viz.py turns the CSV into one self-contained HTML page).
//
//   of_trace NET [NET...] [--market default|efficient|discovery] [--episodes 20]
//            [--seed 960000000] [--warmup 150] [--out of_trace.csv]
//
// --warmup S (default 150 s): the episodes' warm-up (ScalpParams::
// warmup_seconds), so networks trained with of_train --warmup S are replayed
// on the episodes they learned on. A network whose of_train record
// (DIR/seedK.txt) names another warm-up or market is refused (exit 2), and so
// is a network with no record (trained at 150 s) when S is not 150
// (scalp_run.hpp, check_net). With --warmup the CSV header records it.
//
// Runs ScalpEnv episodes with the saved networks (DIR/seedK.net from
// of_train; several nets act as their mean-Q ensemble, as in of_train) and,
// on the same episode seeds, the 30 s delta rule and the fair-value oracle
// (gap > 2 ticks, as in OF2). Each strategy has its own environment (our
// orders move the market, so the three paths can drift apart by a tick or
// so); the market columns are the agent's.
//
// One CSV row per 1 s decision. Market columns (time of day: session seconds
// since the 09:30 open; bid, ask, mid, hidden
// fair value, L1 sizes and imbalance), the 13 observation features and the
// Q-values describe the state the agent saw when it chose; position, fill,
// orders, fees and P&L are after the step. The fair value is for display
// only: the agent never sees it (only the oracle does).
//
// Seeds: 960,000,000+ is the visualization block (docs/ai/NEXT_SESSION.md
// section 4): look at these episodes as often as you like, but never select
// or score anything on them.
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <memory>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/agent/agent.hpp"
#include "rag/orderflow/scalp_env.hpp"
#include "rag/orderflow/scalp_run.hpp"

using namespace rag::agent;
using namespace rag::orderflow;

namespace {

constexpr std::uint64_t kVizFirst = 960'000'000, kVizEnd = 970'000'000;
constexpr double kOracleGap = 2.0;  // ticks, OF2's "oracle (sees fair value)"
constexpr std::array<const char*, kFeatures> kFeatureNames = {"f_delta5",  "f_delta30", "f_delta120", "f_ofi5",  "f_ofi30",
                                                              "f_relvol",  "f_imb_l1",  "f_imb_l5",   "f_ret5",  "f_ret30",
                                                              "f_ret120",  "f_vwap",    "f_absorb"};

Action hold(const ScalpObs& o) { return static_cast<Action>(o.position + 1); }
Action delta_rule(const ScalpObs& o) { return o.f[1] > 1.5 ? 2 : o.f[1] < -1.5 ? 0 : hold(o); }
Action oracle(const ScalpObs& o, const ScalpEnv& e) {
  const double gap = e.market().fair_value() - e.market().mid();
  return gap > kOracleGap ? 2 : gap < -kOracleGap ? 0 : hold(o);
}

// Strategy cash (ticks) recovered from the environment's public statistics:
// equity = cash + position * mid, net P&L = equity - fees.
double cash(const ScalpEnv& e, int position) { return e.net_pnl_ticks() + e.fees_ticks() - position * e.market().mid(); }

std::string fmt(double x, const char* f = "%.6g") {
  if (!std::isfinite(x)) return "";
  char b[48];
  std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, f, x);
  return b;
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  std::vector<std::string> nets;
  std::string market = "default", out = "of_trace.csv";
  unsigned episodes = 20;
  std::uint64_t first_seed = kVizFirst;
  double warmup = kDefaultWarmup;
  bool warmup_given = false;
  for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
    const std::string k = argv[i];
    if (k.rfind("--", 0) != 0) {
      nets.push_back(k);
      continue;
    }
    if (i + 1 >= argc) {
      std::fprintf(stderr, "%s needs a value\n", k.c_str());
      return 2;
    }
    const std::string v = argv[++i];
    if (k == "--market") market = v;
    else if (k == "--out") out = v;
    else if (k == "--warmup") {
      const auto w = parse_warmup(v);
      if (!w) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "--warmup wants a number of seconds >= 0, got %s\n", v.c_str());
        return 2;
      }
      warmup = *w;
      warmup_given = true;
    }
    else if (k == "--episodes") episodes = static_cast<unsigned>(std::max(1, std::atoi(v.c_str())));
    else if (k == "--seed") {
      char* end = nullptr;
      errno = 0;
      first_seed = std::strtoull(v.c_str(), &end, 10);
      if (v.empty() || v[0] == '-' || *end != '\0' || errno == ERANGE || first_seed < kVizFirst || first_seed >= kVizEnd) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "--seed wants an integer in the visualization block [960000000, 970000000) (docs/ai/NEXT_SESSION.md), got %s\n",
                     v.c_str());
        return 2;
      }
    } else {
      std::fprintf(stderr, "unknown option %s\n", k.c_str());
      return 2;
    }
  }
  if (nets.empty()) {
    std::fprintf(stderr,
                 "usage: of_trace NET [NET...] [--market default|efficient|discovery] [--episodes 20] [--seed 960000000] [--warmup 150] [--out "
                 "of_trace.csv]\n");
    return 2;
  }
  if (first_seed + episodes > kVizEnd) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "--episodes runs past the visualization block\n");
    return 2;
  }
  ScalpParams p;
  try {
    p = scalp_params(market, warmup);
  } catch (const std::invalid_argument& e) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "--market: %s\n", e.what());
    return 2;
  }
  if (const std::string why = warmup_error(p); !why.empty()) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "--warmup: %s\n", why.c_str());
    return 2;
  }
  for (const auto& path : nets)  // the networks' own market and warm-up (of_train's records)
    if (const std::string why = check_net(path, market, warmup); !why.empty()) {
      std::fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", why.c_str());
      return 2;
    }

  // The agents: of_train's NeuralQ setup with the saved weights (greedy).
  const ScalpEnv probe(p);
  std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Agent<ScalpEnv>>> agents;
  for (const auto& path : nets) {
    AgentConfig<ScalpEnv::kStateDims> c;
    c.learner = LearnerKind::NeuralQ;
    c.bins.fill(1);
    c.double_q = true;
    c.nn_polyak = 1e-4;
    auto a = std::make_unique<Agent<ScalpEnv>>(probe, c);
    auto s = a->snapshot();
    try {
      s.net = Mlp::load(path);
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
      std::fprintf(stderr, "%s: %s\n", path.c_str(), e.what());
      return 1;
    }
    if (s.net.inputs() != ScalpEnv::kStateDims || s.net.outputs() != ScalpEnv::kNumActions) {
      std::fprintf(stderr, "%s: network has %u inputs and %u outputs, ScalpEnv needs %zu and %zu\n", path.c_str(), s.net.inputs(), s.net.outputs(),
                   ScalpEnv::kStateDims, ScalpEnv::kNumActions);
      return 1;
    }
    a->restore(s);
    agents.push_back(std::move(a));
  }
  auto mean_q = [&](const ScalpObs& o) {
    std::array<double, ScalpEnv::kNumActions> sum{}, q{};
    for (const auto& a : agents) {
      a->q_values(o, q.data());
      for (std::size_t k = 0; k < q.size(); ++k) sum[k] += q[k] / static_cast<double>(agents.size());
    }
    return sum;
  };

  std::ofstream csv(out);
  if (!csv) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "cannot write %s\n", out.c_str());
    return 1;
  }
  csv << "# of_trace market=" << market << " nets=" << nets.size() << " oracle_gap=" << kOracleGap << " fee_dollars=" << p.fee_dollars
      << " tick_value=" << kTickValue;
  if (warmup_given) csv << " warmup_seconds=" << p.warmup_seconds;  // opt-in: the default header is unchanged
  csv << "\n";
  csv << "episode,seed,step,tod_s,bid,ask,mid,fair_value,bid_sz1,ask_sz1,imb_l1";
  for (const char* n : kFeatureNames) csv << ',' << n;
  csv << ",open_pnl,time_left,q_short,q_flat,q_long,action,pos,fill_px,orders,fees,pnl,rule_pos,rule_pnl,oracle_pos,oracle_pnl\n";

  std::printf("%-8s %10s %10s %10s %8s\n", "episode", "agent", "rule", "oracle", "orders");
  double tot_agent = 0, tot_rule = 0, tot_oracle = 0;
  for (unsigned ep = 0; ep < episodes; ++ep) {
    const std::uint64_t seed = first_seed + ep;
    ScalpEnv ea(p), er(p), eo(p);
    Rng ra(seed), rr(seed), ro(seed);
    // Session second of the simulator's start, drawn as ScalpEnv::reset draws
    // it (the simulator's own clock counts from its construction).
    const double start_second = [&] {
      if (p.start_second >= 0) return p.start_second;
      Rng r(seed);
      return r.uniform() * std::max(0.0, p.sim.session_seconds - p.episode_seconds - p.warmup_seconds);
    }();
    ScalpObs oa = ea.reset(ra), orule = er.reset(rr), oor = eo.reset(ro);
    for (unsigned step = 0;; ++step) {
      const auto& m = ea.market();
      const Quote qt = m.quote();
      const double bsz = qt.bid_size[0], asz = qt.ask_size[0];
      const auto q = mean_q(oa);
      const auto act = static_cast<Action>(std::max_element(q.begin(), q.end()) - q.begin());
      const double cash0 = cash(ea, oa.position);
      const std::uint32_t orders0 = ea.orders();

      std::string row = std::to_string(ep) + ',' + std::to_string(seed) + ',' + std::to_string(step) + ',' +
                        fmt(start_second + static_cast<double>(m.t_ns()) * 1e-9, "%.1f") + ',' + std::to_string(m.bid()) + ',' + std::to_string(m.ask()) + ',' +
                        fmt(m.mid(), "%.1f") + ',' + fmt(m.fair_value(), "%.3f") + ',' + fmt(bsz, "%.0f") + ',' + fmt(asz, "%.0f") + ',' +
                        fmt(bsz + asz > 0 ? (bsz - asz) / (bsz + asz) : 0.0, "%.4f");
      for (double f : oa.f) row += ',' + fmt(f, "%.4f");
      row += ',' + fmt(oa.open_pnl, "%.2f") + ',' + fmt(oa.time_left, "%.4f");
      for (double x : q) row += ',' + fmt(x, "%.4f");

      const auto sa = ea.step(act, ra);
      const auto sr = er.step(delta_rule(orule), rr);
      const auto so = eo.step(oracle(oor, eo), ro);
      // The fill price of this step's market order, recovered from the cash
      // change; empty without an order, or with two (the end-of-episode close
      // after a change: their prices can't be separated).
      double fill = std::nan("");
      const int dpos = sa.obs.position - oa.position;
      if (ea.orders() - orders0 == 1 && dpos != 0) fill = -(cash(ea, sa.obs.position) - cash0) / dpos;
      oa = sa.obs;
      orule = sr.obs;
      oor = so.obs;
      row += ',' + std::to_string(act) + ',' + std::to_string(oa.position) + ',' + fmt(fill, "%.2f") + ',' + std::to_string(ea.orders()) + ',' +
             fmt(ea.fees_ticks(), "%.2f") + ',' + fmt(ea.net_pnl_ticks(), "%.2f") + ',' + std::to_string(orule.position) + ',' +
             fmt(er.net_pnl_ticks(), "%.2f") + ',' + std::to_string(oor.position) + ',' + fmt(eo.net_pnl_ticks(), "%.2f") + '\n';
      csv << row;
      if (sa.done) break;
    }
    tot_agent += ea.net_pnl_ticks();
    tot_rule += er.net_pnl_ticks();
    tot_oracle += eo.net_pnl_ticks();
    std::printf("%-8u %+10.2f %+10.2f %+10.2f %8u\n", ep, ea.net_pnl_ticks(), er.net_pnl_ticks(), eo.net_pnl_ticks(), ea.orders());
  }
  const double n = episodes;
  std::printf("%-8s %+10.2f %+10.2f %+10.2f   ticks/episode, market %s, seeds %llu+ (visualization block: not a score)\n", "mean", tot_agent / n,
              tot_rule / n, tot_oracle / n, market.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned long long>(first_seed));
  std::printf("wrote %s\n", out.c_str());
  return csv.good() ? 0 : 1;
}
```

## FILE: examples\of_train.cpp  (11,156 bytes)

```cpp
// of_train — train order-flow scalping agents in parallel on a many-core
// machine: one seed per thread, then score every agent and their mean-Q
// ensemble on sealed test episodes against the 30 s delta rule.
//
//   of_train [--seeds 12] [--threads N] [--episodes 2000] [--market default|efficient|discovery]
//            [--hidden 64] [--gamma 0.97] [--nstep 5] [--batch 32] [--lr 0.001]
//            [--test 300] [--test-seed 900000000] [--warmup 150] [--out DIR]
// --test-seed: first seed of the scoring episodes (900M+ sealed; 950M+ is the
// once-per-claim fresh confirmation block, see docs/ai/NEXT_SESSION.md).
// --warmup S: seconds the simulator runs before each episode's first decision
// (ScalpParams::warmup_seconds) in training, validation AND sealed test
// episodes; default 150. Episodes then start >= S s into the session
// (ScalpEnv::draw_market: latest warm-up start = session - episode - S).
// OF10 v3: RL on --market discovery uses --warmup 1050 (scalp_run.hpp). The
// run header and the summary print it; each saved network gets a record,
// DIR/seedK.txt next to DIR/seedK.net (market, warmup_seconds, the training
// options and the seed; written right after the network), and of6 / of8 /
// of_trace refuse networks whose record names another market or warm-up
// than their own (scalp_run.hpp, check_net).
//
// --threads defaults to the number of hardware threads (capped at --seeds).
// Each agent is NeuralQ with Double DQN and weight averaging (the recipe of
// OF3); champion selected on validation episodes (seeds 700M+), scored once
// on sealed episodes (900M+, the OF2/OF3 test set). Networks are saved as
// DIR/seedK.net (load with Mlp::load, run with of_backtest on recorded ticks).
//
// Results don't depend on the thread count: each agent owns its environment,
// simulator and random streams. Time: ~0.75 s per episode per thread on a
// 2.8 GHz Xeon (much less on a modern desktop core); 12 seeds x 2,000
// episodes on 12 cores take about as long as one seed.
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cerrno>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/agent/trainer.hpp"
#include "rag/orderflow/scalp_env.hpp"
#include "rag/orderflow/scalp_run.hpp"

using namespace rag::agent;
using namespace rag::orderflow;

namespace {

struct Options {
  unsigned seeds = 12, threads = 0, episodes = 2000, test = 300, hidden = 64, nstep = 5, batch = 32;
  double gamma = 0.97, lr = 1e-3, warmup = kDefaultWarmup;
  std::uint64_t test_seed = 900'000'000;
  std::string market = "default", out = "of_train_out";
};

struct Score {
  double mean = 0, t = 0, win = 0, orders = 0;
};

template <class Policy>
Score score(const ScalpParams& p, Policy&& policy, unsigned episodes, std::uint64_t first_seed) {
  std::vector<double> pnl;
  double orders = 0;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < episodes; ++i) {
    ScalpEnv env(p);
    Rng r(first_seed + i);  // sealed test episodes
    auto o = env.reset(r);
    for (;;) {
      const auto st = env.step(policy(o), r);
      o = st.obs;
      if (st.done) break;
    }
    pnl.push_back(env.net_pnl_ticks());
    orders += env.orders();
  }
  Score s;
  double v = 0;
  for (double x : pnl) {
    s.mean += x;
    s.win += x > 0;
  }
  const double n = static_cast<double>(pnl.size());
  s.mean /= n;
  for (double x : pnl) v += (x - s.mean) * (x - s.mean);
  const double se = std::sqrt(v / (n - 1) / n);
  s.t = se > 0 ? s.mean / se : 0;
  s.win = 100 * s.win / n;
  s.orders = orders / n;
  return s;
}

AgentConfig<ScalpEnv::kStateDims> config(const Options& o, std::uint64_t seed) {
  AgentConfig<ScalpEnv::kStateDims> c;
  c.seed = seed;
  c.learner = LearnerKind::NeuralQ;
  c.bins.fill(1);  // the tile grid is unused by NeuralQ
  c.double_q = true;
  c.nn_polyak = 1e-4;
  c.nn_hidden = o.hidden;
  c.nn_batch = o.batch;
  c.nn_lr = o.lr;
  c.gamma = o.gamma;
  c.n_step = o.nstep;
  c.eps_start = 1.0;
  c.eps_end = 0.02;
  c.eps_decay_episodes = std::max(1u, o.episodes / 2);
  return c;
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  Options o;
  if (argc % 2 == 0) {  // options come in pairs: a trailing flag has no value
    std::fprintf(stderr, "%s needs a value\n", argv[argc - 1]);
    return 2;
  }
  for (int i = 1; i + 1 < argc; i += 2) {
    const std::string k = argv[i], v = argv[i + 1];
    if (k == "--seeds") o.seeds = static_cast<unsigned>(std::max(1, std::atoi(v.c_str())));
    else if (k == "--threads") o.threads = static_cast<unsigned>(std::max(1, std::atoi(v.c_str())));
    else if (k == "--episodes") o.episodes = static_cast<unsigned>(std::max(1, std::atoi(v.c_str())));
    else if (k == "--test") o.test = static_cast<unsigned>(std::max(2, std::atoi(v.c_str())));
    else if (k == "--hidden") o.hidden = static_cast<unsigned>(std::max(4, std::atoi(v.c_str())));
    else if (k == "--nstep") o.nstep = static_cast<unsigned>(std::max(1, std::atoi(v.c_str())));
    else if (k == "--batch") o.batch = static_cast<unsigned>(std::max(1, std::atoi(v.c_str())));
    else if (k == "--gamma") o.gamma = std::atof(v.c_str());
    else if (k == "--lr") o.lr = std::atof(v.c_str());
    else if (k == "--market") o.market = v;
    else if (k == "--out") o.out = v;
    else if (k == "--warmup") {
      const auto w = parse_warmup(v);
      if (!w) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "--warmup wants a number of seconds >= 0, got %s\n", v.c_str());
        return 2;
      }
      o.warmup = *w;
    }
    else if (k == "--test-seed") {
      // Must be a whole number in a test block (900M+): a typo parsing to a
      // small seed would score on the training streams (Rng(1..seeds)).
      char* end = nullptr;
      errno = 0;
      o.test_seed = std::strtoull(v.c_str(), &end, 10);
      if (v.empty() || v[0] == '-' || *end != '\0' || errno == ERANGE || o.test_seed < 900'000'000) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "--test-seed wants an integer >= 900000000 (a test block, docs/ai/NEXT_SESSION.md), got %s\n", v.c_str());
        return 2;
      }
    }
    else {
      std::fprintf(stderr, "unknown option %s\n", k.c_str());
      return 2;
    }
  }
  if (o.threads == 0) o.threads = std::max(1u, std::thread::hardware_concurrency());
  o.threads = std::min(o.threads, o.seeds);
  ScalpParams p;
  try {
    p = scalp_params(o.market, o.warmup);
  } catch (const std::invalid_argument& e) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "--market: %s\n", e.what());
    return 2;
  }
  if (const std::string why = warmup_error(p); !why.empty()) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "--warmup: %s\n", why.c_str());
    return 2;
  }
  std::filesystem::create_directories(o.out);
  // Each saved network's record (DIR/seedK.txt): of6 / of8 / of_trace check market and warm-up against it.
  char options[512];
  std::snprintf(options, sizeof options, "seeds=%u\nepisodes=%u\nhidden=%u\ngamma=%.17g\nnstep=%u\nbatch=%u\nlr=%.17g\ntest=%u\ntest_seed=%llu\n",
                o.seeds, o.episodes, o.hidden, o.gamma, o.nstep, o.batch, o.lr, o.test, static_cast<unsigned long long>(o.test_seed));
  std::atomic<bool> record_failed{false};
  std::printf("training %u seeds x %u episodes on %u threads (hardware threads: %u), market %s, warm-up %g s, hidden %u\n", o.seeds, o.episodes,
              o.threads, std::thread::hardware_concurrency(), o.market.c_str(), o.warmup, o.hidden);
  std::fflush(stdout);

  const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Agent<ScalpEnv>>> agents(o.seeds);
  std::vector<Score> scores(o.seeds);
  std::vector<double> validation(o.seeds);
  std::atomic<unsigned> next{0};
  std::mutex print;
  auto worker = [&] {
    for (unsigned i; (i = next++) < o.seeds;) {
      const std::uint64_t seed = i + 1;
      ScalpEnv env(p);
      auto agent = std::make_unique<Agent<ScalpEnv>>(env, config(o, seed));
      Trainer<ScalpEnv> tr(*agent, env,
                           {.eval_every = std::max(1u, o.episodes / 20), .eval_episodes = 40, .eval_seed = 700'000'000, .train_seed = seed,
                            .detect_drift = false});
      const auto rep = tr.run(o.episodes);
      validation[i] = rep.champion_score;
      if (const auto* ch = tr.champion()) {
        // The old record goes first and the new one comes right after the
        // network: a record never vouches for another run's network.
        const std::string path = o.out + "/seed" + std::to_string(seed) + ".net";
        remove_net_record(path);
        ch->net.save(path);
        if (!write_net_record(path, o.market, o.warmup, options + ("seed=" + std::to_string(seed) + "\n"))) {
          std::lock_guard lock(print);
          std::fprintf(stderr, "can't write %s\n", record_path_of_net(path).c_str());
          record_failed = true;
        }
        agent->restore(*ch);  // the deployed policy, for scoring and the ensemble
      }
      scores[i] = score(p, [&](const ScalpObs& ob) { return agent->act(ob, false); }, o.test, o.test_seed);
      {
        std::lock_guard lock(print);
        std::printf("  seed %2llu: validation %+.2f, sealed test %+.2f ticks/episode (t %+.1f, %.1f orders, %.0f%% winning)\n",
                    static_cast<unsigned long long>(seed), validation[i], scores[i].mean, scores[i].t, scores[i].orders, scores[i].win);
        std::fflush(stdout);
      }
      agents[i] = std::move(agent);
    }
  };
  std::vector<std::thread> pool;
  for (unsigned t = 0; t < o.threads; ++t) pool.emplace_back(worker);
  for (auto& t : pool) t.join();
  const double secs = std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count();

  const Score rule = score(
      p, [](const ScalpObs& ob) -> Action { return ob.f[1] > 1.5 ? 2 : ob.f[1] < -1.5 ? 0 : static_cast<Action>(ob.position + 1); }, o.test, o.test_seed);
  const Score ens = score(
      p,
      [&](const ScalpObs& ob) -> Action {
        std::array<double, ScalpEnv::kNumActions> sum{}, q{};
        for (auto& a : agents) {
          a->q_values(ob, q.data());
          for (std::size_t k = 0; k < q.size(); ++k) sum[k] += q[k];
        }
        return static_cast<Action>(std::max_element(sum.begin(), sum.end()) - sum.begin());
      },
      o.test, o.test_seed);
  double mean_single = 0;
  for (const auto& s : scores) mean_single += s.mean / static_cast<double>(scores.size());
  std::printf("\nsealed test, %u episodes of 10 min from seed %llu (1 ES contract, market %s, warm-up %g s):\n", o.test,
              static_cast<unsigned long long>(o.test_seed), o.market.c_str(), o.warmup);
  std::printf("  delta 30 s rule      %+.2f ticks/episode (t %+.1f)\n", rule.mean, rule.t);
  std::printf("  RL, mean of seeds    %+.2f\n", mean_single);
  std::printf("  RL mean-Q ensemble   %+.2f (t %+.1f, %.1f orders, %.0f%% winning) of all %u seeds\n", ens.mean, ens.t, ens.orders, ens.win, o.seeds);
  std::printf("training took %.0f s; networks in %s/\n", secs, o.out.c_str());
  std::printf("note: these are simulator results; replay recorded ticks with of_backtest before trusting any edge.\n");
  return record_failed ? 1 : 0;
}
```

```cpp
// rag_pdf — index PDFs and text/source files, then ask questions with citations.
//
//   rag_pdf index <index-file> <pdf-or-directory>... [options]
//   rag_pdf ask   <index-file> "<question>" [-k N] [--prompt] [options]
//   rag_pdf info  <index-file>
//
// Options:
//   --mode exact|int8|ivf|ivf-sq8   dense retrieval mode (default exact)
//   --window N --overlap N          chunk size in words (default 128 / 32)
//   -k N                            passages to show (default 5)
//   --prompt                        also print the prompt an LLM would receive
//
// Directories are searched recursively for PDFs and text files (.md .txt .rst
// .hpp .h .cpp .cc .c .py .rs .go .java .ts .js .json .yml .yaml .toml .csv
// .cmake CMakeLists.txt), skipping hidden directories, build*, dist and
// node_modules. PDFs are cited by page ("q3.pdf, p. 4"); text files by chunk
// ("api.md, chunk 2"). Files found in a directory are cited by their path
// relative to it; files named directly by file name. Text files are indexed
// verbatim (characters normalized, no reflow, so code keeps its lines);
// binary files (containing NUL bytes) and files over 8 MB are skipped.
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/pdf.hpp"

namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using Engine = rag::RagEngine<rag::HashingEmbedder<384>>;

namespace {

[[noreturn]] void usage(const char* msg = nullptr) {
  if (msg) std::fprintf(stderr, "error: %s\n\n", msg);
  std::fprintf(stderr,
               "usage:\n"
               "  rag_pdf index <index-file> <pdf-or-directory>... [--mode M] [--window N] [--overlap N]\n"
               "  rag_pdf ask   <index-file> \"<question>\" [-k N] [--prompt] [--mode M]\n"
               "  rag_pdf info  <index-file>\n"
               "modes: exact (default), int8, ivf, ivf-sq8\n");
  std::exit(2);
}

struct Args {
  std::vector<std::string> positional;
  rag::DenseMode mode = rag::DenseMode::Exact;
  std::uint32_t window = 128, overlap = 32, k = 5;
  bool prompt = false;
};

std::uint32_t parse_u32(const char* s, const char* what) {
  char* end = nullptr;
  const unsigned long v = std::strtoul(s, &end, 10);
  if (!*s || *end || v == 0 || v > 1'000'000) usage((std::string("bad value for ") + what + ": " + s).c_str());
  return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(v);
}

Args parse(int argc, char** argv, int from) {
  Args a;
  for (int i = from; i < argc; ++i) {
    const std::string s = argv[i];
    auto next = [&]() -> const char* {
      if (i + 1 >= argc) usage(("missing value after " + s).c_str());
      return argv[++i];
    };
    if (s == "--mode") {
      const std::string m = next();
      if (m == "exact") a.mode = rag::DenseMode::Exact;
      else if (m == "int8") a.mode = rag::DenseMode::Int8Rerank;
      else if (m == "ivf") a.mode = rag::DenseMode::Ivf;
      else if (m == "ivf-sq8") a.mode = rag::DenseMode::IvfInt8;
      else usage(("unknown mode " + m).c_str());
    } else if (s == "--window") a.window = parse_u32(next(), "--window");
    else if (s == "--overlap") a.overlap = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::strtoul(next(), nullptr, 10));
    else if (s == "-k") a.k = parse_u32(next(), "-k");
    else if (s == "--prompt") a.prompt = true;
    else if (s.size() > 1 && s[0] == '-') usage(("unknown option " + s).c_str());
    else a.positional.push_back(s);
  }
  if (a.overlap >= a.window) usage("--overlap must be smaller than --window");
  return a;
}

rag::EngineConfig config_for(const Args& a, std::uint32_t max_chunks) {
  rag::EngineConfig cfg;
  cfg.max_chunks = std::max<std::uint32_t>(max_chunks, 1);
  cfg.chunker = {a.window, a.overlap};
  cfg.dense_mode = a.mode;
  cfg.nprobe = 16;
  cfg.prompt.max_context_tokens = 2048;
  cfg.prompt_capacity = 64 * 1024;
  return cfg;
}

enum class Kind { Pdf, Text, Other };

struct Input {
  fs::path path;
  std::string cite_as;
  Kind kind;
};

Kind kind_of(const fs::path& p) {
  std::string ext = p.extension().string();
  std::transform(ext.begin(), ext.end(), ext.begin(), [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
  if (ext == ".pdf") return Kind::Pdf;
  static const char* text[] = {".md", ".txt", ".rst", ".hpp", ".h", ".cpp", ".cc", ".c", ".py", ".rs", ".go", ".java",
                               ".ts", ".js", ".json", ".yml", ".yaml", ".toml", ".csv", ".cmake"};
  for (const char* t : text)
    if (ext == t) return Kind::Text;
  return p.filename() == "CMakeLists.txt" ? Kind::Text : Kind::Other;
}

bool skip_dir(const fs::path& d) {
  const std::string n = d.filename().string();
  return (n.size() > 1 && n[0] == '.') || n.rfind("build", 0) == 0 || n == "dist" || n == "node_modules";
}

constexpr std::uintmax_t kMaxTextBytes = 8u << 20;

// Reads a text file; empty optional-like result (ok=false) for binary or oversized files.
bool read_text(const fs::path& p, std::string& out, std::string& why) {
  if (fs::file_size(p) > kMaxTextBytes) { why = "larger than 8 MB"; return false; }
  std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
  out.assign(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f), {});
  if (out.find('\0') != std::string::npos) { why = "binary (contains NUL bytes)"; return false; }
  out = rag::text::normalize_chars(out);  // CRLF, odd spaces, ligatures; lines are kept
  return true;
}

std::vector<Input> collect(const std::vector<std::string>& args) {
  std::vector<Input> out;
  for (const auto& a : args) {
    const fs::path p = a;
    if (fs::is_directory(p)) {
      std::vector<Input> found;
      for (auto it = fs::recursive_directory_iterator(p, fs::directory_options::skip_permission_denied);
           it != fs::recursive_directory_iterator(); ++it) {
        if (it->is_directory() && skip_dir(it->path())) { it.disable_recursion_pending(); continue; }
        const Kind k = it->is_regular_file() ? kind_of(it->path()) : Kind::Other;
        if (k != Kind::Other) found.push_back({it->path(), fs::relative(it->path(), p).generic_string(), k});
      }
      std::sort(found.begin(), found.end(), [](const Input& x, const Input& y) { return x.cite_as < y.cite_as; });
      out.insert(out.end(), found.begin(), found.end());
    } else if (fs::is_regular_file(p)) {
      const Kind k = kind_of(p);
      if (k == Kind::Other) std::fprintf(stderr, "warning: skipping %s (not a PDF or a known text type)\n", a.c_str());
      else out.push_back({p, p.filename().string(), k});
    } else {
      std::fprintf(stderr, "warning: skipping %s (not a file or directory)\n", a.c_str());
    }
  }
  return out;
}

// Snippet for display: whitespace collapsed, cut at a word boundary.
std::string snippet(std::string_view t, std::size_t max = 280) {
  std::string s;
  bool sp = false;
  for (char c : t) {
    if (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\t') { sp = !s.empty(); continue; }
    if (sp) s += ' ';
    sp = false;
    s += c;
  }
  if (s.size() <= max) return s;
  std::size_t cut = s.rfind(' ', max);
  if (cut == std::string::npos || cut < max / 2) cut = max;
  while (cut > 0 && (static_cast<unsigned char>(s[cut]) & 0xC0) == 0x80) --cut;  // UTF-8 boundary
  return s.substr(0, cut) + " ...";
}

std::string where(const rag::ChunkView& c) {
  std::string w = c.source.empty() ? "doc " + std::to_string(c.doc_id) : std::string(c.source);
  if (c.page_first == 0) return w + ", chunk " + std::to_string(c.ordinal);
  if (c.page_first == c.page_last) return w + ", p. " + std::to_string(c.page_first);
  return w + ", pp. " + std::to_string(c.page_first) + "-" + std::to_string(c.page_last);
}

int cmd_index(const Args& a) {
  if (a.positional.size() < 2) usage("index needs an index file and at least one file or directory");
  const fs::path index = a.positional[0];
  const auto inputs = collect({a.positional.begin() + 1, a.positional.end()});
  if (inputs.empty()) usage("no PDF or text files found");

  // Extract everything first, so the engine can be sized exactly.
  struct Extracted {
    Input in;
    rag::pdf::Document doc;  // PDFs
    std::string text;        // text files
  };
  std::vector<Extracted> docs;
  std::uint64_t words = 0;
  for (const auto& in : inputs) {
    try {
      Extracted x{in, {}, {}};
      std::string why;
      if (in.kind == Kind::Pdf) {
        x.doc = rag::pdf::extract(in.path);
        for (const auto& p : x.doc.pages) rag::for_each_token(p, [&](const rag::Token&) { ++words; });
      } else if (read_text(in.path, x.text, why)) {
        rag::for_each_token(x.text, [&](const rag::Token&) { ++words; });
      } else {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "warning: skipping %s: %s\n", in.cite_as.c_str(), why.c_str());
        continue;
      }
      docs.push_back(std::move(x));
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
      std::fprintf(stderr, "warning: skipping %s: %s\n", in.cite_as.c_str(), e.what());
    }
  }
  if (docs.empty()) { std::fprintf(stderr, "error: no file could be read\n"); return 1; }
  // Chunks per document <= words / stride + 1.
  const std::uint64_t stride = a.window - a.overlap;
  const std::uint64_t estimate = words / stride + docs.size() + 16;
  if (estimate > 0xFFFFFFF0ull) { std::fprintf(stderr, "error: corpus too large\n"); return 1; }

  Engine e(config_for(a, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(estimate)));
  std::uint32_t total_pages = 0, total_empty = 0;
  std::size_t n_pdf = 0;
  for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < docs.size(); ++i) {
    if (docs[i].in.kind == Kind::Text) {
      const auto chunks = e.ingest(docs[i].text, i, rag::IngestOptions{.source = docs[i].in.cite_as});
      std::printf("  %-40s   text %5u chunks\n", docs[i].in.cite_as.c_str(), chunks);
      continue;
    }
    ++n_pdf;
    const auto r = rag::pdf::ingest(e, docs[i].doc, i, docs[i].in.cite_as);
    total_pages += r.pages;
    total_empty += r.empty_pages;
    std::string note;
    if (r.empty_pages)
      note = "  (" + std::to_string(r.empty_pages) + (r.empty_pages == 1 ? " page" : " pages") + " without text: scanned?)";
    std::printf("  %-40s %4u pages %5u chunks%s\n", docs[i].in.cite_as.c_str(), r.pages, r.chunks, note.c_str());
  }
  e.commit();
  e.save(index);
  std::printf("indexed %zu %s (%zu PDF, %u pages), %u chunks -> %s (%.1f MB)\n", docs.size(),
              docs.size() == 1 ? "file" : "files", n_pdf, total_pages, e.size(),
              index.string().c_str(), static_cast<double>(fs::file_size(index)) / 1e6);
  if (total_empty)
    std::printf("note: %u %s no extractable text. Scanned pages need OCR before indexing.\n", total_empty,
                total_empty == 1 ? "page had" : "pages had");
  return 0;
}

int cmd_ask(const Args& a) {
  if (a.positional.size() != 2) usage("ask needs an index file and one question (quote it)");
  const auto info = Engine::inspect(a.positional[0]);
  auto e = Engine::load(a.positional[0], config_for(a, info.chunks + 1));
  auto ctx = e->make_context();
  const std::string& q = a.positional[1];
  const auto r = e->query(q, std::min<std::uint32_t>(a.k, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(Engine::kMaxK)), ctx);
  if (r.hits.empty()) {
    std::printf("No matching passages for: %s\n", q.c_str());
    return 0;
  }
  auto score_in = [](std::span<const rag::Hit> list, std::uint32_t id) -> std::string {
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < list.size(); ++i)
      if (list[i].id == id) return "#" + std::to_string(i + 1);
    return "-";
  };
  if (r.hits.size() == 1) std::printf("Top passage for: %s\n\n", q.c_str());
  else std::printf("Top %zu passages for: %s\n\n", r.hits.size(), q.c_str());
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < r.hits.size(); ++i) {
    const auto c = e->chunk(r.hits[i].id);
    std::printf("[%zu] %s   (semantic %s, keyword %s)\n    %s\n\n", i + 1, where(c).c_str(),
                score_in(r.dense, r.hits[i].id).c_str(), score_in(r.lexical, r.hits[i].id).c_str(),
                snippet(c.text).c_str());
  }
  if (a.prompt) std::printf("----- prompt for the LLM -----\n%.*s\n", static_cast<int>(r.prompt.prompt.size()), r.prompt.prompt.data());
  return 0;
}

int cmd_info(const Args& a) {
  if (a.positional.size() != 1) usage("info needs an index file");
  const auto info = Engine::inspect(a.positional[0]);
  std::printf("format v%u, %u chunks, %u-dim vectors, %.1f MB of text\n", info.format_version, info.chunks, info.dim,
              static_cast<double>(info.text_bytes) / 1e6);
  return 0;
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  if (argc < 2) usage();
  const std::string cmd = argv[1];
  try {
    const Args a = parse(argc, argv, 2);
    if (cmd == "index") return cmd_index(a);
    if (cmd == "ask") return cmd_ask(a);
    if (cmd == "info") return cmd_info(a);
    usage(("unknown command " + cmd).c_str());
  } catch (const std::exception& e) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "error: %s\n", e.what());
    return 1;
  }
}
```

```cpp
// train_ensemble — the best learned execution policy (E25, DECISIONS A48),
// trained in parallel: N NeuralQ networks (Double DQN, weight averaging
// nn_polyak = 1e-4, seeds 1..N), one per thread; each deployed champion
// compiled to an ExecutionPolicyTable; the cell-wise median of the tables
// saved as the deployable policy. Scores every member and the ensemble
// against the exact optimum on 1,000 held-out scenarios.
//
//   train_ensemble [networks=4] [episodes=40000] [threads=networks] [out=ensemble.tbl]
//
// Every network's result is independent of the thread count (each thread
// owns its agent, environment and RNG streams).
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/agent/execution_dp.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/policy_table.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/trainer.hpp"

using namespace rag::agent;

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  const unsigned networks = argc > 1 ? static_cast<unsigned>(std::max(1, std::atoi(argv[1]))) : 4u;
  const unsigned episodes = argc > 2 ? static_cast<unsigned>(std::max(1, std::atoi(argv[2]))) : 40000u;
  const unsigned threads = argc > 3 ? static_cast<unsigned>(std::max(1, std::atoi(argv[3]))) : networks;
  const std::string out = argc > 4 ? argv[4] : "ensemble.tbl";

  const ExecutionParams p;
  const ExecutionEnv env(p);
  const ExecutionDP dp(p);
  auto twap = [](const ExecutionObs&) { return ExecutionEnv::kTwapAction; };
  constexpr std::uint32_t kScenarios = 1000;
  constexpr std::uint64_t kEvalSeed = 77'000'000;  // the held-out scenarios of E21-E25
  const double opt = compare(env, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return dp.act(o); }, twap, kScenarios, kEvalSeed).mean;

  std::printf("Training %u networks x %u episodes on %u threads (hardware threads: %u)...\n", networks, episodes, threads,
              std::thread::hardware_concurrency());
  const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ExecutionPolicyTable>> tables(networks);
  std::vector<double> network_share(networks);
  std::vector<std::thread> pool;
  unsigned next = 0;
  std::mutex m;  // guards next
  auto worker = [&] {
    for (;;) {
      unsigned i;
      {
        std::lock_guard lock(m);
        if (next >= networks) return;
        i = next++;
      }
      AgentConfig<3> c;
      c.seed = i + 1;
      c.eps_decay_episodes = std::min(10000u, std::max(1u, episodes / 4));
      c.learner = LearnerKind::NeuralQ;
      c.double_q = true;
      c.nn_polyak = 1e-4;
      ExecutionEnv e(p);
      auto agent = std::make_unique<Agent<ExecutionEnv>>(e, c);
      Trainer<ExecutionEnv> tr(*agent, e,
                               {.eval_every = std::min(1000u, std::max(1u, episodes / 10)), .eval_episodes = 500, .train_seed = c.seed,
                                .detect_drift = false});
      tr.run(episodes);
      auto deployed = [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return tr.deployed_act(o); };
      network_share[i] = compare(env, deployed, twap, kScenarios, kEvalSeed).mean / opt;
      tables[i] = std::make_unique<ExecutionPolicyTable>(p, deployed, PolicyTableParams{.signal_bins = 256, .signal_range_sd = 4.0});
    }
  };
  for (unsigned t = 0; t < std::min(threads, networks); ++t) pool.emplace_back(worker);
  for (auto& t : pool) t.join();
  const double secs = std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count();

  std::vector<ExecutionPolicyTable> members;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < networks; ++i) {
    const double table_share =
        compare(env, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return tables[i]->act(o); }, twap, kScenarios, kEvalSeed).mean / opt;
    std::printf("  network %2u: %5.1f%% of the optimal gain (its table: %5.1f%%)\n", i + 1, 100 * network_share[i], 100 * table_share);
    members.push_back(*tables[i]);
  }
  const auto ensemble = ExecutionPolicyTable::median(members);
  const double ens = compare(env, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return ensemble.act(o); }, twap, kScenarios, kEvalSeed).mean / opt;
  ensemble.save(out);
  std::printf("Median vote of %u: %.1f%% of the optimal gain. Saved %s (%zu KB). Training took %.0f s.\n", networks, 100 * ens,
              out.c_str(), ensemble.bytes() / 1000, secs);
  std::printf("Load it with ExecutionPolicyTable::load(\"%s\"); act() is a ~3 ns lookup.\n", out.c_str());
}
```

## FILE: examples\tune_agent.cpp  (4,883 bytes)

```cpp
// tune_agent — tune the tile-coded learner's hyperparameters on ExecutionEnv
// with NLopt, validate on held-out seeds with bootstrap confidence intervals,
// and report which parameters matter (Eigen response surface). E18.
//
//   ./build/tune_agent [episodes=10000] [evaluations=120]
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/agent/analysis.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/execution_dp.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/trainer.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/tuning.hpp"

using namespace rag::agent;

namespace {

auto twap = [](const ExecutionObs&) { return ExecutionEnv::kTwapAction; };

AgentConfig<3> config_from(const std::vector<double>& v, std::uint64_t seed) {
  AgentConfig<3> c;
  c.seed = seed;
  c.alpha = v[0];
  c.alpha_min = std::min(c.alpha_min, c.alpha);
  c.alpha_decay_episodes = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(v[1]);
  c.eps_start = v[2];
  c.eps_end = std::min(0.02, v[2]);
  c.eps_decay_episodes = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(v[3]);
  const auto bins = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(v[4]);
  c.bins = {bins, bins, bins};
  c.tilings = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(v[5]);
  return c;
}

// Share of the optimal gain after `episodes` episodes, one value per seed.
std::vector<double> shares(const std::vector<double>& v, const std::vector<std::uint64_t>& seeds, unsigned episodes,
                           const ExecutionEnv& env, double opt) {
  std::vector<double> out;
  for (auto seed : seeds) {
    ExecutionEnv e(env.params());
    Agent<ExecutionEnv> agent(e, config_from(v, seed));
    Trainer<ExecutionEnv> tr(agent, e, {.eval_every = 0, .train_seed = seed, .detect_drift = false});
    tr.run(episodes);
    out.push_back(compare(env, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return agent.act(o, false); }, twap, 1000, 61'000'000).mean / opt);
  }
  return out;
}

double mean(const std::vector<double>& v) {
  double s = 0;
  for (double x : v) s += x;
  return s / static_cast<double>(v.size());
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  const unsigned episodes = argc > 1 ? static_cast<unsigned>(std::atoi(argv[1])) : 10000;
  const int evaluations = argc > 2 ? std::atoi(argv[2]) : 120;
  const ExecutionParams p;
  const ExecutionEnv env(p);
  const ExecutionDP dp(p);
  const double opt = compare(env, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return dp.act(o); }, twap, 1000, 61'000'000).mean;

  const std::vector<tuning::Param> space = {
      {"alpha", 0.001, 1.0, true, false},       {"alpha_decay_episodes", 300, 30000, true, true},
      {"eps_start", 0.02, 1.0, false, false},   {"eps_decay_episodes", 500, 20000, true, true},
      {"bins", 2, 10, false, true},             {"tilings", 4, 32, true, true}};
  const std::vector<double> defaults = {0.1, 3000, 1.0, 10000, 8, 8};
  const std::vector<std::uint64_t> search_seeds = {1, 2, 8}, held_out = {3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11};

  std::printf("Searching %d configurations, %u training episodes each, on seeds 1, 2, 8 ...\n", evaluations, episodes);
  // Global search first (the landscape is rugged: a local search's result
  // depended on its initial step), then local refinement.
  const auto r = tuning::maximize_global(
      space, defaults, [&](const std::vector<double>& v) { return mean(shares(v, search_seeds, episodes, env, opt)); },
      evaluations * 2 / 3, evaluations - evaluations * 2 / 3, 1);
  std::printf("  %zu trials (%s); best on the search seeds: %.1f%% of the optimal gain\n\n", r.history.size(), r.status.c_str(),
              100 * r.best_score);
  std::printf("  %-22s %10s %10s\n", "parameter", "default", "tuned");
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < space.size(); ++i) std::printf("  %-22s %10.4g %10.4g\n", space[i].name.c_str(), defaults[i], r.best[i]);

  std::printf("\nValidation on 8 held-out seeds (mean, 95%% bootstrap interval):\n");
  for (int which = 0; which < 2; ++which) {
    const auto s = shares(which ? r.best : defaults, held_out, episodes, env, opt);
    const auto ci = bootstrap_mean(s, 10000, 1);
    std::printf("  %-8s %5.1f%%  [%5.1f%%, %5.1f%%]\n", which ? "tuned" : "default", 100 * ci.mean, 100 * ci.lo, 100 * ci.hi);
  }

  std::vector<std::vector<double>> rows;
  std::vector<double> scores;
  for (const auto& t : r.history) {
    std::vector<double> row = t.values;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < space.size(); ++i)
      if (space[i].log_scale) row[i] = std::log(row[i]);  // analyse log-scaled parameters in log space
    rows.push_back(row);
    scores.push_back(t.score);
  }
  const auto sens = analysis::quadratic_sensitivity(rows, scores);
  std::printf("\nWhat mattered across the %zu trials (quadratic response surface, R^2 = %.2f):\n", rows.size(), sens.r2);
  std::printf("  %-22s %16s %12s\n", "parameter", "linear per sd", "curvature");
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < space.size(); ++i)
    std::printf("  %-22s %+15.1f%% %+11.1f%%\n", space[i].name.c_str(), 100 * sens.linear[i], 100 * sens.quadratic[i]);
}
```

```cpp
// latency.cpp — tail-latency probe for the full query pipeline.
//
// Google Benchmark reports means; trading-style SLOs care about p99/p99.9.
// This harness records every query's wall time into a preallocated array
// (no allocation inside the timed loop), pins itself to one core to keep
// scheduler migrations out of the tail, and prints percentiles.
#if defined(__linux__)
#include <sched.h>
#elif defined(_WIN32)
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#undef near  // windows.h defines near/far as empty macros
#undef far
#endif

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

#include "fixtures.hpp"

using namespace rag;
using namespace rag::bench;
using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;

// Pin the calling thread to CPU 1 (keeps migrations out of the tail).
static bool pin_to_cpu1() {
#if defined(__linux__)
  cpu_set_t set;
  CPU_ZERO(&set);
  CPU_SET(1, &set);
  return sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(set), &set) == 0;
#elif defined(_WIN32)
  return SetThreadAffinityMask(GetCurrentThread(), DWORD_PTR{1} << 1) != 0;
#else
  return false;
#endif
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  const std::size_t iters = argc > 1 ? std::strtoul(argv[1], nullptr, 10) : 20000;
  const bool pinned = pin_to_cpu1();
  const auto qs = text_queries(1024);
  std::vector<std::int64_t> ns(iters);  // preallocated

  std::printf("corpus: %zu docs | pinned: %s | iters: %zu\n", corpus().docs.size(), pinned ? "cpu1" : "no", iters);
  std::printf("%-12s %8s %8s %8s %8s %8s %8s %9s\n", "mode", "chunks", "p50", "p90", "p99", "p99.9", "max", "QPS/core");
  for (auto mode : {DenseMode::Exact, DenseMode::Int8Rerank, DenseMode::Ivf, DenseMode::IvfInt8}) {
    auto& e = engine(mode);
    auto ctx = e.make_context();
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2000; ++i) (void)e.query(qs[i & 1023], 8, ctx);  // warm caches + branch predictors
    volatile std::size_t sink = 0;
    const auto t_all = Clock::now();
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < iters; ++i) {
      const auto t0 = Clock::now();
      const auto r = e.query(qs[i & 1023], 8, ctx);
      const auto t1 = Clock::now();
      sink = sink + r.prompt.prompt.size();
      ns[i] = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(t1 - t0).count();
    }
    const double secs = std::chrono::duration<double>(Clock::now() - t_all).count();
    std::sort(ns.begin(), ns.end());
    auto pct = [&](double p) { return double(ns[std::min(iters - 1, std::size_t(p * double(iters)))]) / 1000.0; };
    std::printf("%-12s %8u %7.1fus %7.1fus %7.1fus %7.1fus %7.1fus %9.0f\n",
                mode_name(mode),
                e.size(), pct(0.50), pct(0.90), pct(0.99), pct(0.999), double(ns.back()) / 1000.0, double(iters) / secs);
  }
}
```

```cpp
// rag_bench.cpp — Google Benchmark microbenchmarks, kernel -> component -> pipeline.
#include <benchmark/benchmark.h>

#include <random>

// ----------------------------- kernels --------------------------------------
template <float (*F)(const float*, const float*, std::size_t)>
static void BM_DotF32(benchmark::State& st) {
  const auto n = static_cast<std::size_t>(st.range(0));
  auto a = make_aligned_array<float>(n), b = make_aligned_array<float>(n);
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { a[i] = 0.001f * float(i); b[i] = 1.f - 0.0005f * float(i); }
  for (auto _ : st) {
    benchmark::DoNotOptimize(F(a.get(), b.get(), n));
    benchmark::ClobberMemory();
  }
  st.SetBytesProcessed(st.iterations() * std::int64_t(2 * n * sizeof(float)));
}
static float dot_scalar_noinline(const float* a, const float* b, std::size_t n) {
  // GCC auto-vectorises the plain loop at -O3 only with -ffast-math (FP
  // reassociation), so this is the honest "naive C++" baseline.
  return simd::dot_scalar(a, b, n);
}

#endif

// IVF over 100k rows, fp32 lists vs int8 lists + fp32 rerank of 128.
// range(0) = nprobe, range(1) = 0 (fp32) / 1 (int8). Recall@10 vs exact is a counter.
static void BM_Ivf(benchmark::State& st) {
  constexpr std::uint32_t n = 100'000;
  auto& s = store(n);
  const auto& q = queries(n);
  static IvfIndex<kD> ivf = [&] { IvfIndex<kD> i; i.build(s, n, {.nlist = 256, .storage = IvfStorage::Both}); return i; }();
  const auto nprobe = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(st.range(0));
  const bool int8 = st.range(1) != 0;
  std::array<std::int8_t, kD> qq;
  auto run = [&](const float* qv, TopK<10>& out) {
    if (!int8) { ivf.search(qv, nprobe, out); return; }
    simd::quantize_i8(qv, qq.data(), kD);
    TopK<128> cand(128);
    ivf.search_int8(qv, qq.data(), nprobe, cand);
    for (const Hit& h : cand.sorted()) out.push(simd::dot(qv, s.row(h.id), kD), h.id);
  };
  double r = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) {
    TopK<10> e(10), a(10);
    s.search_exact(q.data() + i * kD, 0, n, e);
    run(q.data() + i * kD, a);
    auto eh = e.sorted(); auto ah = a.sorted();
    for (auto& x : ah) r += std::any_of(eh.begin(), eh.end(), [&](const Hit& y) { return y.id == x.id; });
  }
  std::size_t qi = 0;
  for (auto _ : st) {
    TopK<10> tk(10);
    run(q.data() + (qi++ & 255) * kD, tk);
    benchmark::DoNotOptimize(tk.threshold());
  }
  st.counters["recall@10"] = r / 640.0;
  st.SetLabel(int8 ? "int8+rerank128" : "fp32");
}
BENCHMARK(BM_Ivf)->Name("Dense/ivf256_100k")->ArgNames({"nprobe", "int8"})
    ->ArgsProduct({{4, 16, 32}, {0, 1}})->Unit(benchmark::kMicrosecond);

// Batched scans: B queries share one pass over 100k rows. Reports queries/s.
static void BM_FlatBatch(benchmark::State& st) {
  constexpr std::uint32_t n = 100'000;
  const auto nb = static_cast<std::size_t>(st.range(0));
  const bool int8 = st.range(1) != 0;
  auto& s = store(n);
  const auto& q = queries(n);
  alignas(64) std::array<float, 8 * kD> qs{};
  std::array<std::array<std::int8_t, kD>, 8> qq;
  std::array<const std::int8_t*, 8> qqp;
  std::copy_n(q.begin(), nb * kD, qs.begin());
  for (std::size_t j = 0; j < nb; ++j) { simd::quantize_i8(qs.data() + j * kD, qq[j].data(), kD); qqp[j] = qq[j].data(); }
  std::array<TopK<10>, 8> tk;
  std::array<TopK<128>, 8> cand;
  std::array<TopK<10>*, 8> outs;
  std::array<TopK<128>*, 8> couts;
  for (auto _ : st) {
    for (std::size_t j = 0; j < nb; ++j) { tk[j].reset(10); cand[j].reset(128); outs[j] = &tk[j]; couts[j] = &cand[j]; }
    if (int8) {
      s.search_int8_batch(qqp.data(), nb, 0, n, couts.data());
      for (std::size_t j = 0; j < nb; ++j)
        for (const Hit& h : cand[j].sorted()) tk[j].push(simd::dot(qs.data() + j * kD, s.row(h.id), kD), h.id);
    } else {
      s.search_exact_batch(qs.data(), nb, 0, n, outs.data());
    }
    benchmark::DoNotOptimize(tk[0].threshold());
  }
  st.SetItemsProcessed(st.iterations() * std::int64_t(nb));  // items = queries
  st.SetLabel(int8 ? "int8+rerank128" : "fp32");
}
BENCHMARK(BM_FlatBatch)->Name("Dense/flat_batch_100k")->ArgNames({"batch", "int8"})
    ->ArgsProduct({{1, 2, 4, 8}, {0, 1}})->Unit(benchmark::kMicrosecond);

// ------------------------------- agent ---------------------------------------
#include "rag/agent/execution_dp.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/model_based.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/trainer.hpp"

namespace {
rag::agent::Agent<rag::agent::ExecutionEnv>& trained_agent(rag::agent::LearnerKind kind) {
  using namespace rag::agent;
  static std::unique_ptr<Agent<ExecutionEnv>> a[2];
  auto& slot = a[static_cast<int>(kind)];
  if (!slot) {
    ExecutionEnv env{ExecutionParams{}};
    AgentConfig<3> c;
    c.learner = kind;
    c.eps_decay_episodes = 2000;
    slot = std::make_unique<Agent<ExecutionEnv>>(env, c);
    Trainer<ExecutionEnv> t(*slot, env, {.eval_every = 0, .detect_drift = false});
    t.run(kind == LearnerKind::TileQ ? 4000 : 1500);  // the episodic memory fills to capacity
  }
  return *slot;
}
}  // namespace

static void BM_AgentAct(benchmark::State& st) {
  using namespace rag::agent;
  auto& agent = trained_agent(static_cast<LearnerKind>(st.range(0)));
  Rng r(1);
  std::vector<ExecutionObs> obs(256);
  for (auto& o : obs) o = {r.below(20), r.below(101), 0.1 * r.normal()};
  std::size_t i = 0;
  for (auto _ : st) benchmark::DoNotOptimize(agent.act(obs[i++ & 255], /*explore=*/false));
  st.SetLabel(st.range(0) == 0 ? "tile-coded Q (8 tilings x 5 actions)"
                               : "episodic k-NN over " + std::to_string(agent.memory().size()) + " x 64-d memories");
}
BENCHMARK(BM_AgentAct)->Name("Agent/act_greedy")->Arg(0)->Arg(1);

static void BM_AgentLearnStep(benchmark::State& st) {
  using namespace rag::agent;
  ExecutionEnv env{ExecutionParams{}};
  Agent<ExecutionEnv> agent(env, AgentConfig<3>{});
  Rng rng(3);
  auto o = env.reset(rng);
  for (auto _ : st) {  // one real step: act, step the world, TD update + 4 replayed updates
    const Action a = agent.act(o, true);
    const auto s = env.step(a, rng);
    agent.observe(o, a, s.reward, s.obs, s.done);
    o = s.done ? (agent.end_episode(), env.reset(rng)) : s.obs;
  }
}

  std::vector<ExecutionObs> obs(256);
  for (auto& o : obs) o = {r.below(20), r.below(101), 0.1 * r.normal()};
  std::size_t i = 0;
  for (auto _ : st) benchmark::DoNotOptimize(dp.act(obs[i++ & 255]));
}
BENCHMARK(BM_ExecutionDPAct)->Name("Agent/dp_act");

// The model-based agent's model check: exact policy evaluation of its plan
// and TWAP, plus 100 paired real episodes.
static void BM_ModelCheck(benchmark::State& st) {
  using namespace rag::agent;
  ExecutionEnv env{ExecutionParams{}};
  ModelBasedExecutionAgent mb(ExecutionParams{}, {.cost_model = CostModel::Shrunk, .seed = 1});
  Rng rng(42);
  train_model_based(mb, env, 50, rng);
  mb.replan();
  for (auto _ : st) benchmark::DoNotOptimize(mb.check_model(env, 100, 6'000'000).z);
}
BENCHMARK(BM_ModelCheck)->Name("Agent/check_model_100_episodes")->Unit(benchmark::kMillisecond);

BENCHMARK_MAIN();
```

```cpp
// Lazily-built, process-wide benchmark fixtures (built once, reused by every run).
#pragma once
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "rag.hpp"
#include "../tests/synthetic.hpp"

namespace rag::bench {

inline constexpr std::size_t kD = 384;
using Engine = RagEngine<HashingEmbedder<kD>>;

inline VectorStore<kD>& store(std::uint32_t n) {
  static std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::unique_ptr<VectorStore<kD>>>> cache;
  for (auto& [k, s] : cache) if (k == n) return *s;
  auto s = std::make_unique<VectorStore<kD>>(n);
  synth::fill_clustered(*s, n, std::max(16u, n / 200), 0.6f);
  cache.emplace_back(n, std::move(s));
  return *cache.back().second;
}

inline const std::vector<float>& queries(std::uint32_t n_store) {
  static std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::vector<float>>> cache;
  for (auto& [k, q] : cache) if (k == n_store) return q;
  cache.emplace_back(n_store, synth::random_queries<kD>(256, 99, store(n_store), 0.4f));
  return cache.back().second;
}

inline const synth::TextCorpus& corpus() {
  static const auto c = synth::make_text_corpus(20000, 200, 256);
  return c;
}

inline std::vector<std::string> text_queries(std::size_t n) {
  std::mt19937 rng(5);
  const auto& c = corpus();
  std::vector<std::string> q;
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    const auto& w = c.topic_words[rng() % c.topic_words.size()];
    q.push_back("what about " + w[rng() % 40] + " and " + w[rng() % 40] + " with " + w[rng() % 40]);
  }
  return q;
}

inline const char* mode_name(DenseMode m) {
  switch (m) {
    case DenseMode::Exact: return "exact";
    case DenseMode::Int8Rerank: return "int8+rerank";
    case DenseMode::Ivf: return "ivf";
    default: return "ivf-sq8";
  }
}

inline Engine& engine(DenseMode mode) {
  static std::unique_ptr<Engine> e[4];
  auto& slot = e[static_cast<int>(mode)];
  if (!slot) {
    EngineConfig cfg;
    cfg.max_chunks = 1u << 17;
    cfg.chunker = {128, 32};
    cfg.dense_mode = mode;
    cfg.nprobe = 16;
    slot = std::make_unique<Engine>(cfg);
    const auto& c = corpus();
    for (std::uint32_t d = 0; d < c.docs.size(); ++d) slot->ingest(c.docs[d], d);
    slot->commit();
  }
  return *slot;
}

}  // namespace rag::bench
```
