// mlp_tests.cpp — the from-scratch neural network (E16): backpropagation
// against finite differences, Adam on a regression, determinism.
#include <gtest/gtest.h>

#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/agent/mlp.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/trainer.hpp"

using namespace rag::agent;

TEST(Mlp, GradientMatchesFiniteDifferences) {
  Rng rng(3);
  Mlp net({3, 7, 5, 4}, rng);
  std::vector<double> scratch(net.scratch_size());
  std::array<double, 4> out{};
  const std::array<double, 3> x = {0.3, -0.7, 1.1};
  for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
    Mlp n = net;
    const double target = 0.4 - 0.2 * k;
    n.accumulate(x.data(), k, target);
    const std::vector<double> g = n.gradient();
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n.parameters(); ++i) {
      const double w0 = n.weights()[i], h = 1e-6;
      n.weights()[i] = w0 + h;
      n.forward(x.data(), out.data(), scratch.data());
      const double lp = 0.5 * (out[k] - target) * (out[k] - target);
      n.weights()[i] = w0 - h;
      n.forward(x.data(), out.data(), scratch.data());
      const double lm = 0.5 * (out[k] - target) * (out[k] - target);
      n.weights()[i] = w0;
      ASSERT_NEAR((lp - lm) / (2 * h), g[i], 1e-7) << "output " << k << " parameter " << i;
    }
  }
}

TEST(Mlp, AdamFitsASmoothFunctionAndIsDeterministic) {
  // Measured: MSE 0.0004 after 20,000 steps of 32 samples; here 4,000 steps.
  auto fn = [](const std::array<double, 3>& v) { return std::sin(3 * v[0]) + v[1] * v[1] - v[2]; };
  auto train = [&](std::uint64_t seed) {
    Rng init(seed), data(seed + 1);
    Mlp f({3, 32, 32, 1}, init);
    for (int it = 0; it < 4000; ++it) {
      for (int b = 0; b < 32; ++b) {
        const std::array<double, 3> v = {2 * data.uniform() - 1, 2 * data.uniform() - 1, 2 * data.uniform() - 1};
        f.accumulate(v.data(), 0, fn(v));
      }
      f.step(1e-3);
    }
    return f;
  };
  const Mlp f = train(5);
  Rng test(99);
  std::vector<double> scratch(f.scratch_size());
  double mse = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < 2000; ++i) {
    const std::array<double, 3> v = {2 * test.uniform() - 1, 2 * test.uniform() - 1, 2 * test.uniform() - 1};
    std::array<double, 1> o{};
    f.forward(v.data(), o.data(), scratch.data());
    mse += (o[0] - fn(v)) * (o[0] - fn(v)) / 2000;
  }
  EXPECT_LT(mse, 0.02);
  EXPECT_EQ(train(5).weights(), f.weights());  // bit-identical rerun
}

TEST(Mlp, BlendTowardMovesWeightsLinearly) {
  Rng r1(1), r2(2);
  const Mlp a({3, 5, 2}, r1), b({3, 5, 2}, r2);
  const std::array<double, 3> x = {0.4, -0.2, 0.9};
  std::vector<double> scratch(a.scratch_size());
  auto out = [&](const Mlp& m) {
    std::array<double, 2> o{};
    m.forward(x.data(), o.data(), scratch.data());
    return o;
  };
  Mlp m = a;
  m.blend_toward(b, 0.0);
  EXPECT_EQ(out(m), out(a));
  m.blend_toward(b, 1.0);
  EXPECT_EQ(out(m), out(b));
  ASSERT_THROW((void)Agent<ExecutionEnv>(*std::make_unique<ExecutionEnv>(ExecutionParams{}),
                                         AgentConfig<3>{.learner = LearnerKind::NeuralQ, .nn_polyak = 1.5}),
               std::invalid_argument);
}

namespace {
// Train a small NeuralQ with a given averaging rate; return it.
std::unique_ptr<Agent<ExecutionEnv>> small_neural(ExecutionEnv& env, double polyak) {
  AgentConfig<3> c;
  c.learner = LearnerKind::NeuralQ;
  c.nn_hidden = 16;
  c.nn_warmup = 200;
  c.eps_decay_episodes = 200;
  c.nn_polyak = polyak;
  c.seed = 9;
  auto agent = std::make_unique<Agent<ExecutionEnv>>(env, c);
  Trainer<ExecutionEnv> tr(*agent, env, {.eval_every = 0, .train_seed = 9, .detect_drift = false});
  tr.run(300);
  return agent;
}
}  // namespace

TEST(NeuralQ, WeightAveragingLeavesTrainingUnchangedAndOnlyAffectsGreedyActing) {
  ExecutionEnv e0{ExecutionParams{}}, e1{ExecutionParams{}}, e2{ExecutionParams{}};
  auto plain = small_neural(e0, 0.0), full = small_neural(e1, 1.0), avg = small_neural(e2, 0.01);
  Rng r(4);
  int differ = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < 200; ++i) {
    const ExecutionObs o{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(r.below(20)), static_cast<std::uint32_t>(r.below(101)), 0.1 * r.normal()};
    std::array<double, 5> q0{}, q2{};
    plain->q_values(o, q0.data());
    avg->q_values(o, q2.data());
    EXPECT_EQ(q0, q2) << "averaging must not change the online network's training";
    // nn_polyak = 1: the average is the online network after every update.
    EXPECT_EQ(full->act(o, false), plain->act(o, false));
    EXPECT_EQ(full->act_as(full->snapshot(), o), plain->act(o, false));
    // The deployed policy (snapshot) is the averaged one.
    EXPECT_EQ(avg->act_as(avg->snapshot(), o), avg->act(o, false));
    differ += avg->act(o, false) != plain->act(o, false);
  }
  EXPECT_GT(differ, 0) << "a slow average should act differently from the online network somewhere";
}

TEST(Mlp, SaveLoadRoundTripAndRejectsCorruptFiles) {
  Rng rng(12);
  const Mlp net({4, 9, 3}, rng);
  const auto path = std::filesystem::path(::testing::TempDir()) / "mlp_roundtrip.net";
  net.save(path);
  const Mlp back = Mlp::load(path);
  EXPECT_EQ(back.parameters(), net.parameters());
  std::vector<double> s1(net.scratch_size()), s2(back.scratch_size());
  std::array<double, 3> a{}, b{};
  const std::array<double, 4> x = {0.1, -1.2, 0.7, 2.0};
  net.forward(x.data(), a.data(), s1.data());
  back.forward(x.data(), b.data(), s2.data());
  EXPECT_EQ(a, b);
  std::vector<char> bytes;
  {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    bytes.assign(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f), {});
  }
  bytes[bytes.size() / 2] ^= 0x40;
  {
    std::ofstream f(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    f.write(bytes.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
  }
  EXPECT_THROW((void)Mlp::load(path), rag::io::FormatError);
  std::filesystem::remove(path);
}

// model_based_tests.cpp — Experiment E1 (docs/ai/EXPERIMENTS.md): a
// model-based agent that learns the market's parameters and plans with the
// DP, under correct and incorrect model assumptions.
#include <gtest/gtest.h>

#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/agent/model_based.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/ope.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/trainer.hpp"

using namespace rag::agent;

namespace {

auto twap = [](const ExecutionObs&) { return ExecutionEnv::kTwapAction; };

// Share of the optimal gain over TWAP, both measured on the same scenarios.
template <class Policy>
double share(const ExecutionParams& p, Policy&& pi, std::uint32_t n = 1000) {
  ExecutionEnv env(p);
  const ExecutionDP dp(p);
  const double opt = compare(env, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return dp.act(o); }, twap, n, 31'000'000).mean;
  return compare(env, pi, twap, n, 31'000'000).mean / opt;
}

ModelBasedExecutionAgent trained(const ExecutionParams& market, std::uint32_t episodes, CostModel cm,
                                 std::uint64_t seed = 1) {
  ModelBasedExecutionAgent a(market, {.explore_episodes = std::min(10u, episodes), .cost_model = cm, .seed = seed});
  ExecutionEnv env(market);
  Rng rng(seed * 77);
  train_model_based(a, env, episodes, rng);
  a.replan();
  return a;
}

// The "hard" market: impact grows like q^3 and every order pays a fixed cost.
ExecutionParams hard_market() {
  ExecutionParams p;
  p.impact_exponent = 3.0;
  p.impact = 0.01 * 25 / 125.0;  // same cost as the default at the TWAP rate (5 lots)
  p.fixed_cost = 1.5;
  return p;
}

}  // namespace

TEST(ExecutionCosts, GeneralizedCostsKeepTheAccountingIdentity) {
  for (const ExecutionParams& p : {ExecutionParams{}, hard_market()}) {
    ExecutionEnv probe(p);
    EXPECT_EQ(probe.trade_cost(0), 0.0);  // no order, no cost (fixed cost included)
    EXPECT_EQ(probe.dump_cost(0), 0.0);
    Rng pol(4);
    for (int ep = 0; ep < 200; ++ep) {
      ExecutionEnv env(p);
      Rng rng(ep);
      auto o = env.reset(rng);
      double total = 0;
      for (;;) {
        const auto st = env.step(pol.below(5), rng);
        total += st.reward;
        o = st.obs;
        if (st.done) break;
      }
      EXPECT_NEAR(total, env.cash() - p.lots * p.start_price, 1e-9);
    }
  }
  ExecutionEnv hard(hard_market());
  EXPECT_NEAR(hard.trade_cost(10), 0.002 * 1000 + 1.5, 1e-12);
}

TEST(ExecutionCosts, DpWithCostTablesEqualsDpWithFormulas) {
  const ExecutionParams p = hard_market();
  const ExecutionEnv env(p);
  std::vector<double> trade(p.lots + 1), dump(p.lots + 1);
  for (std::uint32_t q = 0; q <= p.lots; ++q) {
    trade[q] = env.trade_cost(q);
    dump[q] = env.dump_cost(q);
  }
  const ExecutionDP a(p, 61), b(p, trade, dump, 61);
  for (std::uint32_t t : {0u, 9u, 19u})
    for (std::uint32_t inv : {7u, 50u, 100u}) EXPECT_EQ(a.value(t, inv, 0.03), b.value(t, inv, 0.03));
  EXPECT_THROW(ExecutionDP(p, std::vector<double>(3), dump), std::invalid_argument);
}

TEST(ModelBased, RecoversTheMarketParameters) {
  const ExecutionParams p;
  const auto a = trained(p, 300, CostModel::Quadratic);
  const auto m = a.model();
  EXPECT_NEAR(m.impact, p.impact, 0.03 * p.impact);
  EXPECT_NEAR(m.terminal_impact, p.terminal_impact, 0.05 * p.terminal_impact);
  EXPECT_NEAR(m.alpha, p.alpha, 0.1);
  EXPECT_NEAR(m.rho, p.signal_rho, 0.06);
  EXPECT_NEAR(m.signal_sd, p.signal_sd, 0.012);
}

TEST(ModelBased, NearOptimalAfterFiftyEpisodes) {
  // Measured: 97-100% after 20-50 episodes across seeds; the model-free
  // TileQ learner needs 40,000 episodes for 62-71%.
  for (std::uint64_t seed : {1u, 2u, 3u}) {
    auto a = trained(ExecutionParams{}, 50, CostModel::Quadratic, seed);
    EXPECT_GT(share(ExecutionParams{}, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return a.act(o, false); }), 0.95) << "seed " << seed;
  }
}

TEST(ModelBased, HiddenMarketParametersDoNotLeakIntoThePlan) {
  // The agent receives `structure` only for lots, horizon and action sizes.
  // Regression test for a bug: replan() once kept the structure's
  // impact_exponent and fixed_cost, planning with true information mixed
  // with a coefficient fitted under the quadratic assumption. Later the same
  // bug class nearly recurred with permanent_impact (E7), so every market
  // field the planner reads is scrambled here.
  const ExecutionParams market = hard_market();
  ExecutionParams garbage = market;
  garbage.impact = 123;
  garbage.terminal_impact = 9;
  garbage.alpha = -7;
  garbage.signal_rho = 0.1;
  garbage.signal_sd = 3;
  garbage.impact_exponent = 1.1;
  garbage.fixed_cost = 99;
  garbage.permanent_impact = 0.5;
  garbage.risk_aversion = 3;
  garbage.noise_sd = 2;
  ExecutionParams clean = market;
  clean.impact_exponent = 2.0;
  clean.fixed_cost = 0.0;
  for (CostModel cm : {CostModel::Quadratic, CostModel::Shrunk}) {
    ModelBasedExecutionAgent a(garbage, {.cost_model = cm}), b(clean, {.cost_model = cm});
    ExecutionEnv env(market);  // identical experience for both
    Rng rng(5);
    for (int ep = 0; ep < 40; ++ep) {
      auto o = env.reset(rng);
      for (;;) {
        const Action act = static_cast<Action>((ep * 7 + o.t) % 5);  // a fixed behaviour policy
        a.note_action(o, act);
        b.note_action(o, act);
        const auto st = env.step(act, rng);
        a.observe(o, act, st.reward, st.obs, st.done);
        b.observe(o, act, st.reward, st.obs, st.done);
        o = st.obs;
        if (st.done) break;
      }
      a.end_episode();
      b.end_episode();
    }
    a.replan();
    b.replan();
    Rng probe(9);
    for (int i = 0; i < 300; ++i) {
      const ExecutionObs o{probe.below(20), probe.below(101), 0.3 * (probe.uniform() - 0.5)};
      ASSERT_EQ(a.act(o, false), b.act(o, false));
    }
  }
}

TEST(ModelBased, WrongModelFormIsCostlyAndAFlexibleModelFixesIt) {
  // Hard market (impact ~ q^3 plus a fixed cost per order), 300 episodes.
  // Measured: quadratic 55%, per-size 100%, shrunk 99%; model-free TileQ 63%
  // after 40,000 episodes.
  const ExecutionParams p = hard_market();
  auto quad = trained(p, 300, CostModel::Quadratic);
  auto per = trained(p, 300, CostModel::PerSize);
  auto shr = trained(p, 300, CostModel::Shrunk);
  const double q = share(p, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return quad.act(o, false); });
  const double s1 = share(p, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return per.act(o, false); });
  const double s2 = share(p, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return shr.act(o, false); });
  EXPECT_LT(q, 0.75) << "quadratic " << q;
  EXPECT_GT(s1, 0.95) << "per-size " << s1;
  EXPECT_GT(s2, 0.93) << "shrunk " << s2;
}

TEST(ModelBased, FlexibleModelsNeedDataAndShrinkageMakesThemSafe) {
  // Measured at 10 episodes in the hard market, seeds 1-10: per-size is
  // bimodal, 97-99% or a catastrophe (-1440% to -1809%, 4 of 10 seeds), as
  // the planner exploits wild estimates for rarely traded sizes. Shrunk:
  // 82-89% on every seed.
  const ExecutionParams p = hard_market();
  int per_failures = 0;
  double shrunk_worst = 1e9;
  for (std::uint64_t seed = 1; seed <= 10; ++seed) {
    auto per = trained(p, 10, CostModel::PerSize, seed);
    auto shr = trained(p, 10, CostModel::Shrunk, seed);
    per_failures += share(p, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return per.act(o, false); }) < 0.0;
    shrunk_worst = std::min(shrunk_worst, share(p, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return shr.act(o, false); }));
  }
  EXPECT_GE(per_failures, 2) << "per-size was expected to fail on some seeds with this little data";
  EXPECT_GT(shrunk_worst, 0.75) << "shrinkage should never be catastrophic";
}

// ================= Experiment E4 (risk-averse execution) =====================
TEST(ModelBased, LearnsTheRiskPenalty) {
  // Measured: fitted holding cost 0.00049 for a true 0.0005 (lambda 0.2), and
  // 100% of the risk-adjusted optimal gain after 300 episodes.
  ExecutionParams p;
  p.risk_aversion = 0.2;
  auto a = trained(p, 300, CostModel::Quadratic);
  const double truth = p.risk_aversion * p.noise_sd * p.noise_sd;
  EXPECT_NEAR(a.model().holding, truth, 0.2 * truth);
  EXPECT_GT(share(p, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return a.act(o, false); }), 0.97);
  // In a risk-neutral market the fitted holding cost is ~0, and the plan is unaffected.
  // (Tolerance: learning the permanent-impact term too, E7, widens this seed's
  // error from 2% to 15%: front-loading plans make q*I' and I'^2 correlated.
  // The share is unaffected: at most 0.3 points across seeds.)
  auto n = trained(ExecutionParams{}, 300, CostModel::Quadratic);
  EXPECT_NEAR(n.model().holding, 0.0, 2e-5);
}

TEST(AgentRisk, FrontLoadsMoreWhenRiskAverse) {
  // Lots sold in the first 5 steps, averaged over scenarios. Measured for the
  // DP optimum: 26.5 at lambda 0, 72.9 at lambda 1.
  auto early = [](const ExecutionParams& p, auto&& policy) {
    double sold = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 400; ++i) {
      ExecutionEnv env(p);
      Rng rng(800 + i);
      auto o = env.reset(rng);
      while (o.t < 5) {
        const auto inv = o.inventory;
        const auto st = env.step(policy(o), rng);
        sold += inv - st.obs.inventory;
        o = st.obs;
        if (st.done) break;
      }
    }
    return sold / 400;
  };
  ExecutionParams neutral, averse;
  averse.risk_aversion = 1.0;
  const ExecutionDP dpn(neutral), dpa(averse);
  const double dp_n = early(neutral, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return dpn.act(o); });
  const double dp_a = early(averse, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return dpa.act(o); });
  EXPECT_GT(dp_a, dp_n + 30) << "DP: neutral " << dp_n << ", averse " << dp_a;
  // A model-free learner, told nothing but the (risk-adjusted) rewards, follows.
  auto learn = [&](const ExecutionParams& p) {
    ExecutionEnv env(p);
    AgentConfig<3> cfg;
    cfg.learner = LearnerKind::ActorCritic;
    auto agent = std::make_unique<Agent<ExecutionEnv>>(env, cfg);
    Trainer<ExecutionEnv> tr(*agent, env, {.eval_every = 0, .detect_drift = false});
    tr.run(8000);
    return early(p, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return agent->act(o, false); });
  };
  const double rl_n = learn(neutral), rl_a = learn(averse);
  EXPECT_GT(rl_a, rl_n + 20) << "learned: neutral " << rl_n << ", averse " << rl_a;
}

// ============ Experiment E7 (outside the model class: permanent impact) ======
TEST(ExecutionCosts, PermanentImpactKeepsTheAccountingIdentityAndTheDpIsExact) {
  ExecutionParams p;
  p.permanent_impact = 0.01;
  p.risk_aversion = 0.2;
  {  // Rewards (without the risk penalty) add up to the cash shortfall.
    ExecutionParams q = p;
    q.risk_aversion = 0;
    ExecutionEnv env(q);
    Rng rng(3);
    for (int e = 0; e < 100; ++e) {
      env.reset(rng);
      double sum = 0;
      for (;;) {
        const auto st = env.step(rng.below(5), rng);
        sum += st.reward;
        if (st.done) break;
      }
      ASSERT_NEAR(sum, env.cash() - q.lots * q.start_price, 1e-9);
    }
  }
  const ExecutionDP dp(p);
  ExecutionEnv env(p);
  // Exact policy evaluation of the optimal policy reproduces its value...
  EXPECT_NEAR(dp.policy_value([&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return dp.act(o); }), dp.expected_start_value(), 1e-9);
  // ...and of TWAP, a closed form: costs, permanent impact and risk penalty of the fixed schedule.
  double twap_value = 0;
  std::uint32_t inv = p.lots;
  for (std::uint32_t t = 0; t < p.horizon; ++t) {
    const std::uint32_t q = env.lots_for(ExecutionEnv::kTwapAction, inv);
    inv -= q;
    twap_value -= env.trade_cost(q) + p.permanent_impact * q * inv;
    if (t + 1 < p.horizon) twap_value -= env.holding_penalty(inv);
  }
  twap_value -= env.dump_cost(inv);
  EXPECT_NEAR(dp.policy_value(twap), twap_value, 1e-9);
  // Simulation agrees with both (paired, so tight).
  const auto gain = compare(env, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return dp.act(o); }, twap, 4000, 1);
  EXPECT_NEAR(gain.mean, dp.expected_start_value() - twap_value, 4 * gain.std_error);
}

namespace {
ModelBasedExecutionAgent fitted(const ExecutionParams& market, std::uint32_t episodes, bool permanent, std::uint64_t seed = 1) {
  ModelBasedExecutionAgent a(market, {.cost_model = CostModel::Shrunk, .learn_permanent_impact = permanent, .seed = seed});
  ExecutionEnv env(market);
  Rng rng(42 + seed);
  train_model_based(a, env, episodes, rng);
  a.replan();
  return a;
}
}  // namespace

TEST(ModelBased, LearnsPermanentImpactAndAWrongModelGetsWorseWithData) {
  // Measured (5 seeds): without the term, 43% at 20 episodes, 37% at 50, 25%
  // at 300 (the plan exploits the model's error, so its data grows more
  // one-sided). With it: 93% at 20, 99.8% at 50, 99.9% at 300.
  ExecutionParams p;
  p.permanent_impact = 0.01;
  auto pol = [](ModelBasedExecutionAgent& a) { return [&a](const ExecutionObs& o) { return a.act(o, false); }; };
  auto with = fitted(p, 300, true);
  EXPECT_NEAR(with.model().permanent, 0.01, 0.0005);
  EXPECT_GT(share(p, pol(with)), 0.97);
  auto few = fitted(p, 20, false), many = fitted(p, 300, false);
  const double s_few = share(p, pol(few)), s_many = share(p, pol(many));
  EXPECT_LT(s_many, 0.5);
  EXPECT_LT(s_many, s_few - 0.05) << "more data should make the misspecified model worse: " << s_few << " -> " << s_many;
  // Where there is no permanent impact, learning the term costs nothing.
  auto plain = fitted(ExecutionParams{}, 300, true);
  EXPECT_NEAR(plain.model().permanent, 0.0, 0.0005);
  EXPECT_GT(share(ExecutionParams{}, pol(plain)), 0.99);
}

TEST(ModelBased, CheckModelFlagsAMissingTerm) {
  // Paired check of predicted vs realized gain over TWAP, 100 real episodes.
  // Measured over 8 seeds: z in [-2.5, 2.2] for a correct model; 8.5-12.9
  // with the permanent term missing (gamma 0.005), 20-27 at gamma 0.01.
  ExecutionParams p;
  p.permanent_impact = 0.005;
  const ExecutionEnv market(p);
  for (std::uint64_t seed = 1; seed <= 3; ++seed) {
    const auto right = fitted(p, 300, true, seed).check_model(market, 100, 6'000'000 + 1000 * seed);
    const auto wrong = fitted(p, 300, false, seed).check_model(market, 100, 6'000'000 + 1000 * seed);
    EXPECT_LT(right.z, 4.0) << "seed " << seed;
    EXPECT_GT(wrong.z, 4.0) << "seed " << seed;
    EXPECT_GT(wrong.predicted_gain, wrong.realized_gain);  // a wrong model is optimistic about its plan
  }
}

// ======== Experiment E9 (a changing market: forgetting vs detection) =========
namespace {
// Run n episodes of the model-based agent on env, learning online.
void online(ModelBasedExecutionAgent& a, ExecutionEnv& env, Rng& rng, int n) {
  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    auto o = env.reset(rng);
    for (;;) {
      const Action act = a.act(o, true);
      a.note_action(o, act);
      const auto st = env.step(act, rng);
      a.observe(o, act, st.reward, st.obs, st.done);
      o = st.obs;
      if (st.done) break;
    }
    a.end_episode();
  }
}
}  // namespace

TEST(ModelBased, DetectsAMarketFlipAndRecoversWithinThirtyEpisodes) {
  // Measured (replanning every 5 episodes, seeds 1-3): alarms 7-13 episodes
  // after the signal's meaning flips, 95-100% of the new optimum at +20.
  // Without forgetting the estimates average both regimes: -166% at +20,
  // still -123% at +100. Here replanning is every 10 episodes on a coarser
  // grid (test speed).
  ExecutionParams flipped;
  flipped.alpha = -1.0;
  for (bool detect : {true, false}) {
    ModelBasedExecutionAgent a(ExecutionParams{}, {.replan_every = 10,
                                                   .replan_max_gap = 10,
                                                   .dp_grid = 31,  // coarser planner: 4x faster replans for the test
                                                   .cost_model = CostModel::Shrunk,
                                                   .detect_drift = detect,
                                                   .seed = 1});
    ExecutionEnv env{ExecutionParams{}};
    Rng rng(101);
    online(a, env, rng, 300);
    EXPECT_TRUE(a.drift_alarms().empty()) << "false alarm in a stable market";
    env.set_alpha(-1.0);
    online(a, env, rng, 30);
    const double s = share(flipped, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return a.act(o, false); }, 600);
    if (detect) {
      ASSERT_EQ(a.drift_alarms().size(), 1u);
      EXPECT_GT(a.drift_alarms()[0], 300u);
      EXPECT_LE(a.drift_alarms()[0], 320u);
      EXPECT_GT(s, 0.9);
    } else {
      EXPECT_LT(s, 0.0) << "without forgetting the old regime dominates the estimates";
    }
  }
}

TEST(ModelBased, ChangeDetectionIsFreeInAStableMarketButConstantForgettingIsNot) {
  // Measured over 3,000 episodes, noise 0.2: detection gave 0-1 false
  // alarms and 99.9-100.3% of optimal (seeds 1-3); constant forgetting 0.95
  // (half-life ~14 episodes) gave 66-98% (seeds 1-6, mean ~89%), because it
  // plans on ~20 episodes' worth of data. The mechanism, checked cheaply
  // (no replanning): with forgetting, the estimates stay as noisy as after
  // ~20 episodes, however long the agent runs.
  ExecutionParams noisy;
  noisy.noise_sd = 0.2;
  ModelBasedExecutionAgent detect(noisy, {.cost_model = CostModel::Shrunk, .detect_drift = true, .seed = 1});
  ExecutionEnv e1(noisy);
  Rng r1(301);
  online(detect, e1, r1, 1000);
  EXPECT_LE(detect.drift_alarms().size(), 1u);
  EXPECT_GT(share(noisy, [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return detect.act(o, false); }), 0.97);
  double err_forget = 0, err_full = 0;
  for (std::uint64_t seed = 1; seed <= 4; ++seed) {
    for (double f : {0.95, 1.0}) {
      ModelBasedExecutionAgent a(noisy, {.replan_every = 100000, .forget = f, .seed = seed});
      ExecutionEnv e(noisy);
      Rng r(400 + seed);
      online(a, e, r, 300);
      const double d = a.current_estimate().alpha - noisy.alpha;
      (f < 1 ? err_forget : err_full) += d * d;
    }
  }
  EXPECT_GT(err_forget, 4 * err_full) << err_forget << " vs " << err_full;
}

// ============== Experiment E10 (off-policy evaluation) ======================
namespace {
struct OpeRun {
  double dm, wpdis, dr;  // estimates of the target's value
  OpeEstimates is;
};
// Log n episodes of TWAP with 20% uniformly random actions, fit a model on
// them (passively), and estimate `target`'s value from the logs alone.
template <class Target>
OpeRun estimate_offline(const ExecutionParams& market, bool permanent_term, unsigned n, std::uint64_t seed, Target&& target) {
  constexpr double eps = 0.2;
  ExecutionEnv env(market);
  Rng rng(1000 + seed), pick(5 + seed);
  ModelBasedExecutionAgent mb(market, {.replan_every = 1'000'000, .cost_model = CostModel::Shrunk,
                                       .learn_permanent_impact = permanent_term, .seed = 1});
  std::vector<LoggedEpisode<ExecutionObs>> logs(n);
  for (auto& ep : logs) {
    auto o = env.reset(rng);
    for (;;) {
      const Action a = pick.uniform() < eps ? static_cast<Action>(pick.below(5)) : ExecutionEnv::kTwapAction;
      mb.note_action(o, a);
      const auto st = env.step(a, rng);
      mb.observe(o, a, st.reward, st.obs, st.done);
      ep.push_back({o, a, st.reward, (a == ExecutionEnv::kTwapAction ? 1 - eps : 0.0) + eps / 5});
      o = st.obs;
      if (st.done) break;
    }
    mb.end_episode();
  }
  mb.replan();
  const auto values = mb.plan()->evaluate_policy(target);
  const auto is = off_policy_estimates(
      logs, target, [&](const ExecutionObs& o, Action a) { return values.q(o.t, o.inventory, o.signal, a); },
      [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return values.value(o.t, o.inventory, o.signal); }, market.horizon);
  return {values.start_value(), is.wpdis, is.dr, is};
}
}  // namespace

TEST(OffPolicy, ImportanceSamplingCollapsesAtLongHorizonsAndTheModelDecides) {
  // Measured (20 replications, errors in % of the optimal gain): for the DP
  // optimum from 1,000 logged episodes, DM rmse 4% with the right model,
  // WPDIS 98%, DR 134%; ~17 of 20 steps had no logged episode following the
  // target. With the permanent term missing (gamma 0.01) DM's bias was -62%
  // at 1,000 episodes and still -62% at 10,000: more data doesn't fix a
  // wrong model.
  ExecutionParams p;
  const ExecutionDP truth(p);
  auto optimal = [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return truth.act(o); };
  const double gain = truth.expected_start_value() - truth.policy_value(twap);
  const double v_opt = truth.policy_value(optimal);
  for (std::uint64_t seed = 1; seed <= 2; ++seed) {
    const auto r = estimate_offline(p, true, 1000, seed, optimal);
    EXPECT_NEAR(r.dm, v_opt, 0.08 * gain) << "seed " << seed;
    EXPECT_GE(r.is.uncovered_steps, 10u);  // nobody followed the target for long
    EXPECT_LT(r.is.min_ess, 1.0);
  }
  ExecutionParams perm;
  perm.permanent_impact = 0.01;
  const ExecutionDP truth_perm(perm);
  auto optimal_perm = [&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return truth_perm.act(o); };
  const double gain_perm = truth_perm.expected_start_value() - truth_perm.policy_value(twap);
  const double v_perm = truth_perm.policy_value(optimal_perm);
  for (unsigned n : {1000u, 10000u}) {
    const auto r = estimate_offline(perm, false, n, 1, optimal_perm);
    EXPECT_LT((r.dm - v_perm) / gain_perm, -0.4) << n << " episodes";
  }
}

    }

// =================== Experiment E14 (tail risk) =============================
TEST(TailRisk, CvarArithmetic) {
  const std::vector<double> r = {5, 1, 3, 2, 4};
  EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(cvar(r, 0.4), 1.5);   // worst 2: 1 and 2
  EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(cvar(r, 0.01), 1.0);  // at least one outcome
  EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(cvar(r, 1.0), 3.0);   // everything: the mean
  EXPECT_EQ(cvar({}, 0.05), 0.0);
}

TEST(TailRisk, VarianceIsNotTailRiskInExecution) {
  // Measured on cash outcomes (20,000 scenarios): the risk-neutral optimum has
  // a higher sd than TWAP (57.4 vs 54.5) but a far better worst 5% (-66 vs
  // -117). A strong mean-variance penalty (lambda 1) halves the sd (27.5) yet
  // improves the worst 5% only to -61, while the mean falls from +10 to -8.
  const ExecutionParams p;
  const ExecutionEnv cash(p);
  auto stats = [&](auto&& pi) {
    const auto r = episode_returns(cash, pi, 4000, 7'000'000);
    const double n = static_cast<double>(r.size());
    double m = 0, v = 0;
    for (double x : r) m += x / n;
    for (double x : r) v += (x - m) * (x - m) / (n - 1);
    return std::array<double, 3>{m, std::sqrt(v), cvar(r, 0.05)};
  };
  ExecutionParams averse = p;
  averse.risk_aversion = 1.0;
  const ExecutionDP neutral_dp(p), averse_dp(averse);
  const auto tw = stats(twap);
  const auto neutral = stats([&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return neutral_dp.act(o); });
  const auto strong = stats([&](const ExecutionObs& o) { return averse_dp.act(o); });
  EXPECT_GT(neutral[1], tw[1]);           // more volatile than TWAP...
  EXPECT_GT(neutral[2], tw[2] + 30.0);    // ...with a much better tail
  EXPECT_LT(strong[1], 0.6 * neutral[1]); // the penalty cuts the sd...
  EXPECT_LT(strong[2] - neutral[2], 10.0);  // ...but barely moves the tail
  EXPECT_LT(strong[0], neutral[0] - 10.0);  // and costs a lot of mean
}

// optional_libs_tests.cpp — E18: the optional optimization (NLopt) and data
// analysis (Eigen) helpers. Built only when both libraries are found.
#include <gtest/gtest.h>

#include <cmath>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/agent/analysis.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/model_based.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/tuning.hpp"

using namespace rag::agent;

TEST(Tuning, MaximizesAKnownFunctionWithLogAndIntegerParameters) {
  // Peak at step = 0.01 (log scale), count = 7 (integer), weight = 0.3.
  const std::vector<tuning::Param> space = {
      {"step", 1e-4, 1.0, true, false}, {"count", 1, 20, false, true}, {"weight", 0.0, 1.0, false, false}};
  auto f = [](const std::vector<double>& v) {
    const double a = std::log10(v[0]) + 2, b = v[1] - 7, c = v[2] - 0.3;
    return -(a * a) - 0.1 * b * b - 4 * c * c;
  };
  const auto r = tuning::maximize(space, {0.5, 15, 0.9}, f, 300);
  ASSERT_EQ(r.best.size(), 3u);
  EXPECT_NEAR(std::log10(r.best[0]), -2.0, 0.1);
  EXPECT_EQ(r.best[1], 7.0);  // integer parameters arrive rounded
  EXPECT_NEAR(r.best[2], 0.3, 0.05);
  EXPECT_FALSE(r.history.empty());
  for (const auto& t : r.history) {
    EXPECT_EQ(t.values[1], std::round(t.values[1]));
    EXPECT_GE(t.values[0], 1e-4);
    EXPECT_LE(t.values[0], 1.0);
  }
}

TEST(Tuning, AGlobalStageEscapesTheLocalOptimumALocalSearchGetsStuckIn) {
  // Two peaks: 0.6 at x = -2 (where the search starts) and 1.0 at x = +2.
  const std::vector<tuning::Param> space = {{"x", -4.0, 4.0, false, false}};
  auto f = [](const std::vector<double>& v) {
    return std::exp(-(v[0] - 2) * (v[0] - 2)) + 0.6 * std::exp(-(v[0] + 2) * (v[0] + 2) / 0.5);
  };
  const auto local = tuning::maximize(space, {-2.0}, f, 60);
  const auto global = tuning::maximize_global(space, {-2.0}, f, 60, 30, 7);
  EXPECT_LT(local.best[0], 0.0) << "a local search from the lower peak should stay there";
  EXPECT_NEAR(global.best[0], 2.0, 0.05);
  EXPECT_GT(global.best_score, 0.99);
  EXPECT_GE(global.history.size(), 60u);  // NLopt may take one evaluation past maxeval per stage
  EXPECT_LE(global.history.size(), 92u);
  // Reproducible with the same seed.
  EXPECT_EQ(tuning::maximize_global(space, {-2.0}, f, 60, 30, 7).best, global.best);
}

TEST(Analysis, EigenAgreesWithTheModelBasedAgentsOwnSolver) {
  // The model-based agent solves its weighted normal equations with
  // hand-written Gaussian elimination. Rebuild the same regression from the
  // same transitions and solve it with Eigen's rank-revealing QR.
  ExecutionParams p;
  p.permanent_impact = 0.005;
  p.risk_aversion = 0.2;
  ModelBasedExecutionAgent mb(p, {.replan_every = 1'000'000, .cost_model = CostModel::Quadratic, .seed = 1});
  ExecutionEnv env(p);
  Rng rng(7), pick(8);
  std::vector<std::array<double, 4>> rows;
  std::vector<double> ys, ws;
  for (int ep = 0; ep < 200; ++ep) {
    auto o = env.reset(rng);
    for (;;) {
      const Action a = pick.below(5);
      mb.note_action(o, a);
      const auto st = env.step(a, rng);
      mb.observe(o, a, st.reward, st.obs, st.done);
      if (!(st.done && st.obs.t >= p.horizon)) {  // non-terminal steps feed the regression
        const double held = st.obs.inventory, q = static_cast<double>(o.inventory - st.obs.inventory);
        rows.push_back({held * o.signal, -held * held, -q * held, -q * q});  // alpha, holding, permanent, impact
        ys.push_back(st.reward);
        ws.push_back(1.0 / std::max(1.0, held * held));
      }
      o = st.obs;
      if (st.done) break;
    }
    mb.end_episode();
  }
  Eigen::MatrixXd X(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(rows.size()), 4);
  Eigen::VectorXd y(X.rows()), w(X.rows());
  for (Eigen::Index i = 0; i < X.rows(); ++i) {
    for (Eigen::Index j = 0; j < 4; ++j) X(i, j) = rows[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)][static_cast<std::size_t>(j)];
    y(i) = ys[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
    w(i) = ws[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
  }
  const Eigen::VectorXd b = analysis::least_squares(X, y, w);
  const ModelEstimate m = mb.current_estimate();
  EXPECT_NEAR(m.alpha, b(0), 1e-6 * (1 + std::abs(b(0))));
  EXPECT_NEAR(m.holding, b(1), 1e-6);
  EXPECT_NEAR(m.permanent, b(2), 1e-6);
  EXPECT_NEAR(m.impact, b(3), 1e-6);
  // And both are close to the truth.
  EXPECT_NEAR(b(0), p.alpha, 0.1);
  EXPECT_NEAR(b(2), p.permanent_impact, 0.002);
  EXPECT_NEAR(b(3), p.impact, 0.002);
}

TEST(Analysis, QuadraticSensitivityRecoversKnownEffects) {
  // score = 3 z0 - 2 z1^2 + 0 * z2 + small noise, on standardized inputs.
  Rng rng(3);
  std::vector<std::vector<double>> rows;
  std::vector<double> y;
  for (int i = 0; i < 400; ++i) {
    const double a = rng.normal(), b = rng.normal(), c = rng.normal();
    rows.push_back({10 + 2 * a, -5 + 0.5 * b, 100 + 30 * c});  // arbitrary units: the fit standardizes
    y.push_back(3 * a - 2 * b * b + 0.01 * rng.normal());
  }
  const auto s = analysis::quadratic_sensitivity(rows, y);
  EXPECT_NEAR(s.linear[0], 3.0, 0.15);
  EXPECT_NEAR(s.quadratic[1], -2.0, 0.15);
  EXPECT_NEAR(s.linear[2], 0.0, 0.1);
  EXPECT_NEAR(s.quadratic[2], 0.0, 0.1);
  EXPECT_GT(s.r2, 0.99);
}

// orderflow_tests.cpp — the ES order-flow simulator: book invariants,
// determinism, market orders, and the FIFO queue mechanics tick-scalping
// strategies depend on.
#include <gtest/gtest.h>

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/orderflow/simulator.hpp"

using namespace rag::orderflow;

TEST(EsSimulator, BookStaysConsistentAndPrintsAreAtTheTouch) {
  EsSimulator sim(SimParams{}, 7);
  std::size_t prints = 0;
  for (int s = 0; s < 20'000; ++s) {
    const std::int32_t bid0 = sim.bid(), ask0 = sim.ask();
    sim.step();
    ASSERT_GE(sim.spread(), 1);
    ASSERT_LT(sim.bid(), sim.ask());
    for (const auto& t : sim.trades()) {
      ++prints;
      ASSERT_GT(t.size, 0u);
      ASSERT_FALSE(t.own);
      // A buy prints at or above the ask it started from (sweeping moves it up),
      // a sell at or below the bid; never more than the simulated depth away.
      if (t.aggressor == Side::Buy) {
        ASSERT_GE(t.price, ask0 - static_cast<std::int32_t>(kLevels));
      } else {
        ASSERT_LE(t.price, bid0 + static_cast<std::int32_t>(kLevels));
      }
    }
    const Quote q = sim.quote();
    ASSERT_EQ(q.bid, sim.bid());
    ASSERT_EQ(q.ask, sim.ask());
  }
  EXPECT_GT(prints, 10'000u);  // ~2,000 s of trading
  EXPECT_LT(std::abs(sim.mid() - 20'000.0), 2'000.0);
}

    }

  };
  EXPECT_EQ(path(3), path(3));

}

TEST(EsSimulator, MarketOrderTakesTheBestPrices) {

  const std::int32_t ask = sim.ask();
  const std::uint32_t at_ask = sim.quote().ask_size[0];
  const Fill f = sim.market_order(Side::Buy, 3);
  EXPECT_EQ(f.filled, 3u);
  EXPECT_EQ(f.avg_price, ask);  // the best level has far more than 3 lots
  ASSERT_EQ(sim.trades().size(), 1u);
  EXPECT_TRUE(sim.trades()[0].own);

}

TEST(EsSimulator, LimitOrderFillsOnlyAfterTheQueueAheadTrades) {
  EsSimulator sim(SimParams{.join_ahead_mean = 0}, 1);  // no faster participants: we join right behind the visible queue
  const std::int32_t bid = sim.bid();
  const std::uint32_t queue = sim.quote().bid_size[0];
  const std::uint64_t id = sim.submit_limit(Side::Buy, bid, 2);
  ASSERT_NE(id, 0u);
  ASSERT_EQ(sim.resting().size(), 1u);
  EXPECT_EQ(sim.resting()[0].ahead, queue);  // joined the back of the queue
  EXPECT_EQ(sim.quote().bid_size[0], queue + 2);
  // Selling exactly the lots ahead fills none of ours (FIFO)...
  sim.market_order(Side::Sell, queue);
  EXPECT_TRUE(sim.own_fills().empty());
  EXPECT_EQ(sim.resting()[0].ahead, 0u);
  EXPECT_EQ(sim.bid(), bid);  // our 2 lots still hold the level
  // ...one more lot fills one of ours, at our price.
  sim.market_order(Side::Sell, 1);
  ASSERT_EQ(sim.own_fills().size(), 1u);
  EXPECT_EQ(sim.own_fills()[0].id, id);
  EXPECT_EQ(sim.own_fills()[0].size, 1u);
  EXPECT_EQ(sim.own_fills()[0].price, bid);
  EXPECT_EQ(sim.resting()[0].qty, 1u);
  // Cancel returns what's left and takes it off the book.
  const std::uint32_t before = sim.quote().bid_size[0];
  EXPECT_EQ(sim.cancel(id), 1u);
  EXPECT_TRUE(sim.resting().empty());
  EXPECT_EQ(sim.quote().bid_size[0], before - 1);
  EXPECT_EQ(sim.cancel(id), 0u);
}

TEST(EsSimulator, QueuePositionImprovesAsOthersCancel) {

  p.noise_rate = 0;

  ASSERT_EQ(sim.resting().size(), 1u);
  EXPECT_LT(sim.resting()[0].ahead, ahead0);
  EXPECT_GT(sim.resting()[0].ahead, ahead0 / 10);
  EXPECT_EQ(sim.resting()[0].qty, 1u);  // nobody traded
}

  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 50; ++i) d5 += deltas[deltas.size() - 1 - i];
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 300; ++i) d30 += deltas[deltas.size() - 1 - i];
  EXPECT_NEAR(fb.raw()[0], d5, 1e-6);   // delta over 5 s = 50 buckets

    rag::agent::Rng r(11);
    auto o = env.reset(r);
    double total = 0;
    int steps = 0;
    for (;;) {
      const auto st = env.step(fixed, r);
      total += st.reward;
      ++steps;
      o = st.obs;
      if (st.done) break;
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(steps, 120);
    EXPECT_EQ(o.position, 0);  // the episode ends flat
    EXPECT_NEAR(total, env.net_pnl_ticks(), 1e-6);
    if (fixed == 1) {
      EXPECT_EQ(total, 0.0);
      EXPECT_EQ(env.orders(), 0u);
    } else {
      EXPECT_EQ(env.orders(), 2u);  // in once, out at the end
      EXPECT_NEAR(env.fees_ticks(), 2 * p.fee_dollars / kTickValue, 1e-12);
    }
  }
}

TEST(ScalpEnv, TradingEveryStepLosesTheSpreadAndFees) {
  ScalpParams p;
  p.episode_seconds = 60;
  ScalpEnv env(p);
  rag::agent::Rng r(3);
  env.reset(r);
  for (int i = 0; i < 60; ++i) env.step(static_cast<rag::agent::Action>(i % 2 == 0 ? 0 : 2), r);  // flip short/long every second
  // ~60 flips of 2 contracts: each pays about a spread (1 tick) per contract plus fees.
  EXPECT_LT(env.net_pnl_ticks(), -40.0);
}

#include "rag/orderflow/tick_env.hpp"

TEST(TickScalpEnv, InventoryStaysWithinLimitsAndRewardsAddUp) {
  TickParams p;
  p.episode_seconds = 120;
  TickScalpEnv env(p);
  for (rag::agent::Action mode : {rag::agent::Action{0}, rag::agent::Action{3}, rag::agent::Action{1}}) {
    rag::agent::Rng r(21);
    auto o = env.reset(r);
    double total = 0;
    for (;;) {
      const auto st = env.step(mode, r);
      total += st.reward;
      o = st.obs;
      ASSERT_LE(std::abs(o.position), p.max_position);
      if (st.done) break;
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(o.position, 0);
    EXPECT_NEAR(total, env.net_pnl_ticks(), 1e-6);
    if (mode == 0) {
      EXPECT_EQ(env.fills(), 0u);
      EXPECT_EQ(total, 0.0);
    } else {
      EXPECT_GT(env.fills(), 0u);  // two minutes at the touch gets filled
    }
  }
}

TEST(TickScalpEnv, QueuePositionIsObservedWhileQuoting) {
  TickScalpEnv env;
  rag::agent::Rng r(5);
  env.reset(r);
  const auto st = env.step(3, r);  // quote both sides for 0.5 s
  // Unless already filled, each side reports a queue position in (0, ~2].
  if (st.obs.position == 0) {
    EXPECT_GT(st.obs.bid_queue, 0.0);
    EXPECT_GT(st.obs.ask_queue, 0.0);
  }
  const auto none = env.step(0, r);
  EXPECT_EQ(none.obs.bid_queue, -1.0);
  EXPECT_EQ(none.obs.ask_queue, -1.0);
}

// Why OF5's agent never learned to quote (and why OF7 guides exploration):
// a fill needs the quote to stay put while the ~120 lots ahead of it trade
// or cancel, and uniformly random modes cancel a side at most decisions, so
// the order rejoins at the back again and again. Measured on 120 s episodes
// (seeds 31-38): quoting both sides throughout got 6-14 fills each, uniform
// random modes got 0 every time (300 s validation episodes: 24.3 vs 0.10 per
// episode).
TEST(TickScalpEnv, OnlyQuotesThatStayPutReachTheFrontOfTheQueue) {
  TickParams p;
  p.episode_seconds = 120;
  std::uint32_t persistent = 0, flickering = 0;
  for (std::uint64_t seed = 31; seed < 35; ++seed) {
    for (const bool random_modes : {false, true}) {
      TickScalpEnv env(p);
      rag::agent::Rng r(seed), pick(seed + 1000);
      env.reset(r);
      while (!env.step(random_modes ? pick.below(5) : rag::agent::Action{3}, r).done) {
      }
      (random_modes ? flickering : persistent) += env.fills();
    }
  }
  EXPECT_GE(persistent, 20u);  // measured 34 (10 + 6 + 10 + 8)
  EXPECT_LE(flickering, 2u);   // measured 0
}

TEST(EsSimulator, SeparateStreamsKeepTheFairValuePathIndependentOfOurOrders) {
  // With one stream per exogenous process, our orders can't change the
  // news shocks. The fair-value *path* also depends on activity, which price
  // moves excite, so it is independent of our orders only without that
  // excitation. (Endogenous processes still diverge once the book differs;
  // see ORDERFLOW.md.)
  SimParams p;
  p.separate_streams = true;
  p.activity_excite = 0;
  EsSimulator quiet(p, 9), active(p, 9);
  for (int s = 0; s < 3000; ++s) {
    if (s % 20 == 0) active.submit_limit(Side::Buy, active.bid(), 1);
    if (s % 37 == 0) active.market_order(Side::Sell, 2);
    quiet.step();
    active.step();
    ASSERT_EQ(quiet.fair_value(), active.fair_value()) << "step " << s;
  }
  // The shared default stream does not have this property.
  EsSimulator q2(SimParams{.activity_excite = 0}, 9), a2(SimParams{.activity_excite = 0}, 9);
  bool diverged = false;
  for (int s = 0; s < 3000 && !diverged; ++s) {
    if (s % 20 == 0) a2.submit_limit(Side::Buy, a2.bid(), 1);
    q2.step();
    a2.step();
    diverged = q2.fair_value() != a2.fair_value();
  }
  EXPECT_TRUE(diverged);
}

// FNV-1a over every trade and quote of `steps` steps: a fingerprint of a run.
static std::uint64_t run_fingerprint(const SimParams& p, std::uint64_t seed, int steps = 20'000) {
  EsSimulator sim(p, seed);
  std::uint64_t h = 14695981039346656037ull;
  auto mix = [&h](std::uint64_t v) {
    for (int b = 0; b < 8; ++b) {
      h ^= (v >> (8 * b)) & 0xffu;
      h *= 1099511628211ull;
    }
  };
  for (int s = 0; s < steps; ++s) {
    sim.step();
    for (const auto& t : sim.trades()) {
      mix(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(t.t_ns));
      mix(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(t.price)));
      mix(t.size);
      mix(t.aggressor == Side::Buy ? 1u : 2u);
      mix(t.own ? 1u : 0u);
    }
    const Quote q = sim.quote();
    mix(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(q.bid)));
    mix(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(q.ask)));
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kDepth; ++i) {
      mix(q.bid_size[i]);
      mix(q.ask_size[i]);
    }
  }
  return h;
}

TEST(EsSimulator, GoldenRunsOfTheExistingPresetsAreUnchanged) {
  // Recorded with the code before the quote-jump mechanism (commit e0a4c7a),
  // MSVC x64. Every OF1-OF9 result depends on these paths staying
  // bit-identical. Floating-point library functions (exp, log, pow) and FMA
  // contraction differ between compilers, so the exact values are checked
  // only where they were recorded; the opt-in test below runs everywhere.
  SimParams sep;
  sep.separate_streams = true;
  const std::uint64_t a = run_fingerprint(SimParams{}, 1), b = run_fingerprint(efficient_market(), 2), c = run_fingerprint(sep, 3);
#if defined(_MSC_VER) && !defined(__clang__)
  EXPECT_EQ(a, 275146979745797631ull) << a;
  EXPECT_EQ(b, 8508263057256671083ull) << b;
  EXPECT_EQ(c, 12097387368164182254ull) << c;
#else
  EXPECT_NE(a, b);
  EXPECT_NE(a, c);
#endif
}

TEST(PriceDiscovery, OffByDefaultAndTheSniperSizeAloneChangesNothing) {
  // reprice_band = 0 switches the mechanism off: no draws, no state change.
  SimParams p;
  p.reprice_snipe = 0.5;
  EXPECT_EQ(run_fingerprint(p, 1, 5'000), run_fingerprint(SimParams{}, 1, 5'000));
  SimParams on;
  on.reprice_band = 0.65;
  EXPECT_NE(run_fingerprint(on, 1, 5'000), run_fingerprint(SimParams{}, 1, 5'000));
  EXPECT_THROW(EsSimulator(SimParams{.reprice_band = -1}), std::invalid_argument);
  EXPECT_THROW(EsSimulator(SimParams{.reprice_snipe = 1.5}), std::invalid_argument);
  EXPECT_THROW(market_preset("fast"), std::invalid_argument);
  EXPECT_EQ(market_preset("discovery").reprice_band, discovery_market().reprice_band);
}

TEST(PriceDiscovery, QuotesTrackValueAndRequeuedOrdersSitBehindTheLevel) {
  SimParams p = discovery_market_v1();
  p.jump_rate = 1.0;  // news about every 10 steps
  EsSimulator sim(p, 11);
  rag::agent::Rng rng(3);
  std::uint64_t jumps = 0;
  for (int s = 0; s < 20'000; ++s) {
    if (s % 7 == 0) {
      const Side side = rng.uniform() < 0.5 ? Side::Buy : Side::Sell;
      const auto back = static_cast<std::int32_t>(rng.below(3));
      sim.submit_limit(side, side == Side::Buy ? sim.bid() - back : sim.ask() + back, 1 + rng.below(3));
    }
    if (s % 13 == 0 && !sim.resting().empty()) sim.cancel(sim.resting().front().id);
    const std::uint64_t before = sim.reprices();
    sim.step();
    // Every quote a strategy sees: value within max(band, 0.5) of the mid.
    ASSERT_LE(std::abs(sim.fair_value() - sim.mid()), std::max(p.reprice_band, 0.5) + 1e-9) << "step " << s;
    ASSERT_GE(sim.spread(), 1);
    if (sim.reprices() == before) continue;
    ++jumps;
    // Orders that kept their price rejoined the back of the queue there.
    const Quote q = sim.quote();
    for (const auto& r : sim.resting()) {
      const std::int32_t d = r.side == Side::Buy ? sim.bid() - r.price : r.price - sim.ask();
      ASSERT_GE(d, 0);
      if (d < static_cast<std::int32_t>(kDepth)) {
        const auto i = static_cast<std::size_t>(d);
        ASSERT_LE(r.ahead + r.qty, r.side == Side::Buy ? q.bid_size[i] : q.ask_size[i]) << "step " << s;
      }
    }
  }
  EXPECT_GT(jumps, 500u);
}

TEST(PriceDiscovery, AStaleOwnAskIsFilledAtItsPriceWhenValueJumpsThroughIt) {
  // Takers off, a news jump every step: the book moves only by quote jumps.
  SimParams p = discovery_market_v1();
  p.noise_rate = p.informed_meta_rate = p.uninformed_meta_rate = p.momentum_rate = 0;
  p.jump_rate = 10;
  p.jump_sd = 4;
  EsSimulator sim(p, 5);
  int crossed = 0;
  for (int s = 0; s < 2'000 && crossed < 20; ++s) {
    const std::int32_t ask = sim.ask();
    const std::uint64_t id = sim.submit_limit(Side::Sell, ask, 2);
    ASSERT_NE(id, 0u);
    sim.step();
    if (sim.bid() < ask) {
      sim.cancel(id);
      continue;
    }
    ++crossed;  // value jumped up through our ask: the snipers took it at our (stale) price
    std::uint32_t lots = 0;
    for (const auto& f : sim.own_fills())
      if (f.id == id) {
        EXPECT_EQ(f.price, ask);
        EXPECT_EQ(f.side, Side::Sell);
        lots += f.size;
      }
    EXPECT_EQ(lots, 2u);
    for (const auto& r : sim.resting()) EXPECT_NE(r.id, id);
    EXPECT_GT(sim.sniper_prints(), 0u);
  }
  EXPECT_GE(crossed, 10);
}

// corr(fair value - mid, mid change over the next 30 s), over `seconds` of trading.
static double gap_predicts_30s(const SimParams& p, std::uint64_t seed, double seconds) {
  EsSimulator sim(p, seed, 3600);
  const auto n = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::lround(seconds / p.dt)), h = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::lround(30 / p.dt));
  std::vector<double> g, m;
  for (std::size_t s = 0; s < n + h; ++s) {
    sim.step();
    g.push_back(sim.fair_value() - sim.mid());
    m.push_back(sim.mid());
  }
  double sx = 0, sy = 0, sxx = 0, syy = 0, sxy = 0;
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    const double x = g[i], y = m[i + h] - m[i];
    sx += x;
    sy += y;
    sxx += x * x;
    syy += y * y;
    sxy += x * y;
  }
  const double k = static_cast<double>(n);
  return (sxy - sx * sy / k) / std::sqrt((sxx - sx * sx / k) * (syy - sy * sy / k));
}

TEST(PriceDiscovery, TheHiddenGapNoLongerPredictsTheNext30Seconds) {
  // 2 h, seed 1. Measured (MSVC): default 0.62, discovery v1 0.13
  // (OF10 seeds 1-3: default 0.54-0.62, discovery ~0.1, the 1-tick grid's floor ~0.09-0.12).
  const double def = gap_predicts_30s(SimParams{}, 1, 7200), disc = gap_predicts_30s(discovery_market_v1(), 1, 7200);
  EXPECT_GT(def, 0.4) << def;
  EXPECT_LT(disc, 0.2) << disc;
}

// --- stale-side depletion (v2: SimParams::reprice_cancel, value_impact) -----

TEST(PriceDiscovery, TheV2FieldsAreInertUnlessSwitchedOn) {
  // reprice_cancel needs reprice_band > 0; impact needs value_impact > 0.
  SimParams p;
  p.reprice_cancel = 5;
  p.reprice_take = 0.3;
  p.impact_forecast_tau = 3;
  p.impact_forecast_weight = 0.5;
  EXPECT_EQ(run_fingerprint(p, 1, 5'000), run_fingerprint(SimParams{}, 1, 5'000));
  SimParams v1 = discovery_market_v1();
  v1.reprice_take = 0.3;
  v1.impact_forecast_tau = 3;
  EXPECT_EQ(run_fingerprint(v1, 4, 5'000), run_fingerprint(discovery_market_v1(), 4, 5'000));
  SimParams sep;  // reprice_take alone (no reprice_band / reprice_cancel) is inert with separate streams too
  sep.separate_streams = true;
  SimParams sep2 = sep;
  sep2.reprice_take = 0.5;
  EXPECT_EQ(run_fingerprint(sep, 3, 5'000), run_fingerprint(sep2, 3, 5'000));
  {  // with separate streams, depletion (and its own random stream) leaves the value path alone
    SimParams on = sep;  // (activity_excite off: it feeds mid moves back into the value volatility)
    on.activity_excite = 0;
    on.reprice_band = 0.5;
    on.reprice_cancel = 15;
    on.reprice_take = 0.1;
    SimParams off = on;
    off.reprice_cancel = 0;
    EsSimulator a(on, 3), b(off, 3);
    for (int s = 0; s < 5'000; ++s) {
      a.step();
      b.step();
      ASSERT_EQ(a.fair_value(), b.fair_value()) << "step " << s;
    }
    EXPECT_GT(a.stale_cancelled_lots(), 0u);  // depletion did run
    EXPECT_EQ(b.stale_cancelled_lots(), 0u);
  }
  SimParams imp;
  imp.value_impact = 0.004;
  EXPECT_NE(run_fingerprint(imp, 1, 5'000), run_fingerprint(SimParams{}, 1, 5'000));
  EXPECT_THROW(EsSimulator(SimParams{.reprice_cancel = -1}), std::invalid_argument);
  EXPECT_THROW(EsSimulator(SimParams{.reprice_take = 1.5}), std::invalid_argument);
  EXPECT_THROW(EsSimulator(SimParams{.value_impact = -1}), std::invalid_argument);
}

// Takers, diffusion and icebergs off, news jumps: the book moves only by depletion.
static SimParams jumps_only(double jump_rate) {
  SimParams p = discovery_market();
  p.noise_rate = p.informed_meta_rate = p.uninformed_meta_rate = p.momentum_rate = 0;
  p.value_vol = 0;
  p.iceberg_rate = 0;
  p.jump_rate = jump_rate;
  p.jump_sd = 4;
  return p;
}

TEST(PriceDiscovery, AfterNewsTheStaleSideDrainsNobodyJoinsItAndTheBookCatchesUp) {
  const SimParams p = jumps_only(0.3);
  EsSimulator sim(p, 7);
  int jumps = 0, slow = 0;
  double v = sim.fair_value();
  int since = -1;  // steps since the last jump, while the book hasn't caught up
  Quote before = sim.quote();
  for (int s = 0; s < 40'000; ++s) {
    sim.step();
    const Quote q = sim.quote();
    const double g = sim.fair_value() - sim.mid();
    // Nobody joins a stale price: while value has passed the best and the
    // price didn't move, the stale best only shrinks.
    if (q.bid == before.bid && q.ask == before.ask && sim.fair_value() == v) {
      if (sim.fair_value() - q.ask > p.reprice_band - 0.5) ASSERT_LE(q.ask_size[0], before.ask_size[0]) << "step " << s;
      if (q.bid - sim.fair_value() > p.reprice_band - 0.5) ASSERT_LE(q.bid_size[0], before.bid_size[0]) << "step " << s;
    }
    if (sim.fair_value() != v) {
      v = sim.fair_value();
      since = 0;
      ++jumps;
    } else if (since >= 0) {
      ++since;
    }
    if (since >= 0 && std::abs(g) <= p.reprice_band) {
      EXPECT_EQ(sim.spread(), 1) << "step " << s;  // caught up, with a 1-tick spread
      if (since > 20) ++slow;
      since = -1;
    }
    before = q;
  }
  EXPECT_GT(jumps, 300);
  EXPECT_LE(slow, jumps / 50) << slow;  // catch-up beyond 2 s is rare
  EXPECT_GT(sim.races(), 300u);
  EXPECT_GT(sim.stale_cancelled_lots(), 0u);
  EXPECT_GT(sim.taker_volume(EsSimulator::kSniper), 0u);
}

TEST(PriceDiscovery, AStaleOwnAskAtTheBackIsFilledOnlyAfterTheLotsAheadOfIt) {
  SimParams p = jumps_only(0.2);
  p.jump_sd = 1.5;  // small news: the stale queue drains over a few steps
  EsSimulator sim(p, 9);
  int cases = 0, fills = 0, queued = 0, early = 0;
  for (int s = 0; s < 200'000 && cases < 15; ++s) {
    if (!sim.resting().empty()) {
      sim.step();
      continue;
    }
    const std::int32_t ask = sim.ask();
    const std::uint64_t id = sim.submit_limit(Side::Sell, ask, 1);
    ASSERT_NE(id, 0u);
    sim.step();
    const bool stale = sim.fair_value() - ask > p.reprice_band - 0.5;
    for (const auto& f : sim.own_fills())
      if (stale && f.id == id) ++early;  // FIFO: the first depletion step can't reach the back of the queue
    if (!stale || sim.ask() != ask || sim.resting().empty()) {  // not stale: next try
      sim.cancel(id);
      continue;
    }
    // Stale: value passed our ask. We joined at the back (behind the level and
    // the faster participants), so the first depletion step didn't reach us.
    ++cases;
    ASSERT_EQ(sim.resting().front().id, id);
    std::uint32_t ahead = sim.resting().front().ahead;
    if (ahead > 0) ++queued;  // lots still ahead of us after the first depletion step
    bool filled = false;
    for (int k = 0; k < 100 && !filled; ++k) {
      sim.step();
      for (const auto& f : sim.own_fills())
        if (f.id == id) {
          EXPECT_EQ(f.price, ask);
          filled = true;
        }
      if (filled) break;
      ASSERT_FALSE(sim.resting().empty()) << "order vanished without a fill";
      ASSERT_LE(sim.resting().front().ahead, ahead);  // the queue ahead only shrinks
      ahead = sim.resting().front().ahead;
      ASSERT_EQ(sim.ask(), ask);                                      // the price can't tick past our unfilled order
      if (!(sim.fair_value() - ask > p.reprice_band - 0.5)) break;  // news back down: no longer stale
    }
    if (filled) ++fills;
    else sim.cancel(id);
  }
  EXPECT_GE(cases, 10);
  EXPECT_GE(fills, cases / 2);
  EXPECT_GE(queued, cases / 2);
  EXPECT_EQ(early, 0);
}

TEST(PriceDiscovery, V2BookInvariantsHoldUnderFrequentNews) {
  SimParams p = discovery_market();
  p.jump_rate = 1.0;
  EsSimulator sim(p, 11);
  rag::agent::Rng rng(3);
  for (int s = 0; s < 20'000; ++s) {
    if (s % 7 == 0) {
      const Side side = rng.uniform() < 0.5 ? Side::Buy : Side::Sell;
      const auto back = static_cast<std::int32_t>(rng.below(3));
      sim.submit_limit(side, side == Side::Buy ? sim.bid() - back : sim.ask() + back, 1 + rng.below(3));
    }
    if (s % 13 == 0 && !sim.resting().empty()) sim.cancel(sim.resting().front().id);
    if (s % 17 == 0) sim.market_order(rng.uniform() < 0.5 ? Side::Buy : Side::Sell, 1);
    sim.step();
    ASSERT_GE(sim.spread(), 1);
    const Quote q = sim.quote();
    for (const auto& r : sim.resting()) {
      const std::int32_t d = r.side == Side::Buy ? sim.bid() - r.price : r.price - sim.ask();
      ASSERT_GE(d, 0) << "step " << s;
      if (d < static_cast<std::int32_t>(kDepth)) {
        const auto i = static_cast<std::size_t>(d);
        ASSERT_LE(r.ahead + r.qty, r.side == Side::Buy ? q.bid_size[i] : q.ask_size[i]) << "step " << s;
      }
    }
  }
  EXPECT_GT(sim.reprices(), 500u);
}

// Event time: corr(L1 imbalance, the next mid change), over `seconds` of trading.
static double imbalance_predicts_next_change(const SimParams& p, std::uint64_t seed, double seconds) {
  EsSimulator sim(p, seed, 3600);
  const auto n = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::lround(seconds / p.dt));
  std::vector<double> x, m;
  for (std::size_t s = 0; s < n; ++s) {
    sim.step();
    const Quote q = sim.quote();
    const double b = q.bid_size[0], a = q.ask_size[0];
    x.push_back(b + a > 0 ? (b - a) / (b + a) : 0);
    m.push_back(sim.mid());
  }
  double sx = 0, sy = 0, sxx = 0, syy = 0, sxy = 0, k = 0;
  std::size_t c = 1;
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    if (c <= i) c = i + 1;
    while (c < n && m[c] == m[i]) ++c;
    if (c >= n) break;
    const double y = m[c] - m[i];
    sx += x[i];
    sy += y;
    sxx += x[i] * x[i];
    syy += y * y;
    sxy += x[i] * y;
    k += 1;
  }
  return (sxy - sx * sy / k) / std::sqrt((sxx - sx * sx / k) * (syy - sy * sy / k));
}

TEST(EsSimulatorActivity, NewFieldsAreInertWithTheLegacyModelAndTheWarmStartNeedsModel1) {
  SimParams p;
  p.activity_news_excite = 0.7;  // model 0 ignores it
  EXPECT_EQ(run_fingerprint(p, 1, 5'000), run_fingerprint(SimParams{}, 1, 5'000));

  SimParams bad = default_warm();

TEST(EsSimulatorActivity, TheWarmStartDrawsTheStationaryLaw) {
  // Activity in model 1 doesn't depend on the book, so a market without takers
  // and makers (cheap steps) has the same activity law as default_warm().
  SimParams p = default_warm();
  p.noise_rate = p.informed_meta_rate = p.uninformed_meta_rate = p.momentum_rate = 0;
  p.maker_rate = 0;
  p.iceberg_rate = 0;
  const ActivityLaw law = activity_law(p);
  const int n = 5'000;  // sd of x within 3%: ~3 SE (measured at 20,000: ratio 0.995-0.997, |mean - m0| <= 1.3 SE)
  std::vector<double> x0, x1;
  double ratio_num = 0, ratio_den = 0;
  std::vector<double> ratio;
  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    EsSimulator sim(p, 5'000'000ull + static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i), 3600);
    x0.push_back(sim.log_activity());
    for (int s = 0; s < 3'000; ++s) sim.step();
    x1.push_back(sim.log_activity());
    ratio.push_back(sim.activity() / sim.intraday_factor());
    ratio_num += ratio.back();
    ratio_den += 1;
  }
  auto moments = [](const std::vector<double>& v) {
    double m = 0, s = 0;
    for (double x : v) m += x / static_cast<double>(v.size());
    for (double x : v) s += (x - m) * (x - m);
    return std::pair<double, double>{m, std::sqrt(s / static_cast<double>(v.size() - 1))};
  };
  for (const auto* v : {&x0, &x1}) {
    const auto [m, sd] = moments(*v);
    const double se = sd / std::sqrt(static_cast<double>(n));
    EXPECT_LE(std::abs(m - law.m0), 2 * se) << "mean " << m << " m0 " << law.m0 << " se " << se;
    EXPECT_NEAR(sd / law.sd, 1.0, 0.03) << "sd " << sd << " analytic " << law.sd;
  }
  const auto [rm, rsd] = moments(ratio);  // E[activity / intraday] = 1 (m0 centring)
  EXPECT_LE(std::abs(rm - 1), 2 * rsd / std::sqrt(static_cast<double>(n))) << rm;
  EXPECT_NEAR(law.sd, 0.531, 0.01);  // tau / 2 * (vol^2 + k^2 jump_rate), the design's value
}

// Share of steps at the lower activity clamp in ScalpEnv-built 10-minute episodes after the 150 s warm-up.
static std::pair<double, double> episode_activity(const SimParams& sim, int episodes) {
  ScalpParams sp;
  sp.sim = sim;
  double low = 0, act = 0, steps = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < episodes; ++i) {
    rag::agent::Rng r(6'000'000ull + static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i));
    EsSimulator m = ScalpEnv::make_market(sp, r);
    for (int s = 0; s < 1'500 + 6'000; ++s) {
      m.step();
      if (s < 1'500) continue;
      low += m.log_activity() <= sim.activity_min + 1e-9 ? 1 : 0;
      act += m.activity() / m.intraday_factor();
      steps += 1;
    }
  }
  return {low / steps, act / steps};
}

TEST(EsSimulatorActivity, EpisodesAreNotStuckAtTheLowerClampWithTheWarmStart) {
  // 40 episodes. Measured (MSVC): legacy default 0.4 of the steps at the lower
  // clamp (activity / intraday ~0.3); default_warm and discovery v3 0.000
  // (activity / intraday ~1).
  const auto [low_def, act_def] = episode_activity(SimParams{}, 40);
  const auto [low_warm, act_warm] = episode_activity(default_warm(), 40);
  const auto [low_v3, act_v3] = episode_activity(discovery_market(), 40);
  EXPECT_GT(low_def, 0.2) << low_def << " " << act_def;
  EXPECT_LT(low_warm, 0.001) << low_warm;
  EXPECT_LT(low_v3, 0.001) << low_v3;
  EXPECT_GT(act_warm, 0.6) << act_warm;
  EXPECT_GT(act_v3, 0.6) << act_v3;
}

TEST(EsSimulatorActivity, MakeMarketBuildsTheSameEpisodeAsReset) {
  for (const SimParams& sim : {default_warm(), discovery_market()}) {
    ScalpParams sp;
    sp.sim = sim;
    ScalpEnv env(sp);
    rag::agent::Rng r1(77), r2(77);
    env.reset(r1);
    EsSimulator m = ScalpEnv::make_market(sp, r2);
    for (int s = 0; s < 1'500; ++s) m.step();
    for (int d = 0; d < 10; ++d) {  // 10 flat decisions: 100 steps
      env.step(1, r1);
      for (int s = 0; s < 10; ++s) m.step();
      ASSERT_EQ(env.market().t_ns(), m.t_ns());
      ASSERT_EQ(env.market().fair_value(), m.fair_value());
      ASSERT_EQ(env.market().bid(), m.bid());
      ASSERT_EQ(env.market().quote().bid_size, m.quote().bid_size);
      ASSERT_EQ(env.market().quote().ask_size, m.quote().ask_size);
    }
    TickParams tp;
    tp.sim = sim;
    TickScalpEnv tenv(tp);
    rag::agent::Rng t1(78), t2(78);
    tenv.reset(t1);
    EsSimulator tm = TickScalpEnv::make_market(tp, t2);
    for (int s = 0; s < 1'500; ++s) tm.step();
    ASSERT_EQ(tenv.market().fair_value(), tm.fair_value());
    ASSERT_EQ(tenv.market().quote().ask_size, tm.quote().ask_size);
  }
}

TEST(EsSimulatorActivity, ForkGivesACopyFreshRandomnessAndLeavesTheOriginalAlone) {
  for (bool sep : {false, true}) {
    SimParams p = discovery_market();
    p.separate_streams = sep;
    EsSimulator a(p, 9, 3600), b(p, 9, 3600);
    for (int s = 0; s < 500; ++s) {
      a.step();
      b.step();
    }
    EsSimulator f1 = a, f2 = a, f3 = a;
    f1.fork(1);
    f2.fork(1);
    f3.fork(2);
    bool differs = false;
    for (int s = 0; s < 300; ++s) {
      a.step();
      b.step();
      f1.step();
      f2.step();
      f3.step();
      ASSERT_EQ(a.fair_value(), b.fair_value());  // forking a copy doesn't touch the original
      ASSERT_EQ(f1.fair_value(), f2.fair_value());  // same salt: same future
      differs = differs || f1.fair_value() != f3.fair_value() || f1.fair_value() != a.fair_value();
    }
    EXPECT_TRUE(differs);
  }
}

// Review of iteration 3: the hidden fair value at a fill is diagnostics only.
// It must not ride in OwnFill (copied by agent-facing step_fills()); the
// simulator and TickScalpEnv keep it in parallel accessors named as hidden.
template <class T>
concept CarriesAValue = requires(T f) { f.value; };
static_assert(!CarriesAValue<OwnFill>, "OwnFill is agent-facing: keep the hidden value out of it");

TEST(EsSimulatorActivity, HiddenFillValuesStayOutOfOwnFillAndParallelToIt) {
  TickParams tp;
  tp.sim = discovery_market();
  tp.episode_seconds = 120;
  TickScalpEnv env(tp);
  rag::agent::Rng r(31);
  env.reset(r);
  std::size_t fills = 0;
  for (;;) {
    const auto st = env.step(rag::agent::Action{3}, r);  // quote both sides
    ASSERT_EQ(env.step_fill_hidden_values().size(), env.step_fills().size());
    ASSERT_EQ(env.market().own_fill_hidden_values().size(), env.market().own_fills().size());
    fills += env.step_fills().size();
    if (st.done) break;
  }
  EXPECT_GT(fills, 0u);
}

// The probe's ground-truth path (a longer burn before the same window) uses
// ScalpEnv::draw_market: the same draws, in the same order, as make_market.
TEST(EsSimulatorActivity, DrawMarketMatchesMakeMarket) {
  ScalpParams sp;
  sp.sim = discovery_market();
  for (std::uint64_t seed : {3ull, 4ull, 5ull}) {
    rag::agent::Rng r1(seed), r2(seed);
    const ScalpEnv::MarketDraw d = ScalpEnv::draw_market(sp, r1);
    EsSimulator a(sp.sim, d.seed, d.start), b = ScalpEnv::make_market(sp, r2);
    EXPECT_EQ(r1.next(), r2.next());  // the same number of draws consumed
    EXPECT_GE(d.start, 0.0);
    for (int s = 0; s < 200; ++s) {
      a.step();
      b.step();
    }
    EXPECT_EQ(a.t_ns(), b.t_ns());
    EXPECT_EQ(a.fair_value(), b.fair_value());
    EXPECT_EQ(a.quote().bid_size, b.quote().bid_size);
  }
}

// OF10 iteration 3: the --warmup option of the ScalpEnv programs
// (rag/orderflow/scalp_run.hpp), opt-in with ScalpEnv's 150 s default.
#include <algorithm>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>

#include "rag/orderflow/scalp_run.hpp"

TEST(ScalpEnvRun, TheWarmupOptionReachesScalpParamsAndMovesTheEpisodes) {
  EXPECT_EQ(kDefaultWarmup, ScalpParams{}.warmup_seconds);
  EXPECT_EQ(scalp_params("default").warmup_seconds, ScalpParams{}.warmup_seconds);
  ASSERT_TRUE(parse_warmup("1050").has_value());
  EXPECT_EQ(*parse_warmup("1050"), 1050.0);
  EXPECT_EQ(*parse_warmup("0"), 0.0);
  for (const char* bad : {"", "-1", "10x", "nan", "inf", "1e999"}) EXPECT_FALSE(parse_warmup(bad).has_value()) << bad;
  const ScalpParams p = scalp_params("discovery", *parse_warmup("1050"));
  EXPECT_EQ(p.warmup_seconds, 1050.0);
  EXPECT_EQ(p.sim.jump_rate, discovery_market().jump_rate);
  EXPECT_EQ(p.sim.activity_model, 1);
  // The warm-up start is uniform on [0, session - episode - warm-up]: every
  // episode starts >= 1050 s into the session and ends by the close.
  const double latest = p.sim.session_seconds - p.episode_seconds - p.warmup_seconds;
  double hi = 0;
  for (std::uint64_t s = 1; s <= 200; ++s) {
    rag::agent::Rng r(s);
    const double start = ScalpEnv::draw_market(p, r).start;
    EXPECT_GE(start, 0.0);
    EXPECT_LE(start, latest);
    hi = std::max(hi, start);
  }
  EXPECT_GT(hi, 0.9 * latest);
  // reset() runs the simulator for the whole warm-up before the first decision.
  ScalpEnv env(p);
  rag::agent::Rng r(7);
  (void)env.reset(r);
  EXPECT_EQ(env.market().t_ns(), 1'050'000'000'000LL);
  // At most session - episode (22,800 s): beyond that no episode fits before the close.
  EXPECT_EQ(warmup_error(p), "");
  EXPECT_EQ(warmup_error(scalp_params("default", 22'800)), "");
  EXPECT_NE(warmup_error(scalp_params("default", 22'801)), "");
  EXPECT_NE(warmup_error(scalp_params("discovery", 1e12)), "");
}

TEST(ScalpEnvRun, DiscoveryStressListDiffersAndTheLegacyListIsUnchanged) {
  auto names = [](const std::vector<StressScenario>& v) {
    std::vector<std::string> n;
    for (const auto& s : v) n.push_back(s.name);
    return n;
  };
  const std::vector<std::string> legacy = {"nominal",         "latency 300 ms",  "latency 1 s",     "fees $3/side", "informed flow x0.5",
                                           "uninformed flow x1.5", "volatility x1.5", "quote fading x2", "session open"};
  EXPECT_EQ(names(stress_scenarios(false)), legacy);
  const std::vector<std::string> disc = {"nominal",          "latency 300 ms",        "latency 1 s",      "fees $3/side",
                                         "uninformed flow x1.5", "slower discovery x0.5", "flow impact x1.5", "news x3",
                                         "informed meta-orders x4", "thinner book x0.5", "session open"};
  EXPECT_EQ(names(stress_scenarios(true)), disc);
  // The legacy scenarios change exactly what they did.
  const auto ls = stress_scenarios(false);
  ScalpParams q;
  ls[4].change(q);
  EXPECT_EQ(q.sim.informed_meta_rate, SimParams{}.informed_meta_rate * 0.5);
  q = {};
  ls[7].change(q);
  EXPECT_EQ(q.sim.fade, SimParams{}.fade * 2);
  // On discovery every new scenario changes the market (fade x2 would not: fade = 0).
  const ScalpParams base = scalp_params("discovery", 1050);
  ScalpParams f = base;
  ls[7].change(f);
  EXPECT_EQ(f.sim.fade, base.sim.fade);  // the no-op the discovery list drops
  const auto ds = stress_scenarios(true);
  auto changed = [&](std::size_t i) {
    ScalpParams x = base;
    ds[i].change(x);
    if (i < 10) EXPECT_EQ(x.warmup_seconds, 1050.0);  // the run's warm-up survives every scenario but the cold open
    return x;
  };
  EXPECT_EQ(changed(5).sim.reprice_cancel, base.sim.reprice_cancel * 0.5);
  EXPECT_EQ(changed(5).sim.reprice_take, base.sim.reprice_take * 0.5);
  EXPECT_EQ(changed(6).sim.value_impact, base.sim.value_impact * 1.5);
  EXPECT_EQ(changed(7).sim.jump_rate, base.sim.jump_rate * 3);
  EXPECT_EQ(changed(8).sim.informed_meta_rate, base.sim.informed_meta_rate * 4);
  EXPECT_EQ(changed(9).sim.maker_rate, base.sim.maker_rate * 0.5);
  for (std::size_t i = 5; i <= 9; ++i) EXPECT_NO_THROW(EsSimulator(changed(i).sim, 1)) << ds[i].name;
  // "Session open" is a cold open on both lists, whatever the run's warm-up:
  // the simulator starts at the open with a 150 s burn (the episode at 150 s),
  // which at the default warm-up is exactly the legacy start_second = 0.
  const ScalpParams disc_open = changed(10);
  ScalpParams legacy_open_1050 = base;
  ls[8].change(legacy_open_1050);
  for (const ScalpParams* o : std::initializer_list<const ScalpParams*>{&disc_open, &legacy_open_1050}) {
    EXPECT_EQ(o->start_second, 0.0);
    EXPECT_EQ(o->warmup_seconds, kDefaultWarmup);
    EXPECT_EQ(o->sim.jump_rate, base.sim.jump_rate);
  }
  ScalpParams d;
  ls[8].change(d);
  ScalpParams legacy_open;
  legacy_open.start_second = 0;
  EXPECT_EQ(d.start_second, legacy_open.start_second);
  EXPECT_EQ(d.warmup_seconds, legacy_open.warmup_seconds);
}

TEST(ScalpEnvRun, EachNetworkRecordsItsMarketAndWarmupAndAMismatchIsRefused) {
  const auto dir = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "rag_scalp_run_record_test";
  std::filesystem::remove_all(dir);
  std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
  const std::string net = (dir / "seed1.net").string(), other = (dir / "seed2.net").string();
  EXPECT_EQ(record_path_of_net(net), (dir / "seed1.txt").string());
  EXPECT_EQ(record_path_of_net("a.b/net"), "a.b/net.txt");
  // No record: a legacy network (of3_rl, an older of_train), trained at 150 s
  // on an unknown market: fine at 150 s on any market, refused at 1050 s.
  EXPECT_EQ(check_net(net, "default", 150), "");
  EXPECT_EQ(check_net(net, "discovery", 150), "");
  EXPECT_NE(check_net(net, "discovery", 1050), "");
  ASSERT_TRUE(write_net_record(net, "discovery", 1050, "seeds=12\nseed=1\n"));
  EXPECT_EQ(net_record_value(net, "market").value_or(""), "discovery");
  EXPECT_EQ(net_record_value(net, "warmup_seconds").value_or(""), "1050");
  EXPECT_EQ(net_record_value(net, "seeds").value_or(""), "12");
  EXPECT_FALSE(net_record_value(net, "warmup").has_value());  // whole keys only
  EXPECT_EQ(check_net(net, "discovery", 1050), "");
  EXPECT_NE(check_net(net, "discovery", 150), "");   // another warm-up
  EXPECT_NE(check_net(net, "default", 1050), "");    // another market
  EXPECT_NE(check_net(other, "discovery", 1050), "");  // a record vouches for its own network only
  remove_net_record(net);
  EXPECT_FALSE(std::filesystem::exists(record_path_of_net(net)));
  {
    std::ofstream out(record_path_of_net(net), std::ios::binary);  // CRLF (an edited record) reads the same
    out << "market=discovery\r\nwarmup_seconds=150\r\n";
  }
  EXPECT_EQ(check_net(net, "discovery", 150), "");
  EXPECT_NE(check_net(net, "discovery", 1050), "");
  {
    std::ofstream out(record_path_of_net(net), std::ios::binary);  // a record without a readable warm-up is refused
    out << "market=discovery\nwarmup_seconds=abc\n";
  }
  EXPECT_NE(check_net(net, "discovery", 150), "");
  std::filesystem::remove_all(dir);
}

const std::string kHeader = "Northwind Capital - Internal Research";

// A realistic 3-page report: running header, page-number footer, prose.
void write_report(const std::string& p) {
  write_pdf(p,
            {
                PdfPage{{kHeader, "Execution Costs", "Implementation shortfall measures the gap between the",
                         "decision price and the final execution price of an order.", "Page 1 of 3"}},
                PdfPage{{kHeader, "Exchange fees are charged per share. Maker rebates",
                         "reward liquidity providers while takers pay the fee.", "Page 2 of 3"}},
                PdfPage{{kHeader, "Iceberg orders display only a small visible quantity",
                         "and replenish it from a hidden reserve.", "Page 3 of 3"}},
            },
            "Execution Research Notes");
}

TEST_F(PdfTest, EmptyPagesAreCountedAndKeepTheirPageNumbers) {

  write_pdf(path("gap.pdf"), {PdfPage{{"Opening page about auctions."}}, PdfPage{},
                              PdfPage{{"Closing page about dark pools."}}});
  const auto d = pdf::extract(path("gap.pdf"));
  ASSERT_EQ(d.pages.size(), 3u);
  EXPECT_EQ(d.empty_pages, 1u);
  EXPECT_TRUE(d.pages[1].empty());
  Engine e(EngineConfig{.max_chunks = 64});
  const auto r = pdf::ingest(e, d, 0, "gap.pdf");
  EXPECT_EQ(r.pages, 3u);
  EXPECT_EQ(r.empty_pages, 1u);
  e.commit();
  auto ctx = e.make_context();
  const auto q = e.query("dark pools", 1, ctx);
  ASSERT_FALSE(q.hits.empty());
  // One chunk holds pages 1 and 3; the citation spans them (the empty page 2 lies between).
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(q.hits[0].id).page_first, 1u);
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(q.hits[0].id).page_last, 3u);
}

TEST_F(PdfTest, RejectsMissingNonPdfAndDamagedFiles) {
  EXPECT_THROW((void)pdf::extract(path("nope.pdf")), pdf::PdfError);
  EXPECT_THROW((void)pdf::extract(dir_), pdf::PdfError);  // a directory
  std::ofstream(path("fake.pdf")) << "this is plain text, not a PDF";
  EXPECT_THROW((void)pdf::extract(path("fake.pdf")), pdf::PdfError);
  std::ofstream(path("empty.pdf")).close();
  EXPECT_THROW((void)pdf::extract(path("empty.pdf")), pdf::PdfError);
  // Truncated real PDFs: Poppler may repair them or give up. Either way the
  // call must not crash (ASan/UBSan in CI) and must not return garbage pages.
  write_report(path("full.pdf"));
  std::ifstream in(path("full.pdf"), std::ios::binary);
  const std::string bytes{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in), {}};
  for (std::size_t cut : {std::size_t{20}, bytes.size() / 3, bytes.size() / 2, bytes.size() - 30}) {
    std::ofstream(path("cut.pdf"), std::ios::binary) << bytes.substr(0, cut);
    try {
      const auto d = pdf::extract(path("cut.pdf"));
      EXPECT_LE(d.pages.size(), 3u) << "cut at " << cut;
    } catch (const pdf::PdfError&) {
    }
  }
}

TEST_F(PdfTest, ZeroPageDocument) {
  write_pdf(path("zero.pdf"), {});
  const auto d = pdf::extract(path("zero.pdf"));
  EXPECT_TRUE(d.pages.empty());
  Engine e(EngineConfig{.max_chunks = 8});
  EXPECT_EQ(pdf::ingest(e, d, 0, "zero.pdf").chunks, 0u);
}

TEST_F(PdfTest, AnswersCiteTheRightFileAndPage) {
  write_report(path("report.pdf"));
  write_pdf(path("glossary.pdf"),
            {PdfPage{{"Glossary", "Spoofing: placing orders one intends to cancel before execution."}},
             PdfPage{{"VWAP: the volume weighted average price over a trading session."}}});
  Engine e(EngineConfig{.max_chunks = 256, .chunker = {24, 4}});
  const auto a = pdf::ingest_pdf(e, path("report.pdf"), 0);
  const auto b = pdf::ingest_pdf(e, path("glossary.pdf"), 1);
  EXPECT_EQ(a.pages, 3u);
  EXPECT_EQ(b.pages, 2u);
  EXPECT_GT(a.chunks, 0u);
  e.commit();
  auto ctx = e.make_context();
  struct Case {
    const char* q;
    const char* source;
    std::uint32_t page;
  };
  for (const Case& c : {Case{"maker rebates exchange fees", "report.pdf", 2}, Case{"iceberg hidden reserve", "report.pdf", 3},
                        Case{"implementation shortfall decision price", "report.pdf", 1},
                        Case{"volume weighted average price", "glossary.pdf", 2}, Case{"spoofing cancel", "glossary.pdf", 1}}) {
    const auto r = e.query(c.q, 3, ctx);
    ASSERT_FALSE(r.hits.empty()) << c.q;
    const auto top = e.chunk(r.hits[0].id);
    EXPECT_EQ(top.source, c.source) << c.q;
    EXPECT_LE(top.page_first, c.page) << c.q;
    EXPECT_GE(top.page_last, c.page) << c.q;
    EXPECT_NE(r.prompt.prompt.find(std::string("(") + c.source + ", p"), std::string_view::npos) << r.prompt.prompt;
  }
}

TEST_F(PdfTest, ChunkSpanningAPageBreakCitesBothPages) {
  write_pdf(path("span.pdf"), {PdfPage{{"alpha bravo charlie delta echo"}}, PdfPage{{"foxtrot golf hotel india juliet"}}});
  Engine e(EngineConfig{.max_chunks = 16, .chunker = {6, 0}});
  pdf::ingest_pdf(e, path("span.pdf"), 0);
  e.commit();
  ASSERT_EQ(e.size(), 2u);  // words 1-6 and 7-10
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(0).page_first, 1u);
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(0).page_last, 2u);  // "alpha ... echo foxtrot"
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(1).page_first, 2u);
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(1).page_last, 2u);
  auto ctx = e.make_context();
  EXPECT_NE(e.query("echo foxtrot", 1, ctx).prompt.prompt.find("(span.pdf, pp. 1-2)"), std::string_view::npos);
}

TEST_F(PdfTest, IndexOfPdfsSurvivesSaveAndLoad) {
  write_report(path("report.pdf"));
  Engine e(EngineConfig{.max_chunks = 64, .chunker = {16, 4}});
  pdf::ingest_pdf(e, path("report.pdf"), 0);
  e.commit();
  e.save(path("pdfs.ragidx"));
  auto l = Engine::load(path("pdfs.ragidx"), e.config());
  auto ca = e.make_context(), cb = l->make_context();
  const auto ra = e.query("maker rebates", 3, ca), rb = l->query("maker rebates", 3, cb);
  EXPECT_EQ(ra.prompt.prompt, rb.prompt.prompt);  // same passages, same citations
  ASSERT_FALSE(rb.hits.empty());
  const auto top = l->chunk(rb.hits[0].id);
  EXPECT_EQ(top.source, "report.pdf");
  EXPECT_LE(top.page_first, 2u);  // the maker-rebates text is on page 2 (the chunk may start on page 1)
  EXPECT_GE(top.page_last, 2u);
}
