// reference_tests.cpp — differential tests against a deliberately naive
// reference implementation.
//
// The reference is written from the *specification* of each stage, not from
// the optimized code: std::string words, std::map counts, double math, full
// sorts. Randomized corpora (mixed case, punctuation, UTF-8, stopwords,
// duplicates, empty documents) and random configurations are then run through
// both, and every stage is compared: tokenization, chunking, embeddings, BM25
// scores and rankings, exact dense rankings, and RRF fusion.
#include <gtest/gtest.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <map>
#include <random>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "rag.hpp"
#include "test_util.hpp"

using namespace rag;

namespace ref {

// ------------------------------ tokenizer ------------------------------------
// Spec: a word is a maximal run of [A-Za-z0-9] or bytes >= 0x80; ASCII letters
// are case-folded; everything else separates words.
struct Word {
  std::string text;  // case-folded
  std::size_t offset, length;
};

inline bool word_byte(unsigned char c) { return std::isalnum(c) || c >= 0x80; }

inline std::vector<Word> tokenize(const std::string& s) {
  std::vector<Word> out;
  std::size_t i = 0;
  while (i < s.size()) {
    if (!word_byte(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]))) { ++i; continue; }
    std::size_t j = i;
    std::string w;
    while (j < s.size() && word_byte(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[j]))) {
      const auto c = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[j]);
      w += (c < 0x80) ? static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)) : static_cast<char>(c);
      ++j;
    }
    out.push_back({w, i, j - i});
    i = j;
  }
  return out;
}

inline const std::set<std::string>& stopwords() {
  static const std::set<std::string> s = {
      "a", "an", "and", "are", "as", "at", "be", "but", "by", "for", "from", "has", "have", "how", "i", "if", "in",
      "into", "is", "it", "its", "of", "on", "or", "that", "the", "their", "then", "there", "these", "they", "this",
      "to", "was", "we", "were", "what", "when", "where", "which", "who", "why", "will", "with", "you", "your",
      "does", "do", "can", "about"};
  return s;
}

// ------------------------------- chunker -------------------------------------
// Spec: windows of `window` words starting every (window - overlap) words; the
// last window ends at the last word. Chunk text runs from the first word to
// the start of the word after the window (or end of text), minus trailing
// ASCII whitespace.
struct Chunk {
  std::size_t first_word, end_word;
  std::string text;
};

inline std::vector<Chunk> chunk(const std::string& s, const std::vector<Word>& w, std::size_t window,
                                std::size_t overlap) {
  std::vector<Chunk> out;
  if (w.empty()) return out;
  for (std::size_t b = 0;; b += window - overlap) {
    const std::size_t e = std::min(b + window, w.size());
    std::size_t end = e < w.size() ? w[e].offset : s.size();
    while (end > w[e - 1].offset + w[e - 1].length && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[end - 1]))) --end;
    out.push_back({b, e, s.substr(w[b].offset, end - w[b].offset)});
    if (e == w.size()) break;
  }
  return out;
}

// -------------------------------- BM25 ---------------------------------------
// Spec: Lucene BM25, idf = ln(1 + (N - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5)), document
// length = number of non-stopword terms, each distinct query term counted once.
struct Bm25 {
  std::vector<std::map<std::string, int>> tf;
  std::vector<double> len;
  double avgdl = 1;
  std::map<std::string, int> df;

  explicit Bm25(const std::vector<std::vector<std::string>>& docs) {
    double total = 0;
    for (const auto& d : docs) {
      std::map<std::string, int> m;
      for (const auto& t : d) ++m[t];
      for (const auto& [t, c] : m) ++df[t];
      tf.push_back(m);
      len.push_back(static_cast<double>(d.size()));
      total += static_cast<double>(d.size());
    }
    avgdl = std::max(1.0, docs.empty() ? 1.0 : total / static_cast<double>(docs.size()));
  }

  std::vector<std::pair<double, std::uint32_t>> scores(const std::vector<std::string>& q, double k1 = 1.2,
                                                       double b = 0.75) const {
    const std::set<std::string> uq(q.begin(), q.end());
    const double N = static_cast<double>(tf.size());
    std::vector<std::pair<double, std::uint32_t>> out;
    for (std::uint32_t d = 0; d < tf.size(); ++d) {
      double s = 0;
      bool any = false;
      for (const auto& t : uq) {
        const auto it = tf[d].find(t);
        if (it == tf[d].end()) continue;
        any = true;
        const double n = df.at(t), f = it->second;
        const double idf = std::log(1 + (N - n + 0.5) / (n + 0.5));
        s += idf * f * (k1 + 1) / (f + k1 * (1 - b + b * len[d] / avgdl));
      }
      if (any) out.push_back({s, d});
    }
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end(), [](auto& x, auto& y) { return x.first != y.first ? x.first > y.first : x.second < y.second; });
    return out;
  }
};

// ------------------------------ embedding ------------------------------------
// Spec: signed feature hashing of every non-stopword unigram (weight 1) and of
// each adjacent pair of non-stopword unigrams (weight 0.5), bucket =
// floor(h32 * D / 2^32), sign = top bit, then L2 normalisation.
inline std::vector<double> embed(const std::vector<Word>& words, std::size_t D) {
  std::vector<double> v(D, 0.0);
  auto add = [&](std::uint64_t h, double w) {
    const std::size_t idx = static_cast<std::size_t>((std::uint64_t{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(h)} * D) >> 32);
    v[idx] += (h >> 63) ? -w : w;
  };
  std::uint64_t prev = 0;
  for (const auto& w : words) {
    if (stopwords().count(w.text)) continue;
    const std::uint64_t h = hash_term(w.text);
    add(h, 1.0);
    if (prev) add(detail::mix64(prev * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull ^ h), 0.5);
    prev = h;
  }
  double nn = 0;
  for (double x : v) nn += x * x;
  if (nn > 0)
    for (double& x : v) x /= std::sqrt(nn);
  return v;
}

// --------------------------------- RRF ---------------------------------------
inline std::vector<std::pair<double, std::uint32_t>> rrf(const std::vector<std::uint32_t>& a,
                                                         const std::vector<std::uint32_t>& b, double k0 = 60) {
  std::map<std::uint32_t, double> s;
  for (std::size_t r = 0; r < a.size(); ++r) s[a[r]] += 1.0 / (k0 + static_cast<double>(r + 1));
  for (std::size_t r = 0; r < b.size(); ++r) s[b[r]] += 1.0 / (k0 + static_cast<double>(r + 1));
  std::vector<std::pair<double, std::uint32_t>> out;
  for (auto [id, sc] : s) out.push_back({sc, id});
  std::sort(out.begin(), out.end(), [](auto& x, auto& y) { return x.first != y.first ? x.first > y.first : x.second < y.second; });
  return out;
}

}  // namespace ref

namespace {

constexpr std::size_t kD = 384;
using Engine = RagEngine<HashingEmbedder<kD>>;

// Random documents built to stress tokenization and scoring.
std::string random_doc(std::mt19937& rng, std::size_t words) {
  static const std::vector<std::string> vocab = [] {
    std::vector<std::string> v = {"Order", "book", "VWAP", "vwap", "imbalance", "AND", "spread", "bid", "ask",
                                  "queue", "latency", "ZX81Q", "café", "crème", "brûlée", "naïve", "42", "x86",
                                  "L2", "tick", "tick", "TICK", "venue", "it's"};
    for (const auto& w : ref::stopwords()) v.push_back(w);  // every stopword appears in the corpora
    return v;
  }();
  static const std::vector<std::string> seps = {" ", "  ", ", ", ". ", "\n", "\t", " -- ", "/", "(", ") ", "!?"};
  std::string s;
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < words; ++i) {
    s += vocab[rng() % vocab.size()];
    s += seps[rng() % seps.size()];
  }
  return s;
}

std::vector<std::string> nonstop_terms(const std::string& text) {
  std::vector<std::string> t;
  for (const auto& w : ref::tokenize(text))
    if (!ref::stopwords().count(w.text)) t.push_back(w.text);
  return t;
}

// Rankings agree up to near-ties: the score at every rank matches, and the
// ids match wherever the score isn't (nearly) tied with a neighbour. `want`
// must be the reference's FULL ranking, not cut to the engine's depth: a tie
// with the first candidate past the cut decides who makes the list too.
void expect_same_ranking(const std::vector<std::pair<double, std::uint32_t>>& want, std::span<const Hit> got,
                         double tol, const std::string& what) {
  const std::size_t n = std::min(want.size(), got.size());  // callers check the sizes themselves
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    EXPECT_NEAR(got[i].score, want[i].first, tol * std::max(1.0, std::abs(want[i].first))) << what << " rank " << i;
    const bool tied = (i > 0 && std::abs(want[i].first - want[i - 1].first) < 2 * tol) ||
                      (i + 1 < want.size() && std::abs(want[i].first - want[i + 1].first) < 2 * tol);
    if (!tied) {
      EXPECT_EQ(got[i].id, want[i].second) << what << " rank " << i << " score " << want[i].first << " got "
                                           << got[i].score << " neighbours "
                                           << (i > 0 ? want[i - 1].first : -1) << " / "
                                           << (i + 1 < want.size() ? want[i + 1].first : -1);
    }
  }
}

}  // namespace

TEST(Reference, StopwordSetMatchesSpecExactly) {
  std::set<std::uint64_t> want;
  for (const auto& w : ref::stopwords()) want.insert(hash_term(w));
  const std::set<std::uint64_t> got(kStopwords.begin(), kStopwords.end());
  EXPECT_EQ(got, want);
  EXPECT_EQ(kStopwords.size(), ref::stopwords().size());  // no duplicates either
}

TEST(Reference, TokenizerMatchesSpecOnRandomBytes) {
  std::mt19937 rng(1);
  for (int iter = 0; iter < 300; ++iter) {
    std::string s(rng() % 200, '\0');
    for (auto& c : s) c = static_cast<char>(rng() % 256);  // arbitrary bytes, including NUL and UTF-8
    if (iter % 2) s = random_doc(rng, rng() % 40);
    const auto want = ref::tokenize(s);
    std::vector<Token> got;
    for_each_token(s, [&](const Token& t) { got.push_back(t); });
    ASSERT_EQ(got.size(), want.size()) << "iter " << iter;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < want.size(); ++i) {
      EXPECT_EQ(got[i].offset, want[i].offset);
      EXPECT_EQ(got[i].length, want[i].length);
      EXPECT_EQ(got[i].hash, hash_term(want[i].text));  // hash of the case-folded word
    }
  }
}

  std::mt19937 rng(2);

    const auto words = ref::tokenize(s);

    std::vector<Token> toks;

    std::vector<ChunkRange> got;
    chunk_tokens(s, toks, ChunkerConfig{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(window), static_cast<std::uint32_t>(overlap)},

    ASSERT_EQ(got.size(), want.size()) << "window " << window << " overlap " << overlap;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < want.size(); ++i) {
      EXPECT_EQ(got[i].token_begin, want[i].first_word);
      EXPECT_EQ(got[i].token_end, want[i].end_word);

    }

}

TEST(Reference, EmbedderMatchesSpec) {
  std::mt19937 rng(3);
  HashingEmbedder<kD> emb;

TEST(Reference, Bm25MatchesSpecOnRandomCorpora) {
  std::mt19937 rng(4);
  for (int iter = 0; iter < 40; ++iter) {
    const std::size_t ndocs = 1 + rng() % 60;
    std::vector<std::vector<std::string>> docs;
    Bm25Builder b;
    for (std::uint32_t d = 0; d < ndocs; ++d) {
      const auto text = random_doc(rng, rng() % 30);  // includes empty and stopword-only docs
      docs.push_back(nonstop_terms(text));

      for (const auto& t : docs.back()) h.push_back(hash_term(t));
      b.add(d, h);

    const ref::Bm25 want_index(docs);
    const auto idx = b.freeze();
    Bm25Scratch sc(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ndocs));
    for (int qi = 0; qi < 10; ++qi) {
      const auto q = nonstop_terms(random_doc(rng, 1 + rng() % 5));
      std::vector<std::uint64_t> qh;
      for (const auto& t : q) qh.push_back(hash_term(t));

      idx.search(qh, sc, tk);

TEST(Reference, EnginePipelineMatchesSpecStageByStage) {
  std::mt19937 rng(5);
  for (int iter = 0; iter < 12; ++iter) {
    EngineConfig cfg;
    cfg.max_chunks = 4096;
    cfg.chunker = {static_cast<std::uint32_t>(4 + rng() % 20), 0};
    cfg.chunker.overlap_tokens = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rng() % cfg.chunker.window_tokens);
    cfg.retrieve_depth = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(1 + rng() % 32);
    Engine e(cfg);

    // Reference view of the same corpus.
    std::vector<std::string> chunk_text;
    std::vector<std::vector<double>> chunk_vec;
    std::vector<std::vector<std::string>> chunk_terms;
    const std::size_t ndocs = 5 + rng() % 40;
    for (std::uint32_t d = 0; d < ndocs; ++d) {
      const std::string doc = random_doc(rng, rng() % 80);
      e.ingest(doc, d);
      const auto words = ref::tokenize(doc);
      for (const auto& c : ref::chunk(doc, words, cfg.chunker.window_tokens, cfg.chunker.overlap_tokens)) {
        chunk_text.push_back(c.text);
        const std::vector<ref::Word> cw(words.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(c.first_word),
                                        words.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(c.end_word));
        chunk_vec.push_back(ref::embed(cw, kD));
        std::vector<std::string> t;
        for (const auto& w : cw)
          if (!ref::stopwords().count(w.text)) t.push_back(w.text);
        chunk_terms.push_back(t);
      }
    }
    e.commit();
    ASSERT_EQ(e.size(), chunk_text.size()) << "iter " << iter;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < e.size(); ++i) ASSERT_EQ(e.chunk(i).text, chunk_text[i]);
    const ref::Bm25 bm25(chunk_terms);

    auto ctx = e.make_context();
    for (int qi = 0; qi < 15; ++qi) {
      const std::string q = random_doc(rng, 1 + rng() % 6);
      const std::uint32_t k = 1 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rng() % 10);
      const auto r = e.query(q, k, ctx);
      const std::string tag = "iter " + std::to_string(iter) + " q '" + q + "'";

      // Dense: brute-force cosine in double over the reference embeddings,
      // keeping only strictly positive scores (dense_min_score = 0).
      const auto qv = ref::embed(ref::tokenize(q), kD);
      std::vector<std::pair<double, std::uint32_t>> dense_want;
      for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < chunk_vec.size(); ++i) {
        double s = 0;
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < kD; ++d) s += qv[d] * chunk_vec[i][d];
        if (s > 1e-6) dense_want.push_back({s, i});
      }
      std::sort(dense_want.begin(), dense_want.end(),
                [](auto& x, auto& y) { return x.first != y.first ? x.first > y.first : x.second < y.second; });
      ASSERT_EQ(r.dense.size(), std::min<std::size_t>(dense_want.size(), cfg.retrieve_depth)) << tag;
      expect_same_ranking(dense_want, r.dense, 1e-5, "dense " + tag);

      // Lexical: the reference BM25 over the reference chunk terms.
      const auto lex_want = bm25.scores(nonstop_terms(q));
      ASSERT_EQ(r.lexical.size(), std::min<std::size_t>(lex_want.size(), cfg.retrieve_depth)) << tag;
      expect_same_ranking(lex_want, r.lexical, 1e-5, "lexical " + tag);

      // Fusion: the reference RRF of the engine's own two lists (so near-tie
      // flips upstream can't make this comparison flaky).
      std::vector<std::uint32_t> a, b;
      for (const Hit& h : r.dense) a.push_back(h.id);
      for (const Hit& h : r.lexical) b.push_back(h.id);
      const auto fused_want = ref::rrf(a, b);
      ASSERT_EQ(r.hits.size(), std::min<std::size_t>(fused_want.size(), k)) << tag;
      expect_same_ranking(fused_want, r.hits, 1e-6, "fused " + tag);
    }
  }
}

```cpp
// stress.cpp — long-running concurrency stress test with exact invariants.
//
//   rag_stress [seconds=5] [dense_mode 0..3 = all]
//
// One writer thread continuously ingests documents, commits, and every few
// commits saves the index and reloads it into a second engine. At the same
// time:
//   * query threads issue "docN" queries. Every document contains a unique
//     token docN, so once document N is committed, BM25 must rank a chunk of
//     document N first. That is an exact check, not a heuristic, and it is
//     made against the snapshot version the query reports.
//   * a batch thread runs query_batch() and, whenever the batch and a
//     follow-up single query saw the same snapshot, requires identical
//     lexical results.
//   * a pin thread holds snapshots for random durations and requires a
//     pinned snapshot never to change underneath it.
// Throughout: hit ids are in range, snapshot versions never go backwards
// per thread, and at the end every retired snapshot has been reclaimed.
// Exits non-zero on the first violated invariant. Run it under -DRAG_TSAN=ON
// to also check for data races.
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <random>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "pid.hpp"

#include "rag.hpp"

using namespace rag;
using Engine = RagEngine<HashingEmbedder<128>, 16>;
using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;

namespace {

std::atomic<bool> g_failed{false};
std::atomic<bool> g_stop{false};

#define STRESS_CHECK(cond, ...)                                              \
  do {                                                                       \
    if (!(cond)) {                                                           \
      if (!g_failed.exchange(true)) {                                        \
        std::fprintf(stderr, "INVARIANT FAILED: %s (%s:%d): ", #cond, __FILE__, __LINE__); \
        std::fprintf(stderr, __VA_ARGS__);                                   \
        std::fprintf(stderr, "\n");                                          \
      }                                                                      \
      g_stop = true;                                                         \
      return;                                                                \
    }                                                                        \
  } while (0)

std::string doc_text(std::uint32_t n, std::mt19937& rng) {
  static const char* words[] = {"order", "book", "spread", "venue", "latency", "queue", "tick", "vwap",
                                "imbalance", "auction", "the", "of", "and", "quote", "fill", "cancel"};
  std::string s = "doc" + std::to_string(n);
  for (int i = 0; i < 20; ++i) {
    s += ' ';
    s += words[rng() % std::size(words)];
  }
  return s;
}

struct Counters {
  std::atomic<std::uint64_t> queries{0}, batches{0}, batch_checks{0}, pins{0}, exact_checks{0};
  std::atomic<std::uint64_t> commits{0}, saves{0}, docs{0};
};

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  const double seconds = argc > 1 ? std::atof(argv[1]) : 5.0;
  const int only_mode = argc > 2 ? std::atoi(argv[2]) : -1;
  const auto tmp = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / ("rag-stress-" + std::to_string(test_pid()) + ".ragidx");
  int rc = 0;

  for (int m = 0; m < 4 && !g_failed; ++m) {
    if (only_mode >= 0 && m != only_mode) continue;
    const auto mode = static_cast<DenseMode>(m);
    EngineConfig cfg;
    cfg.max_chunks = 1u << 15;
    cfg.chunker = {64, 8};  // one chunk per document
    cfg.dense_mode = mode;
    cfg.retrieve_depth = 16;
    cfg.ivf.nlist = 8;
    cfg.ivf.train_iters = 3;
    cfg.nprobe = 3;
    cfg.prompt_capacity = 4096;
    Engine e(cfg);

    // committed_docs: documents [0, committed_docs) are in the published snapshot
    // with version >= committed_version.
    std::atomic<std::uint32_t> committed_docs{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> committed_version{0};
    Counters c;
    g_stop = false;

    std::thread writer([&] {
      std::mt19937 rng(1);
      std::uint32_t n = 0;
      const auto end = Clock::now() + std::chrono::duration<double>(seconds);
      while (!g_stop && Clock::now() < end && e.size() + 4 < cfg.max_chunks) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; ++i, ++n) e.ingest(doc_text(n, rng), n);
        c.docs = n;
        e.commit();
        ++c.commits;
        // Publish after commit: any snapshot with version >= this one covers [0, n).
        committed_version.store(c.commits.load(), std::memory_order_release);
        committed_docs.store(n, std::memory_order_release);
        if (c.commits % 10 == 0) {  // save + reload while queries keep running
          e.save(tmp);
          const auto copy = Engine::load(tmp, cfg);
          STRESS_CHECK(copy->size() == e.size(), "reloaded %u chunks, expected %u", copy->size(), e.size());
          ++c.saves;
        }
      }
      g_stop = true;
    });

    auto query_thread = [&](unsigned seed) {
      auto ctx = e.make_context();
      std::mt19937 rng(seed);
      std::uint64_t last_version = 0;
      while (!g_stop) {
        const std::uint32_t done = committed_docs.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        const std::uint64_t at_least = committed_version.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (done == 0) { std::this_thread::yield(); continue; }
        const std::uint32_t target = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rng() % done);
        const std::string q = "doc" + std::to_string(target);
        const auto r = e.query(q, 8, ctx);
        const std::uint32_t n = e.size();
        STRESS_CHECK(r.snapshot_version >= last_version, "version went backwards %llu -> %llu",
                     (unsigned long long)last_version, (unsigned long long)r.snapshot_version);
        last_version = r.snapshot_version;
        for (const Hit& h : r.hits) STRESS_CHECK(h.id < n, "hit id %u >= size %u", h.id, n);
        for (const Hit& h : r.lexical) STRESS_CHECK(h.id < n, "lexical id %u >= size %u", h.id, n);
        // Exact check: document `target` was committed in a snapshot no newer
        // than the one this query used, so BM25 must rank it first.
        if (r.snapshot_version >= at_least) {
          STRESS_CHECK(!r.lexical.empty(), "no lexical hit for committed %s (v%llu)", q.c_str(),
                       (unsigned long long)r.snapshot_version);
          STRESS_CHECK(e.chunk(r.lexical[0].id).doc_id == target, "%s ranked doc %u first", q.c_str(),
                       e.chunk(r.lexical[0].id).doc_id);
          ++c.exact_checks;
        }
        ++c.queries;
      }
    };

    std::thread batcher([&] {
      std::vector<Engine::QueryContext> ctxs;
      for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) ctxs.push_back(e.make_context());
      auto single = e.make_context();
      std::array<Engine::QueryResult, 8> out;
      std::array<std::string, 8> qs;
      std::array<std::string_view, 8> views;
      std::mt19937 rng(99);
      while (!g_stop) {
        const std::uint32_t done = committed_docs.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (done == 0) { std::this_thread::yield(); continue; }
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
          qs[i] = "doc" + std::to_string(rng() % done) + " vwap";
          views[i] = qs[i];
        }
        e.query_batch(views, 6, ctxs, out);
        const std::uint32_t n = e.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
          for (const Hit& h : out[i].hits) STRESS_CHECK(h.id < n, "batch hit id %u >= %u", h.id, n);
          const auto s = e.query(views[i], 6, single);
          if (s.snapshot_version == out[i].snapshot_version) {  // same snapshot => same lexical answer
            STRESS_CHECK(s.lexical.size() == out[i].lexical.size(), "batch/single lexical size differ");
            for (std::size_t k = 0; k < s.lexical.size(); ++k)
              STRESS_CHECK(s.lexical[k] == out[i].lexical[k], "batch/single lexical differ at %zu", k);
            ++c.batch_checks;
          }
        }
        ++c.batches;
      }
    });

    std::thread pinner([&] {
      auto ctx = e.make_context();
      std::mt19937 rng(7);
      while (!g_stop) {
        const auto pin = e.pin(ctx);
        const auto version = pin->version;
        const auto docs = pin->bm25.num_docs();
        const auto covered = pin->covered;
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(rng() % 2000));
        // Commits happen meanwhile; the pinned snapshot must be untouched.
        STRESS_CHECK(pin->version == version && pin->bm25.num_docs() == docs && pin->covered == covered,
                     "pinned snapshot changed under the pin");
        ++c.pins;
      }
    });

    std::vector<std::thread> readers;
    for (unsigned t = 0; t < 2; ++t) readers.emplace_back(query_thread, 100 + t);
    writer.join();
    for (auto& t : readers) t.join();
    batcher.join();
    pinner.join();

    const std::size_t left = e.reclaim();
    if (!g_failed && (left != 0 || e.live_readers() != 0)) {
      std::fprintf(stderr, "INVARIANT FAILED: %zu snapshots unreclaimed, %zu readers registered\n", left, e.live_readers());
      g_failed = true;
    }
    std::printf("%-11s docs=%llu commits=%llu saves=%llu queries=%llu exact_checks=%llu batches=%llu "
                "batch_checks=%llu pins=%llu\n",
                m == 0 ? "exact" : m == 1 ? "int8+rerank" : m == 2 ? "ivf" : "ivf-sq8", (unsigned long long)c.docs.load(),
                (unsigned long long)c.commits.load(), (unsigned long long)c.saves.load(), (unsigned long long)c.queries.load(),
                (unsigned long long)c.exact_checks.load(), (unsigned long long)c.batches.load(),
                (unsigned long long)c.batch_checks.load(), (unsigned long long)c.pins.load());
    if (!g_failed && (c.exact_checks == 0 || c.batch_checks == 0 || c.pins == 0 || c.saves == 0)) {
      std::fprintf(stderr, "stress run too short to exercise every check\n");
      rc = 2;
    }
  }
  std::error_code ec;
  std::filesystem::remove(tmp, ec);
  if (g_failed) return 1;
  std::printf("%s\n", rc ? "INCOMPLETE" : "OK");
  return rc;
}

// stylized_tests.cpp — the tick CSV reader and the stylized-facts meter used
// to calibrate the ES simulator against recorded ticks.
#include <gtest/gtest.h>

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>

#include "rag/orderflow/stylized.hpp"
#include "rag/orderflow/tick_csv.hpp"

using namespace rag::orderflow;

namespace {
struct Recorder {
  std::vector<Trade> trades;
  std::vector<Quote> quotes;
  void add_trade(const Trade& t) { trades.push_back(t); }
  void end_bucket(const Quote& q) { quotes.push_back(q); }
};
}  // namespace

TEST(TickCsv, ParsesTradesQuotesAndBucketsThem) {
  std::istringstream in(
      "# header\n"
      "Q,0.00,5000.00,5000.25,10,11,12,13,14,20,21,22,23,24\n"
      "T,0.05,5000.25,3,B\n"
      "T,0.07,5000.00,2,S\n"
      "Q,0.12,5000.25,5000.50\n"
      "bad,line\n"
      "T,0.31,5000.50,1,X\n"  // bad side: skipped
      "T,100.0,5001.00,4,B\n");  // after a gap > 60 s
  Recorder r;
  const auto st = replay_tick_csv(in, r, TickCsvOptions{.time_unit = "s"});
  EXPECT_EQ(st.trades, 3u);
  EXPECT_EQ(st.quotes, 2u);
  EXPECT_EQ(st.skipped, 2u);
  EXPECT_EQ(st.gaps, 1u);
  ASSERT_EQ(r.trades.size(), 3u);
  EXPECT_EQ(r.trades[0].price, 20001);  // 5000.25 / 0.25
  EXPECT_EQ(r.trades[0].aggressor, Side::Buy);
  EXPECT_EQ(r.trades[1].aggressor, Side::Sell);
  ASSERT_FALSE(r.quotes.empty());
  EXPECT_EQ(r.quotes[0].bid, 20000);
  EXPECT_EQ(r.quotes[0].ask, 20001);
  EXPECT_EQ(r.quotes[0].bid_size[0], 10u);
  EXPECT_EQ(r.quotes[0].ask_size[4], 24u);
  EXPECT_EQ(r.quotes.back().bid, 20001);  // the second quote (no depth given: sizes 0)
  EXPECT_THROW(replay_tick_csv(in, r, TickCsvOptions{.tick_size = 0}), std::invalid_argument);
}

TEST(StylizedMeter, CsvRoundTripReproducesTheSimulatorsFacts) {
  // Simulator ticks written in the CSV format and read back must give the
  // same facts as measuring the simulator directly.
  const SimParams p;
  EsSimulator sim(p, 4, 3600);
  StylizedMeter direct(p.dt);
  std::ostringstream csv;
  csv.precision(12);
  for (int s = 0; s < 6000; ++s) {  // 10 minutes
    sim.step();
    const double t = static_cast<double>(sim.t_ns()) * 1e-9;
    for (const auto& tr : sim.trades()) {
      direct.add_trade(tr);
      csv << "T," << t << "," << tr.price * 0.25 << "," << tr.size << "," << (tr.aggressor == Side::Buy ? 'B' : 'S') << "\n";
    }
    const Quote q = sim.quote();
    direct.end_bucket(q);
    csv << "Q," << t + 0.0005 << "," << q.bid * 0.25 << "," << q.ask * 0.25;
    for (auto v : q.bid_size) csv << "," << v;
    for (auto v : q.ask_size) csv << "," << v;
    csv << "\n";
  }
  StylizedMeter replayed(p.dt);
  std::istringstream in(csv.str());
  const auto st = replay_tick_csv(in, replayed, TickCsvOptions{.time_unit = "s"});
  EXPECT_EQ(st.skipped, 0u);
  const auto a = direct.facts(), b = replayed.facts();
  EXPECT_NEAR(a.trades_per_sec, b.trades_per_sec, 0.02 * a.trades_per_sec);
  EXPECT_NEAR(a.mean_trade_size, b.mean_trade_size, 1e-9);
  EXPECT_NEAR(a.spread1_share, b.spread1_share, 0.01);
  EXPECT_NEAR(a.ret1m_sd, b.ret1m_sd, 0.1 * a.ret1m_sd + 0.05);
  EXPECT_NEAR(a.sign_ac1, b.sign_ac1, 1e-9);  // same prints in the same order
  EXPECT_GT(a.trades_per_sec, 1.0);
}

TEST(TickCsv, SimWriterMatchesTheOldExportAndWritesSessionsFromTheOpen) {
  // write_sim_ticks must give of_calibrate export's bytes as they were
  // (the former inline fprintf loop, reproduced here with snprintf).
  auto old_export = [](EsSimulator& sim, std::size_t steps) {
    std::string s = "# ES simulator ticks: T,time_s,price,size,side / Q,time_s,bid,ask,bid sizes x5,ask sizes x5\n";
    char b[64];
    for (std::size_t k = 0; k < steps; ++k) {
      sim.step();
      const double t = static_cast<double>(sim.t_ns()) * 1e-9;
      for (const auto& tr : sim.trades()) {
        std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, "T,%.3f,%.2f,%u,%c\n", t, tr.price * 0.25, tr.size, tr.aggressor == Side::Buy ? 'B' : 'S');
        s += b;
      }
      const Quote q = sim.quote();
      std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, "Q,%.3f,%.2f,%.2f", t + 0.0005, q.bid * 0.25, q.ask * 0.25);
      s += b;
      for (auto v : q.bid_size) s += "," + std::to_string(v);
      for (auto v : q.ask_size) s += "," + std::to_string(v);
      s += "\n";
    }
    return s;
  };
  auto written = [](EsSimulator& sim, std::size_t steps) {
    std::string s;
    write_sim_ticks(sim, steps, [&s](const char* p, std::size_t n) { s.append(p, n); });
    return s;
  };
  EsSimulator a(SimParams{}, 7, 3600), b(SimParams{}, 7, 3600);
  const std::string old_text = old_export(a, 3000), new_text = written(b, 3000);
  EXPECT_GT(old_text.size(), 100000u);
  EXPECT_EQ(old_text, new_text);
  // The opt-in form: a discovery session from the open (start second 0).
  EsSimulator d(market_preset("discovery"), 960'000'001, 0);
  std::istringstream in(written(d, 600));
  Recorder r;
  const auto st = replay_tick_csv(in, r, TickCsvOptions{.time_unit = "s"});
  EXPECT_EQ(st.skipped, 0u);
  EXPECT_EQ(st.quotes, 600u);
  EXPECT_GT(st.trades, 100u);
  ASSERT_FALSE(r.trades.empty());
  EXPECT_LE(r.trades.front().t_ns, 60'000'000'000);  // times count from the open
  EXPECT_GT(r.quotes.front().bid_size[0], 0u);
}

  EXPECT_GT(f.trades_per_sec, 3);

#include "rag/orderflow/replay_env.hpp"

TEST(ReplayScalpEnv, FillsAtTheRecordedTouchWithFeesAndWindowsTheTape) {
  // 20 minutes of a constant market: bid 5000.00 x 50, ask 5000.25 x 50, one print per second.
  std::ostringstream csv;
  for (int i = 0; i < 12000; ++i) {
    const double t = i * 0.1;
    if (i % 10 == 0) csv << "T," << t << ",5000.25,1,B\n";
    csv << "Q," << t + 0.0005 << ",5000.00,5000.25,50,50,50,50,50,50,50,50,50,50\n";
  }
  std::istringstream in(csv.str());
  auto tape = std::make_shared<const TickTape>(TickTape::from_stream(in, TickCsvOptions{.time_unit = "s"}));
  ReplayParams p;
  p.window_seconds = 300;
  ReplayScalpEnv env(tape, p);
  EXPECT_EQ(env.windows(), 3u);  // (1200 s - 150 s warm-up) / 300 s
  rag::agent::Rng r(1);
  for (rag::agent::Action a : {rag::agent::Action{1}, rag::agent::Action{2}}) {
    auto o = env.seek(1);
    double total = 0;
    for (;;) {
      const auto s = env.step(a, r);
      total += s.reward;
      o = s.obs;
      if (s.done) break;
    }
    EXPECT_NEAR(total, env.net_pnl_ticks(), 1e-9);
    if (a == 1) {
      EXPECT_EQ(env.net_pnl_ticks(), 0.0);
    } else {
      // Long once at the ask, out at the bid in an unchanged market: one tick of spread plus two fees.
      EXPECT_EQ(env.orders(), 2u);
      EXPECT_NEAR(env.net_pnl_ticks(), -1.0 - 2 * p.fee_dollars / kTickValue, 1e-9);
    }
  }
  EXPECT_THROW(env.seek(3), std::out_of_range);
}

// --- agent memory: NeuralQ allocates no tile tables ------------------------------
#include "rag/agent/agent.hpp"
#include "rag/orderflow/tick_env.hpp"

TEST(NeuralQMemory, HighDimensionalEnvironmentsNeedNoTileTables) {
  // 21 inputs at the default 8 bins would need 9^21 tile cells per table;
  // NeuralQ never uses them, so construction and snapshots must stay small.
  TickScalpEnv env;
  rag::agent::AgentConfig<TickScalpEnv::kStateDims> c;
  c.learner = rag::agent::LearnerKind::NeuralQ;
  c.double_q = true;
  c.nn_polyak = 1e-4;
  rag::agent::Agent<TickScalpEnv> agent(env, c);
  const auto snap = agent.snapshot();
  EXPECT_EQ(snap.q.weights().size(), 0u);
  EXPECT_EQ(snap.q2.weights().size(), 0u);
  EXPECT_GT(snap.net.parameters(), 0u);
  rag::agent::Rng r(1);
  auto o = env.reset(r);
  const auto a = agent.act(o, true);
  EXPECT_LT(a, TickScalpEnv::kNumActions);
}

// text_clean_tests.cpp — cleanup of extracted page text (no PDF dependency).
#include <gtest/gtest.h>

#include "pid.hpp"

#include <random>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "rag.hpp"
#include "rag/text_clean.hpp"

using namespace rag;
using namespace rag::text;

TEST(TextClean, LigaturesBecomeLettersSoQueriesMatch) {
  // (Literals are split after each escape: "\x80ect" would parse as one hex escape.)
  EXPECT_EQ(normalize_chars("\xEF\xAC\x81" "nance \xEF\xAC\x82" "ow e\xEF\xAC\x80" "ect \xEF\xAC\x83" "x \xEF\xAC\x84"
                            "e \xEF\xAC\x85" "op"),
            "finance flow effect ffix ffle stop");
  // The point: after cleanup the tokenizer sees the same term as the query.
  std::vector<Token> t;
  const std::string cleaned = normalize_chars("\xEF\xAC\x81" "nance");
  for_each_token(cleaned, [&](const Token& x) { t.push_back(x); });
  ASSERT_EQ(t.size(), 1u);
  EXPECT_EQ(t[0].hash, hash_term("finance"));
}

TEST(TextClean, InvisibleAndUnusualSpaceCharacters) {
  EXPECT_EQ(normalize_chars("co\xC2\xADoperate"), "cooperate");           // soft hyphen
  EXPECT_EQ(normalize_chars("a\xC2\xA0" "b"), "a b");                     // NBSP
  EXPECT_EQ(normalize_chars("a\xE2\x80\x83" "b\xE2\x80\xAF" "c"), "a b c");  // em space, narrow NBSP
  EXPECT_EQ(normalize_chars("zero\xE2\x80\x8Bwidth"), "zerowidth");       // ZWSP
  EXPECT_EQ(normalize_chars("\xEF\xBB\xBFstart"), "start");               // BOM
  EXPECT_EQ(normalize_chars("pre\xE2\x80\x91" "trade"), "pre-trade");     // non-breaking hyphen
  EXPECT_EQ(normalize_chars("a\r\nb\rc\fd\ve"), "a\nb\nc\nd\ne");
  EXPECT_EQ(normalize_chars(std::string("x\0y\x1bz\tq", 8)), "xyz q");    // controls dropped, tab -> space
  // Everything else passes through, including invalid UTF-8 and truncated sequences.
  EXPECT_EQ(normalize_chars("caf\xC3\xA9 \xFF\xFE \xEF\xAC"), "caf\xC3\xA9 \xFF\xFE \xEF\xAC");
  // Malformed sequences whose prefix looks like a ligature or a Unicode space
  // (found by the random test: the ligature table index used to underflow).
  EXPECT_EQ(normalize_chars("\xEF\xAC" "A"), "\xEF\xAC" "A");
  EXPECT_EQ(normalize_chars("\xE2\x80" "A"), "\xE2\x80" "A");
}

TEST(TextClean, ReflowJoinsLinesAndDehyphenates) {
  CleanOptions o;
  EXPECT_EQ(reflow("Market micro-\nstructure studies\n  how   orders\tbecome prices.", o),
            "Market microstructure studies how orders become prices.");
  EXPECT_EQ(reflow("First para line one\nline two\n\n\nSecond para", o), "First para line one line two\n\nSecond para");
  // Not a line-break hyphenation: next line starts uppercase or with a digit, or no letter before '-'.
  EXPECT_EQ(reflow("Anglo-\nSaxon", o), "Anglo- Saxon");
  EXPECT_EQ(reflow("pages 10-\n12", o), "pages 10- 12");
  EXPECT_EQ(reflow("x -\nfoo", o), "x - foo");
  CleanOptions keep = o;
  keep.dehyphenate = false;
  EXPECT_EQ(reflow("micro-\nstructure", keep), "micro- structure");
  keep.join_lines = false;
  EXPECT_EQ(reflow("a\nb\n\nc", keep), "a\nb\n\nc");
  EXPECT_EQ(reflow("\n\n   \n", o), "");
}

TEST(TextClean, LineKeyIgnoresCaseDigitsAndSpacing) {
  EXPECT_EQ(line_key("  Page 3   of 10 "), "page # of #");
  EXPECT_EQ(line_key("PAGE 12 OF 10"), "page # of #");
  EXPECT_EQ(line_key("- 7 -"), "- # -");
  EXPECT_EQ(line_key("2024-01-31"), "#-#-#");
  // Long lines keep their digits: they must repeat exactly to count as running.
  EXPECT_EQ(line_key("Q3 revenue grew 12% year on year"), "q3 revenue grew 12% year on year");
}

TEST(TextClean, BodyLinesThatDifferOnlyInNumbersAreNotHeaders) {
  // Short pages (slides): every line is an "edge" line. Lines that differ only
  // in their numbers must survive, while the exact repeat is removed.
  std::vector<std::string> slides;
  for (int q = 1; q <= 4; ++q)
    slides.push_back("Acme Investor Update\nQ" + std::to_string(q) + " revenue grew " + std::to_string(10 + q) +
                     "% year on year in every region");
  const auto out = clean_pages(slides);
  for (int q = 1; q <= 4; ++q) {
    EXPECT_EQ(out[q - 1], "Q" + std::to_string(q) + " revenue grew " + std::to_string(10 + q) +
                              "% year on year in every region");
  }
}

TEST(TextClean, StripsRunningHeadersFootersAndPageNumbers) {
  std::vector<std::string> pages;
  for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i)
    pages.push_back("ACME Research | Q3 Report\nBody text of page " + std::to_string(i) +
                    " mentions ACME Research | Q3 Report in the middle.\nMore body.\n- " + std::to_string(i) + " -");
  const auto out = clean_pages(pages);
  for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
    EXPECT_EQ(out[i].find("- " + std::to_string(i + 1) + " -"), std::string::npos) << out[i];  // page number gone
    EXPECT_NE(out[i].rfind("Body text of page", 0), std::string::npos) << out[i];  // header gone: body comes first
    EXPECT_NE(out[i].find("mentions ACME Research | Q3 Report in the middle"), std::string::npos);  // body copy kept
  }
}

TEST(TextClean, KeepsRepeatsInShortDocumentsAndRareLines) {
  // One page: nothing can repeat.
  EXPECT_EQ(clean_pages({"Report Title\nalpha\nPage 1"})[0], "Report Title alpha Page 1");
  // Two pages: a header/footer must be on both to count (found on real 2-page
  // handouts, where it used to survive).
  const auto two = clean_pages({"Risk Controls - Acme\nalpha\nPage 1", "Risk Controls - Acme\nbeta\nPage 2"});
  EXPECT_EQ(two[0], "alpha");
  EXPECT_EQ(two[1], "beta");
  const auto one_sided = clean_pages({"Risk Controls - Acme\nalpha", "Appendix\nbeta"});
  EXPECT_EQ(one_sided[0], "Risk Controls - Acme alpha");
  // A line at the top of only 1 of 5 pages is content, not a header.
  std::vector<std::string> five = {"Chapter One\nalpha", "x\nbeta", "y\ngamma", "z\ndelta", "w\nepsilon"};
  EXPECT_EQ(clean_pages(five)[0], "Chapter One alpha");
  // Threshold is configurable.
  CleanOptions strict;
  strict.repeated_line_fraction = 1.0;  // must be on every page
  std::vector<std::string> p = {"H\na", "H\nb", "c", "H\nd"};
  EXPECT_EQ(clean_pages(p, strict)[0], "H a");
  CleanOptions off;
  off.strip_repeated_lines = false;
  EXPECT_EQ(clean_pages({"H\na", "H\nb", "H\nc"}, off)[1], "H b");
}

TEST(TextClean, JoinPagesGivesStrictlyIncreasingStartsEvenWithEmptyPages) {
  const auto j = join_pages({"", "B", "", "", "CC", ""});
  ASSERT_EQ(j.page_starts.size(), 6u);
  for (std::size_t i = 1; i < 6; ++i) EXPECT_GT(j.page_starts[i], j.page_starts[i - 1]);
  EXPECT_EQ(j.text.substr(j.page_starts[1], 1), "B");
  EXPECT_EQ(j.text.substr(j.page_starts[4], 2), "CC");
  EXPECT_LE(j.page_starts.back(), j.text.size());
  EXPECT_TRUE(join_pages({}).page_starts.empty());
}

TEST(TextClean, RandomInputInvariants) {
  std::mt19937 rng(77);
  for (int it = 0; it < 500; ++it) {
    std::vector<std::string> pages(1 + rng() % 6);
    for (auto& p : pages) {
      p.resize(rng() % 120);
      for (auto& c : p) c = static_cast<char>(rng() % 4 == 0 ? '\n' : rng() % 256);
    }
    const auto out = clean_pages(pages);
    ASSERT_EQ(out.size(), pages.size());
    for (const auto& p : out) {
      for (unsigned char c : p) ASSERT_TRUE(c >= 0x20 || c == '\n') << "control char survived";
      EXPECT_EQ(p.find("\n\n\n"), std::string::npos);
      EXPECT_EQ(p.find("  "), std::string::npos);
      if (!p.empty()) {
        EXPECT_NE(p.front(), ' ');
        EXPECT_NE(p.back(), ' ');
        EXPECT_NE(p.back(), '\n');
      }
    }
  }
}

// ----------------------- engine: source and page metadata ---------------------
using Engine = RagEngine<HashingEmbedder<384>>;

TEST(PagedIngest, ChunksRecordSourceAndPageSpanAndPromptCitesThem) {
  EngineConfig cfg;
  cfg.max_chunks = 256;
  cfg.chunker = {8, 0};
  Engine e(cfg);
  // Page 1: 10 words, page 2: 6 words; window 8 => chunks [0,8) p.1, [8,16) pp.1-2.
  const std::string text = "alpha beta gamma delta epsilon zeta eta theta iota kappa\n\nlambda mu nu xi omicron pi";
  const std::uint32_t starts[] = {0, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(text.find("lambda"))};
  ASSERT_EQ(e.ingest(text, 3, IngestOptions{.source = "greek.pdf", .page_starts = starts}), 2u);
  e.ingest("no pages here at all", 4, IngestOptions{.source = "notes.txt"});
  e.ingest("plain text with nothing extra", 5);
  e.commit();
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(0).source, "greek.pdf");
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(0).page_first, 1u);
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(0).page_last, 1u);
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(1).page_first, 1u);
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(1).page_last, 2u);
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(0).source.data(), e.chunk(1).source.data());  // interned once
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(2).page_first, 0u);

  auto ctx = e.make_context();
  EXPECT_NE(e.query("alpha gamma", 1, ctx).prompt.prompt.find("[1] (greek.pdf, p. 1)\n"), std::string_view::npos);
  EXPECT_NE(e.query("lambda omicron iota", 1, ctx).prompt.prompt.find("[1] (greek.pdf, pp. 1-2)\n"), std::string_view::npos);
  EXPECT_NE(e.query("nothing extra plain", 1, ctx).prompt.prompt.find("[1] (doc 5, chunk 0)\n"), std::string_view::npos);
  EXPECT_NE(e.query("pages here", 1, ctx).prompt.prompt.find("[1] (notes.txt, chunk 0)\n"), std::string_view::npos);
}

TEST(PagedIngest, RejectsBadPageOffsetsWithoutChangingTheEngine) {
  Engine e(EngineConfig{.max_chunks = 16});
  const std::string t = "one two three four";
  const std::uint32_t not_zero[] = {2}, not_increasing[] = {0, 5, 5}, too_far[] = {0, 999};
  EXPECT_THROW(e.ingest(t, 0, IngestOptions{.page_starts = not_zero}), std::invalid_argument);
  EXPECT_THROW(e.ingest(t, 0, IngestOptions{.page_starts = not_increasing}), std::invalid_argument);
  EXPECT_THROW(e.ingest(t, 0, IngestOptions{.page_starts = too_far}), std::invalid_argument);
  EXPECT_EQ(e.size(), 0u);
  EXPECT_EQ(e.arena_bytes(), 0u);  // nothing was copied before validation failed
}

TEST(PagedIngest, LongSourceNamesAreCutAtUtf8BoundaryInCitations) {
  Engine e(EngineConfig{.max_chunks = 16});
  std::string name;
  for (int i = 0; i < 70; ++i) name += "\xC3\xA9";  // 140 bytes of 'é'
  e.ingest("orderbook depth", 0, IngestOptions{.source = name});
  e.commit();
  auto ctx = e.make_context();
  const auto p = e.query("orderbook", 1, ctx).prompt.prompt;
  const auto open = p.find("[1] (") + 5, close = p.find(", chunk 0)");
  const std::string_view shown = p.substr(open, close - open);
  EXPECT_LE(shown.size(), 120u);
  EXPECT_EQ(shown.substr(shown.size() - 3), "...");
  EXPECT_EQ((shown.size() - 3) % 2, 0u);  // whole 2-byte characters only
  EXPECT_EQ(e.chunk(0).source, name);     // the stored name is complete
}

TEST(PagedIngest, SourcesAndPagesSurviveSaveAndLoadAndKeepInterning) {
  Engine e(EngineConfig{.max_chunks = 64});
  const std::string t = "first page words here\n\nsecond page words there";
  const std::uint32_t starts[] = {0, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(t.find("second"))};
  e.ingest(t, 1, IngestOptions{.source = "a.pdf", .page_starts = starts});
  e.ingest("unsourced text", 2);
  e.commit();
  const auto path = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / ("paged-" + std::to_string(test_pid()) + ".ragidx");
  e.save(path);
  const auto info = Engine::inspect(path);
  EXPECT_EQ(info.format_version, io::kFormatVersion);
  EXPECT_EQ(info.chunks, e.size());
  EXPECT_EQ(info.dim, 384u);
  auto l = Engine::load(path, EngineConfig{.max_chunks = 64});
  std::filesystem::remove(path);
  for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < e.size(); ++i) {
    EXPECT_EQ(l->chunk(i).source, e.chunk(i).source);
    EXPECT_EQ(l->chunk(i).page_first, e.chunk(i).page_first);
    EXPECT_EQ(l->chunk(i).page_last, e.chunk(i).page_last);
  }
  l->ingest("more from the same file", 3, IngestOptions{.source = "a.pdf"});
  EXPECT_EQ(l->chunk(l->size() - 1).source.data(), l->chunk(0).source.data());  // reloaded names are interned
}

// Minimal PDF writer for test fixtures: multi-page documents of text lines in
// Helvetica (WinAnsiEncoding), optionally in two columns, with a valid xref
// table and an optional /Title. Deterministic and dependency-free, so tests
// never rely on binary files checked into the repository.
#pragma once

#include <cstdio>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace rag::testutil {

struct PdfPage {
  PdfPage() = default;
  PdfPage(std::vector<std::string> l, std::vector<std::string> right = {})
      : lines(std::move(l)), right_column(std::move(right)) {}
  std::vector<std::string> lines;        // UTF-8; Latin-1 characters are encoded as WinAnsi
  std::vector<std::string> right_column; // optional second column, set beside `lines`
};

namespace detail {
// PDF string literal body: escape ( ) \ and map Latin-1 UTF-8 sequences to one byte.
inline std::string pdf_escape(const std::string& s) {
  std::string out;
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
    const auto c = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]);
    if (c == '(' || c == ')' || c == '\\') { out += '\\'; out += static_cast<char>(c); continue; }
    if ((c == 0xC2 || c == 0xC3) && i + 1 < s.size()) {  // U+0080..U+00FF
      const unsigned v = ((c & 0x1Fu) << 6) | (static_cast<unsigned char>(s[++i]) & 0x3Fu);
      char oct[8];
      std::snprintf(oct, sizeof oct, "\\%03o", v);
      out += oct;
      continue;
    }
    out += static_cast<char>(c);
  }
  return out;
}

inline std::string column(const std::vector<std::string>& lines, int x) {
  std::string s = "BT /F1 10 Tf 13 TL " + std::to_string(x) + " 740 Td\n";
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < lines.size(); ++i) s += (i ? "T* (" : "(") + pdf_escape(lines[i]) + ") Tj\n";
  return s + "ET\n";
}
}  // namespace detail

inline void write_pdf(const std::string& path, const std::vector<PdfPage>& pages, const std::string& title = "") {
  std::vector<std::string> objs;  // objs[i] is object i+1
  const std::size_t n = pages.size();
  // 1 catalog, 2 pages tree, 3 font, 4 info, then (page, contents) pairs.
  std::string kids;
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) kids += std::to_string(5 + 2 * i) + " 0 R ";
  objs.push_back("<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>");
  objs.push_back("<< /Type /Pages /Kids [" + kids + "] /Count " + std::to_string(n) + " >>");
  objs.push_back("<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>");
  objs.push_back("<< /Title (" + detail::pdf_escape(title) + ") /Producer (rag-cpp tests) >>");
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    const bool two = !pages[i].right_column.empty();
    std::string content = detail::column(pages[i].lines, 56);
    if (two) content += detail::column(pages[i].right_column, 320);
    objs.push_back("<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Resources << /Font << /F1 3 0 R >> >> "
                   "/Contents " + std::to_string(6 + 2 * i) + " 0 R >>");
    objs.push_back("<< /Length " + std::to_string(content.size()) + " >>\nstream\n" + content + "endstream");
  }
  std::string out = "%PDF-1.4\n%\xE2\xE3\xCF\xD3\n";
  std::vector<std::size_t> offsets;
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < objs.size(); ++i) {
    offsets.push_back(out.size());
    out += std::to_string(i + 1) + " 0 obj\n" + objs[i] + "\nendobj\n";
  }
  const std::size_t xref = out.size();
  out += "xref\n0 " + std::to_string(objs.size() + 1) + "\n0000000000 65535 f \n";
  for (auto off : offsets) {
    char line[24];
    std::snprintf(line, sizeof line, "%010zu 00000 n \n", off);
    out += line;
  }
  out += "trailer\n<< /Size " + std::to_string(objs.size() + 1) + " /Root 1 0 R /Info 4 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" +
         std::to_string(xref) + "\n%%EOF\n";
  std::ofstream(path, std::ios::binary) << out;
}

}  // namespace rag::testutil

```

// Synthetic data shared by tests and benchmarks (deterministic, seeded).
#pragma once

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <random>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/simd.hpp"
#include "rag/vector_store.hpp"

namespace rag::synth {

// Clustered unit vectors: realistic for ANN (real embeddings are far from
// uniform on the sphere) and makes IVF recall meaningful. `noise` is the
// noise-to-signal norm ratio (per-dim sigma = noise / sqrt(D)).
template <std::size_t D>
void fill_clustered(VectorStore<D>& store, std::uint32_t n, std::uint32_t clusters, float noise,
                    std::uint64_t seed = 42) {
  std::mt19937_64 rng(seed);
  std::normal_distribution<float> g(0.f, 1.f);
  std::vector<float> centers(std::size_t{clusters} * D);
  for (auto& c : centers) c = g(rng);
  for (std::uint32_t c = 0; c < clusters; ++c) simd::normalize(centers.data() + std::size_t{c} * D, D);
  std::vector<float> v(D);
  const float sigma = noise / std::sqrt(static_cast<float>(D));
  for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    const float* c = centers.data() + std::size_t{rng() % clusters} * D;
    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < D; ++d) v[d] = c[d] + sigma * g(rng);
    simd::normalize(v.data(), D);
    store.append(std::span<const float, D>(v.data(), D));
  }
}

template <std::size_t D>
std::vector<float> random_queries(std::uint32_t n, std::uint64_t seed, const VectorStore<D>& base, float noise) {
  // Perturbed copies of stored rows: queries land near real data, as in practice.
  std::mt19937_64 rng(seed);
  std::normal_distribution<float> g(0.f, 1.f);
  std::vector<float> q(std::size_t{n} * D);
  const float sigma = noise / std::sqrt(static_cast<float>(D));
  for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    const float* r = base.row(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rng() % base.size()));
    float* dst = q.data() + std::size_t{i} * D;
    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < D; ++d) dst[d] = r[d] + sigma * g(rng);
    simd::normalize(dst, D);
  }
  return q;
}

// Topic-structured text: each topic has its own vocabulary, plus shared
// filler words drawn Zipf-like, so BM25 and dense retrieval both have signal.
struct TextCorpus {
  std::vector<std::string> docs;
  std::vector<std::uint32_t> topic;  // topic of each doc
  std::vector<std::vector<std::string>> topic_words;
};

inline TextCorpus make_text_corpus(std::uint32_t ndocs, std::uint32_t topics, std::uint32_t words_per_doc,
                                   std::uint64_t seed = 7) {
  std::mt19937_64 rng(seed);
  TextCorpus c;
  c.topic_words.resize(topics);
  for (std::uint32_t t = 0; t < topics; ++t)
    for (int w = 0; w < 40; ++w) c.topic_words[t].push_back("t" + std::to_string(t) + "w" + std::to_string(w));
  std::vector<std::string> filler;
  for (int w = 0; w < 2000; ++w) filler.push_back("f" + std::to_string(w));
  std::uniform_real_distribution<double> u(0.0, 1.0);
  for (std::uint32_t d = 0; d < ndocs; ++d) {
    const std::uint32_t t = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rng() % topics);
    std::string s;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < words_per_doc; ++i) {
      if (u(rng) < 0.35) s += c.topic_words[t][rng() % 40];
      else s += filler[static_cast<std::size_t>(std::pow(u(rng), 3.0) * 2000)];  // Zipf-ish
      s += (i % 17 == 16) ? ". " : " ";
    }
    c.docs.push_back(std::move(s));
    c.topic.push_back(t);
  }
  return c;
}

}  // namespace rag::synth

// Helpers shared by the test translation units.
#pragma once

#include <gtest/gtest.h>
#include "pid.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "rag/io.hpp"

namespace rag::testutil {

// Heap allocations (every operator new) between begin and end; defined in
// rag_tests.cpp, which replaces the global allocation functions.
void begin_alloc_count();
std::size_t end_alloc_count();

// Every temp index file a test creates; deleted when the test process ends.
inline std::vector<std::filesystem::path>& created_files() {
  static std::vector<std::filesystem::path> v;
  return v;
}

// Unique per test *and* per process: ctest -j runs tests as parallel processes,
// so a shared name would let two tests clobber each other's files.
inline std::filesystem::path temp_index(const char* name) {
  const auto* info = ::testing::UnitTest::GetInstance()->current_test_info();
  std::string id = std::string(info ? info->test_suite_name() : "nosuite") + "." + (info ? info->name() : "notest") +
                   "." + name + "." + std::to_string(test_pid()) + ".ragidx";
  for (char& c : id) if (c == '/') c = '_';
  auto p = std::filesystem::path(::testing::TempDir()) / id;
  created_files().push_back(p);
  return p;
}

inline std::vector<char> read_file(const std::filesystem::path& p) {
  std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
  return {std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f), {}};
}

inline void write_file(const std::filesystem::path& p, const std::vector<char>& b) {
  std::ofstream f(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
  f.write(b.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(b.size()));
}

// Rewrite the trailing checksum so a deliberately edited file passes the
// integrity check and exercises the structural validation behind it.
inline void fix_checksum(std::vector<char>& b) {
  io::Checksum c;
  c.update(b.data(), b.size() - 8);
  const std::uint64_t h = c.value();
  std::memcpy(b.data() + b.size() - 8, &h, 8);
}

template <class T>
void poke(std::vector<char>& b, std::size_t off, T v) { std::memcpy(b.data() + off, &v, sizeof v); }

template <class T>
T peek(const std::vector<char>& b, std::size_t off) {
  T v;
  std::memcpy(&v, b.data() + off, sizeof v);
  return v;
}

// The message of the exception f() throws, or "no exception".
template <class F>
std::string error_of(F&& f) {
  try {
    f();
  } catch (const std::exception& e) {
    return e.what();
  }
  return "no exception";
}

}  // namespace rag::testutil

#define FUZZ_CHECK(cond)                                                                   \
  do {                                                                                     \
    if (!(cond)) {                                                                         \
      std::fprintf(stderr, "FUZZ_CHECK failed: %s at %s:%d\n", #cond, __FILE__, __LINE__); \
      std::abort();                                                                        \
    }                                                                                      \
  } while (0)

inline std::filesystem::path scratch_file(const char* name) {
  const char* base = std::getenv("RAG_FUZZ_TMP");
  const std::filesystem::path dir = base ? base : (std::filesystem::exists("/dev/shm") ? "/dev/shm" : "/tmp");
  return dir / (std::string("rag-fuzz-") + name + "-" + std::to_string(::getpid()));
}

  c.nprobe = 2;
  c.prompt_capacity = 4096;

// fuzz_load — Engine::load on arbitrary files.
//
// The fuzzer's bytes are the file payload; a correct checksum is appended,
// so mutations get past the integrity check and reach the structural
// validation behind it. That is the attack surface that matters: anyone who
// can hand the process a file can also compute a checksum.
//
// Invariants: load() either throws or returns an engine whose every chunk and
// index entry is in bounds; queries on a loaded engine must not crash (ASan
// turns any out-of-bounds read into a crash).
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <vector>

#include "fuzz_common.hpp"

using namespace rag;
using namespace rag::fuzz;

extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size) {
  static const auto path = scratch_file("load");
  {
    io::Checksum c;
    c.update(data, size);
    const std::uint64_t h = c.value();
    std::ofstream f(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    f.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), static_cast<std::streamsize>(size));
    f.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&h), sizeof h);
  }
  // Vary the dense mode with the input length (byte 0 is always the magic
  // 'R' in valid files), so every reuse/rebuild path of load() is reached.
  const DenseMode modes[] = {DenseMode::Exact, DenseMode::Int8Rerank, DenseMode::Ivf, DenseMode::IvfInt8};
  const auto cfg = small_config(modes[size % 4]);
  std::unique_ptr<Engine> e;
  try {
    e = Engine::load(path, cfg);
  } catch (const std::exception&) {
    return 0;  // rejected: fine
  }
  const std::uint32_t n = e->size();
  FUZZ_CHECK(n <= cfg.max_chunks);
  FUZZ_CHECK(e->committed() == n);
  for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    const auto c = e->chunk(i);
    volatile char sink = 0;
    for (char ch : c.text) sink = static_cast<char>(sink ^ ch);  // touch every byte: ASan checks bounds
    (void)sink;
  }
  auto ctx = e->make_context();
  for (const char* q : {"alpha beta", "t0w1 t1w2 f3", "the", "order book imbalance"}) {
    const auto r = e->query(q, 8, ctx);
    for (const Hit& h : r.hits) FUZZ_CHECK(h.id < n);
    for (const Hit& h : r.lexical) FUZZ_CHECK(h.id < n);
    FUZZ_CHECK(r.prompt.prompt.size() <= cfg.prompt_capacity);
  }
  // A loaded engine must keep working: ingest, commit, save, reload.
  e->ingest("fresh document after load", 7);
  e->commit();
  e->save(path);
  const auto again = Engine::load(path, cfg);
  FUZZ_CHECK(again->size() == e->size());
  return 0;
}

// fuzz_policy_table — ExecutionPolicyTable::load on arbitrary files.
//
// As in fuzz_load, the fuzzer's bytes are the file payload and a correct
// checksum is appended, so mutations get past the integrity check and reach
// the structural validation behind it.
//
// Invariants: load() either throws io::FormatError (anything else escapes and
// is reported) or returns a table that matches the payload's layout. Every
// lookup, including times, inventories and signals far outside the grid, NaN
// and infinities, is in bounds (ASan) and a valid action; NaN and -inf use
// bin 0, +inf the last bin, and on a grid whose bins are resolvable in double
// precision each bin centre maps to its own cell, all checked against the
// payload's bytes. median() of the table with itself is the table, and save()
// writes back exactly the bytes that were loaded.
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <limits>
#include <optional>
#include <vector>

#include "fuzz_common.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/policy_table.hpp"

using namespace rag;
using namespace rag::agent;
using namespace rag::fuzz;

namespace {
template <class T>
T peek(const std::uint8_t* p) {
  T v;
  std::memcpy(&v, p, sizeof v);
  return v;
}
}  // namespace

extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size) {
  static const auto path = scratch_file("policy-table");
  io::Checksum c;
  c.update(data, size);
  const std::uint64_t h = c.value();
  {
    std::ofstream f(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    f.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), static_cast<std::streamsize>(size));
    f.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&h), sizeof h);
  }
  std::optional<ExecutionPolicyTable> loaded;
  try {
    loaded.emplace(ExecutionPolicyTable::load(path));
  } catch (const io::FormatError&) {
    return 0;  // rejected: fine
  }
  const ExecutionPolicyTable& table = *loaded;

  // Layout: magic[8], horizon, lots, bins (u32), lo, width (f64), u64 length, cells.
  constexpr std::size_t kHeader = 44;
  FUZZ_CHECK(size == kHeader + table.bytes());
  const auto horizon = peek<std::uint32_t>(data + 8), lots = peek<std::uint32_t>(data + 12),
             bins = peek<std::uint32_t>(data + 16);
  const double lo = peek<double>(data + 20), width = peek<double>(data + 28);
  FUZZ_CHECK(table.signal_bins() == bins && horizon > 0 && bins > 0);
  const std::uint64_t inventories = std::uint64_t{lots} + 1, cells = table.bytes();
  FUZZ_CHECK(cells % bins == 0 && (cells / bins) % inventories == 0 && cells / bins / inventories == horizon);
  const std::uint8_t* cell = data + kHeader;

  const ExecutionPolicyTable self3 = ExecutionPolicyTable::median({table, table, table});
  const ExecutionPolicyTable self2 = ExecutionPolicyTable::median({table, table});

  constexpr std::uint32_t kMax32 = std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max();
  constexpr double kInf = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(), kNaN = std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN(),
                   kMaxD = std::numeric_limits<double>::max(), kTiny = std::numeric_limits<double>::denorm_min();
  const std::uint32_t ts[] = {0, 1, horizon - 1, horizon, kMax32 - 1, kMax32};
  const std::uint32_t invs[] = {0, 1, lots, lots + 1 /* wraps at UINT32_MAX: fine */, kMax32};
  const double span = static_cast<double>(bins) * width;
  const double signals[] = {0.0,   -0.0,  1e-3,   -1e-3, 1.0,  -1.0,  1e300,       -1e300,
                            kMaxD, -kMaxD, kInf,  -kInf, kNaN, kTiny, -kTiny,      lo,
                            lo + span, std::nextafter(lo, -kInf), table.bin_centre(0), table.bin_centre(bins / 2),
                            table.bin_centre(bins - 1)};
  // Bin centres map back to their bins when the grid's coordinates are
  // resolvable: |lo| at most the grid's span (true of everything save()
  // writes) and no overflow at the top edge.
  const bool resolvable = std::isfinite(2 * span) && std::abs(lo) <= span;
  for (const std::uint32_t t : ts)
    for (const std::uint32_t inv : invs) {
      const std::uint64_t row = (std::uint64_t{std::min(t, horizon - 1)} * inventories + std::min(inv, lots)) * bins;
      for (const double s : signals) {
        const ExecutionObs o{t, inv, s};
        const Action a = table.act(o);
        FUZZ_CHECK(a < ExecutionEnv::kNumActions);
        FUZZ_CHECK(self3.act(o) == a && self2.act(o) == a);
      }
      const Action first{cell[row]}, last{cell[row + bins - 1]};
      FUZZ_CHECK(table.act({t, inv, kNaN}) == first);
      FUZZ_CHECK(table.act({t, inv, -kInf}) == first);
      FUZZ_CHECK(table.act({t, inv, -kMaxD}) == first);
      FUZZ_CHECK(table.act({t, inv, std::nextafter(lo, -kInf)}) == first);
      FUZZ_CHECK(table.act({t, inv, kInf}) == last);
      if (resolvable)
        for (const std::uint32_t b : {0u, bins / 2, bins - 1})
          FUZZ_CHECK(table.act({t, inv, table.bin_centre(b)}) == Action{cell[row + b]});
    }

  // save() writes back exactly what was loaded, checksum included.
  table.save(path);
  std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
  const std::vector<char> back{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f), {}};
  FUZZ_CHECK(back.size() == size + sizeof h);
  FUZZ_CHECK(std::memcmp(back.data(), data, size) == 0);
  FUZZ_CHECK(std::memcmp(back.data() + size, &h, sizeof h) == 0);
  return 0;
}

// fuzz_text — tokenizer, chunker, ingest, query and prompt assembly on
// arbitrary bytes, with invariants checked at every stage.
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

#include "fuzz_common.hpp"
#include "rag/text_clean.hpp"

using namespace rag;
using namespace rag::fuzz;

extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size) {
  if (size < 3) return 0;
  // First bytes choose a chunker config and a split point; the rest is text.
  const std::uint32_t window = 1 + data[0] % 24;
  const std::uint32_t overlap = data[1] % window;  // always < window
  const std::string_view all(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data + 3), size - 3);
  const std::size_t split = all.empty() ? 0 : data[2] % (all.size() + 1);
  const std::string_view doc = all.substr(0, split), query = all.substr(split);

  // Tokenizer: both APIs agree; tokens are in bounds, non-empty, ordered, and
  // never contain a separator byte.
  std::vector<Token> streamed;
  for_each_token(doc, [&](const Token& t) { streamed.push_back(t); });
  std::array<Token, 64> bounded;
  const std::size_t nb = tokenize(doc, bounded);
  FUZZ_CHECK(nb == std::min<std::size_t>(streamed.size(), bounded.size()));
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < streamed.size(); ++i) {
    const Token& t = streamed[i];
    FUZZ_CHECK(t.length > 0 && std::size_t{t.offset} + t.length <= doc.size());
    FUZZ_CHECK(i == 0 || t.offset >= streamed[i - 1].offset + streamed[i - 1].length + 1);
    FUZZ_CHECK(t.hash == hash_term(doc.substr(t.offset, t.length)));
    if (i < nb) FUZZ_CHECK(bounded[i].offset == t.offset && bounded[i].hash == t.hash);
  }

  // Chunker: windows cover every token in order, with the configured overlap,
  // and byte ranges stay inside the text and contain their tokens.
  const ChunkerConfig cc{window, overlap};
  std::uint32_t prev_begin = 0, chunks = 0, last_end = 0;
  chunk_tokens(doc, streamed, cc, [&](const ChunkRange& r) {
    FUZZ_CHECK(r.token_begin < r.token_end && r.token_end <= streamed.size());
    FUZZ_CHECK(r.token_end - r.token_begin <= window);
    FUZZ_CHECK(chunks == 0 || r.token_begin == prev_begin + (window - overlap));
    FUZZ_CHECK(r.byte_begin == streamed[r.token_begin].offset);
    FUZZ_CHECK(r.byte_end <= doc.size());
    FUZZ_CHECK(r.byte_end >= streamed[r.token_end - 1].offset + streamed[r.token_end - 1].length);
    prev_begin = r.token_begin;
    last_end = r.token_end;
    ++chunks;
  });
  FUZZ_CHECK(streamed.empty() ? chunks == 0 : last_end == streamed.size());

  // Engine: ingest both halves, query with the other, in two dense modes.
  for (DenseMode mode : {DenseMode::Exact, DenseMode::IvfInt8}) {
    auto cfg = small_config(mode);
    cfg.chunker = cc;
    cfg.max_chunks = 64;  // small: also exercises the capacity limit
    Engine e(cfg);
    e.ingest(doc, 1);
    e.commit();
    e.ingest(query, 2);  // uncommitted: dense-only delta
    auto ctx = e.make_context();
    for (std::string_view q : {query, doc}) {
      const auto r = e.query(q, 16, ctx);
      const std::uint32_t n = e.size();
      for (const Hit& h : r.hits) FUZZ_CHECK(h.id < n && !std::isnan(h.score));
      for (const Hit& h : r.dense) FUZZ_CHECK(h.score > 0.f);  // dense_min_score = 0, strict
      const auto& p = r.prompt.prompt;
      FUZZ_CHECK(p.size() <= cfg.prompt_capacity);
      if (!p.empty()) FUZZ_CHECK(p.find("### Answer") != std::string_view::npos);
      FUZZ_CHECK(r.prompt.chunks_used <= r.hits.size());
    }
  }

  // Page cleanup (PDF text): split the input into pages at form feeds.
  std::vector<std::string> pages(1);
  for (char ch : all) {
    if (ch == '\f') pages.emplace_back();
    else pages.back() += ch;
  }
  const auto cleaned = text::clean_pages(pages);
  FUZZ_CHECK(cleaned.size() == pages.size());
  for (const auto& pg : cleaned) {
    for (unsigned char c : pg) FUZZ_CHECK(c >= 0x20 || c == '\n');
    FUZZ_CHECK(pg.find("\n\n\n") == std::string::npos && pg.find("  ") == std::string::npos);
    FUZZ_CHECK(pg.size() <= 3 * (all.size() + 1));  // ligature expansion is at most 3 bytes -> 3 letters
  }
  const auto joined = text::join_pages(cleaned);
  FUZZ_CHECK(joined.page_starts.size() == cleaned.size());
  for (std::size_t i = 1; i < joined.page_starts.size(); ++i) FUZZ_CHECK(joined.page_starts[i] > joined.page_starts[i - 1]);
  {
    Engine pe(small_config());
    pe.ingest(joined.text, 9, IngestOptions{.source = "fuzz.pdf", .page_starts = joined.page_starts});
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < pe.size(); ++i) {
      const auto c = pe.chunk(i);
      FUZZ_CHECK(c.page_first >= 1 && c.page_first <= c.page_last && c.page_last <= cleaned.size());
      FUZZ_CHECK(c.source == "fuzz.pdf");
    }
  }

  // Prompt builder with a tiny buffer: never writes past it.
  std::array<char, 96> buf;
  buf.fill('#');
  const std::array<Hit, 2> hits{{{1.f, 0}, {0.5f, 1}}};
  const auto r = build_prompt(query, hits, [&](std::uint32_t i) { return ChunkView{i ? doc : query, i, 0}; },
                              PromptParams{.max_context_tokens = 16, .system = "S"}, std::span(buf).first(64));
  FUZZ_CHECK(r.prompt.size() <= 64);
  FUZZ_CHECK(std::all_of(buf.begin() + 64, buf.end(), [](char c) { return c == '#'; }));
  return 0;
}

```cpp
// make_seeds — writes valid index payloads (file minus trailing checksum)
// for every dense mode, as a starting corpus for fuzz_load; given a second
// directory, also valid policy-table payloads for fuzz_policy_table.
#include <cstdio>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <vector>

#include "fuzz_common.hpp"
#include "rag/agent/policy_table.hpp"

using namespace rag;
using namespace rag::fuzz;

namespace {
// A saved file minus its trailing checksum: the fuzzers append a fresh one.
std::vector<char> payload_of(const std::filesystem::path& tmp) {
  std::vector<char> b;
  {
    std::ifstream f(tmp, std::ios::binary);
    b.assign(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f), {});
  }
  std::filesystem::remove(tmp);
  b.resize(b.size() - 8);
  return b;
}

void write_payload(const std::filesystem::path& p, const std::vector<char>& b) {
  std::ofstream o(p, std::ios::binary);
  o.write(b.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(b.size()));
}

// Small policy tables (each a few hundred bytes at most) over varied grids,
// including widths near both ends of the normal range (1e-307 is one byte
// edit from a subnormal width).
int policy_table_seeds(const std::filesystem::path& out) {
  using namespace rag::agent;
  std::filesystem::create_directories(out);
  struct Shape {
    std::uint32_t horizon, lots, bins;
    double range, sd;
  };
  const Shape shapes[] = {{1, 0, 1, 4.0, 0.1}, {2, 3, 4, 4.0, 0.1}, {5, 12, 6, 2.0, 0.1}, {3, 2, 32, 4.0, 1e-300},
                          {2, 1, 16, 1e300, 1e7}, {4, 9, 5, 0.5, 3.0},   {2, 2, 8, 4.0, 1e-307}};
  int idx = 0;
  for (const Shape& s : shapes) {
    ExecutionParams p;
    p.horizon = s.horizon;
    p.lots = s.lots;
    p.signal_sd = s.sd;
    const ExecutionPolicyTable table(
        p, [](const ExecutionObs& o) -> Action { return (o.t * 3 + o.inventory + (o.signal > 0 ? 2u : 0u)) % 5; },
        {.signal_bins = s.bins, .signal_range_sd = s.range});
    const auto tmp = out / "tmp.tbl";
    table.save(tmp);
    write_payload(out / ("seed-" + std::to_string(idx++)), payload_of(tmp));
  }
  return idx;
}
}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  if (argc < 2) { std::fprintf(stderr, "usage: make_seeds <out-dir> [<policy-table-out-dir>]\n"); return 2; }
  const std::filesystem::path out = argv[1];
  std::filesystem::create_directories(out);
  const char* docs[] = {"alpha beta gamma delta epsilon zeta eta theta iota kappa",
                        "order book imbalance predicts the next mid price move",
                        "the of and", "t0w1 t0w2 t1w3 f4 f5 f6 f7 f8 f9 f10 f11 f12 f13 f14"};
  const DenseMode modes[] = {DenseMode::Exact, DenseMode::Int8Rerank, DenseMode::Ivf, DenseMode::IvfInt8};
  int idx = 0;
  for (int m = 0; m < 4; ++m) {
    for (int ndocs : {0, 1, 4}) {
      Engine e(small_config(modes[m]));
      for (int d = 0; d < ndocs; ++d) {
        // Odd documents carry a source and two pages, so seeds cover every record field.
        const std::uint32_t pages[] = {0, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::string_view(docs[d]).size() / 2)};
        if (d % 2) e.ingest(docs[d], static_cast<std::uint32_t>(d), IngestOptions{.source = "seed.pdf", .page_starts = pages});
        else e.ingest(docs[d], static_cast<std::uint32_t>(d));
      }
      e.commit();
      if (ndocs == 4) e.ingest("uncommitted tail chunk", 9);
      const auto tmp = out / "tmp.idx";
      e.save(tmp);
      write_payload(out / ("seed-" + std::to_string(idx++)), payload_of(tmp));
    }
  }
  std::printf("wrote %d seeds to %s\n", idx, out.c_str());
  if (argc >= 3) std::printf("wrote %d policy-table seeds to %s\n", policy_table_seeds(argv[2]), argv[2]);
}

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bundle the project's documentation (and optionally its source) into one
Markdown file to paste into a language model's context.

  python3 tools/make_context_pack.py                 # docs only
  python3 tools/make_context_pack.py --with-source   # docs + headers, tests, examples, build files
  python3 tools/make_context_pack.py --out FILE

The bundle starts with a file tree and a table of contents, then includes
every file verbatim with a header giving its path and size. Token counts are
estimated at ~4 characters per token.
"""
import argparse
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

DOCS = [
    "llms.txt",
    "docs/ai/README.md",
    "docs/ai/OBJECTIVES.md",
    "docs/ai/PROJECT_MAP.md",
    "docs/ai/SPECS.md",
    "docs/ai/API.md",
    "docs/ai/RAG_ENGINE.md",
    "docs/agent.md",
    "docs/WINDOWS.md",
    "docs/ai/TASK_SPECS.md",
    "docs/ai/LESSONS.md",
    "docs/ai/RESEARCH.md",
    "docs/ai/EXPERIMENTS.md",
    "docs/ai/DECISIONS.md",
    "docs/ai/CONVENTIONS.md",
    "docs/ai/STATUS.md",
    "docs/ai/ORDERFLOW.md",
    "docs/ai/NEXT_SESSION.md",
    "experiments/research_synthesis.md",
    "README.md",
]
SOURCE_GLOBS = [
    "CMakeLists.txt",
    ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
    "include/**/*.hpp",
    "examples/*.cpp",
    "bench/*.cpp",
    "bench/*.hpp",
    "tests/*.cpp",
    "tests/*.hpp",
    "tests/fuzz/*",
    "tools/*.py",
]
FENCE = {".hpp": "cpp", ".cpp": "cpp", ".py": "python", ".yml": "yaml", ".txt": "cmake"}


def tracked_files():
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(["git", "ls-files"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
        return sorted(out.split())
    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        return sorted(str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in ROOT.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and ".git" not in p.parts)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--with-source", action="store_true", help="include headers, tests, examples and build files")
    ap.add_argument("--out", help="output path (default dist/context_pack_{docs,full}.md)")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    files = [f for f in DOCS if (ROOT / f).is_file()]
    if args.with_source:
        seen = set(files)
        for pattern in SOURCE_GLOBS:
            for p in sorted(ROOT.glob(pattern)):
                rel = str(p.relative_to(ROOT))
                if p.is_file() and rel not in seen:
                    files.append(rel)
                    seen.add(rel)

    out = pathlib.Path(args.out).resolve() if args.out else ROOT / "dist" / ("context_pack_full.md" if args.with_source else "context_pack_docs.md")
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    parts = ["# rag-cpp context pack\n",
             "Generated by tools/make_context_pack.py. Contents: "
             + ("documentation and full source" if args.with_source else "documentation") + ".\n",
             "\n## Repository files\n\n```\n" + "\n".join(tracked_files()) + "\n```\n",
             "\n## Contents\n\n" + "\n".join(f"{i + 1}. {f}" for i, f in enumerate(files)) + "\n"]
    total = 0
    for f in files:
        text = (ROOT / f).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        total += len(text)
        suffix = pathlib.Path(f).suffix
        if suffix == ".md":
            body = text
        else:
            fence = "````" if "```" in text else "```"
            body = f"{fence}{FENCE.get(suffix, '')}\n{text}\n{fence}"
        parts.append(f"\n\n---\n\n## FILE: {f}  ({len(text):,} bytes)\n\n{body}\n")
    out.write_text("".join(parts), encoding="utf-8")
    size = out.stat().st_size
    print(f"wrote {out}: {len(files)} files, {size:,} bytes, ~{size // 4:,} tokens", file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
