#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""of_viz.py - turn an of_trace CSV into ONE self-contained HTML viewer.

    python tools/of_viz.py trace.csv [out.html]

Standard library only; the page has inline JS and SVG, no CDN, no network.
Per episode: price (bid/ask band, mid, hidden fair value, the agent's fills),
position strips (agent, 30 s delta rule, fair-value oracle), the two signals
of the policy map, Q-values, cumulative net P&L; a shared crosshair shows
every column of the hovered step. Over all episodes: the policy map (action
by L1 imbalance x 30 s delta, optionally given the position held), action
shares by each signal, holding times and P&L per round trip.

Round trips: a run of steps with the same non-zero position. Its P&L is the
change in cumulative net P&L from the step before the entry to the step that
closes or flips it (a flip's new entry cost lands on the closing trip), so
the trips of an episode sum to its P&L exactly.
"""
import csv
import json
import os
import sys

FEATURES = ["f_delta5", "f_delta30", "f_delta120", "f_ofi5", "f_ofi30", "f_relvol", "f_imb_l1",
            "f_imb_l5", "f_ret5", "f_ret30", "f_ret120", "f_vwap", "f_absorb"]
STRATS = [("agent", "pos", "pnl"), ("rule", "rule_pos", "rule_pnl"), ("oracle", "oracle_pos", "oracle_pnl")]
IMB_BINS = 10    # raw L1 imbalance (bid-ask)/(bid+ask) over [-1, 1]
DELTA_BINS = 8   # normalized 30 s delta feature over [-4, 4] (the feature clip)


def num(s):
    if s == "":
        return None
    x = float(s)
    return int(x) if x.is_integer() and abs(x) < 1e15 else x


def read(path):
    meta, body = [], []
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            (meta if line.startswith("#") else body).append(line)
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(body))
    if not rows:
        sys.exit(f"{path}: no rows")
    cols = list(rows[0].keys())
    episodes = {}
    for r in rows:
        ep = episodes.setdefault(int(r["episode"]), {c: [] for c in cols})
        for c in cols:
            ep[c].append(num(r[c]))
    return " ".join(m.lstrip("# ").strip() for m in meta), cols, [episodes[k] for k in sorted(episodes)]


def runs(pos):
    """(first, last) row of each run of one non-zero position."""
    out, start = [], None
    for i, p in enumerate(pos + [0]):
        if start is not None and (i == len(pos) or p != pos[start]):
            out.append((start, i - 1))
            start = None
        if start is None and i < len(pos) and p != 0:
            start = i
    return out


def trips(pos, pnl):
    res = []
    for a, b in runs(pos):
        end = min(b + 1, len(pnl) - 1)  # the step that closes (or flips) the position
        # After a flip, step a (the flip) already belongs to the closing trip.
        before = 0.0 if a == 0 else pnl[a] if pos[a - 1] != 0 else pnl[a - 1]
        res.append({"hold": b - a + 1, "pnl": round(pnl[end] - before, 3), "side": pos[a]})
    return res


def bin_of(x, lo, hi, n):
    if x is None:
        return None
    k = int((x - lo) / (hi - lo) * n)
    return max(0, min(n - 1, k))


def aggregate(episodes):
    # policy[position held before the decision + 1][imbalance bin][delta bin] = [short, flat, long]
    policy = [[[[0, 0, 0] for _ in range(DELTA_BINS)] for _ in range(IMB_BINS)] for _ in range(3)]
    trip = {s: [] for s, _, _ in STRATS}
    for ep in episodes:
        for i, a in enumerate(ep["action"]):
            held = ep["pos"][i - 1] if i > 0 else 0
            bi = bin_of(ep["imb_l1"][i], -1.0, 1.0, IMB_BINS)
            bd = bin_of(ep["f_delta30"][i], -4.0, 4.0, DELTA_BINS)
            if bi is not None and bd is not None and a is not None:
                policy[max(-1, min(1, held)) + 1][bi][bd][a] += 1
        for s, pc, pl in STRATS:
            for t in trips(ep[pc], ep[pl]):
                t["ep"] = ep["episode"][0]
                trip[s].append(t)
    for s, pc, pl in STRATS:  # integrity: trips partition each episode's P&L
        total = sum(t["pnl"] for t in trip[s])
        final = sum(ep[pl][-1] for ep in episodes)
        if abs(total - final) > 0.05 * len(episodes) + 1e-6:
            print(f"warning: {s} round trips sum to {total:.2f}, episodes to {final:.2f}", file=sys.stderr)
    return {"policy": policy, "trips": trip, "imbBins": IMB_BINS, "deltaBins": DELTA_BINS}


def main(argv):
    if len(argv) < 2 or argv[1] in ("-h", "--help"):
        print(__doc__)
        return 2
    src = argv[1]
    dst = argv[2] if len(argv) > 2 else os.path.splitext(src)[0] + ".html"
    meta, cols, episodes = read(src)
    missing = [c for c in ["episode", "step", "bid", "ask", "mid", "fair_value", "imb_l1", "q_short", "q_flat", "q_long",
                           "action", "pos", "fill_px", "pnl", "rule_pos", "rule_pnl", "oracle_pos", "oracle_pnl"] + FEATURES
               if c not in cols]
    if missing:
        sys.exit(f"{src}: missing columns {missing}")
    data = {"meta": meta, "source": os.path.basename(src), "features": FEATURES, "episodes": episodes, **aggregate(episodes)}
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":")).replace("</", "<\\/")
    page = PAGE.replace("/*DATA*/null", payload)
    with open(dst, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write(page)
    n = sum(len(e["step"]) for e in episodes)
    print(f"wrote {dst}: {len(episodes)} episodes, {n} steps, {os.path.getsize(dst) / 1e6:.1f} MB")
    return 0


PAGE = r"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>RL scalping episode viewer</title>
<style>
:root{--surface:#fcfcfb;--page:#f9f9f7;--ink:#0b0b0b;--ink2:#52514e;--muted:#898781;--grid:#e1e0d9;--axis:#c3c2b7;
--agent:#2a78d6;--rule:#eb6834;--oracle:#1baf7a;--fv:#c98500;--long:#2a78d6;--short:#e34948;--neutral:#f0efec;--band:#e9e8e3;
--longbg:rgba(42,120,214,.10);--shortbg:rgba(227,73,72,.10)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--surface:#1a1a19;--page:#0d0d0d;--ink:#f0efec;--ink2:#c3c2b7;--muted:#898781;--grid:#2c2c2a;
--axis:#383835;--agent:#3987e5;--rule:#d95926;--oracle:#199e70;--fv:#eda100;--long:#3987e5;--short:#e66767;--neutral:#383835;--band:#2c2c2a;
--longbg:rgba(57,135,229,.16);--shortbg:rgba(230,103,103,.16)}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--page);color:var(--ink);font:13px/1.4 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
header{padding:14px 20px 4px}h1{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 2px}h2{font-size:15px;margin:22px 0 6px}h3{font-size:13px;margin:10px 0 2px;font-weight:600}
.sub{color:var(--ink2)}.muted{color:var(--muted)}main{padding:0 20px 30px}
.bar{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:8px 0}
select,button{font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--axis);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px}
button{cursor:pointer}.wrap{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start}.charts{flex:1;min-width:0}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--grid);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.side{width:270px;flex:none;position:sticky;top:8px;font-size:12px}.side table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
.side td{padding:1px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid)}.side td:last-child{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:600}
svg{display:block;width:100%;overflow:visible}text{fill:var(--muted);font-size:11px}.lab{fill:var(--ink2)}
.legend{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:var(--ink2);font-size:12px;margin:2px 0 4px}
.key{display:inline-block;width:14px;height:0;border-top:2px solid;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:5px}
.sw{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;vertical-align:-1px;margin-right:5px}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(420px,1fr));gap:10px}
table.sum{border-collapse:collapse;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;width:100%}
table.sum th,table.sum td{padding:3px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid);text-align:right}table.sum th{color:var(--ink2);font-weight:600}
table.sum td:first-child,table.sum th:first-child{text-align:left}table.sum tr.ep{cursor:pointer}table.sum tr.ep:hover,table.sum tr.cur{background:var(--band)}
#tip{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--axis);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px;display:none;z-index:9;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
#tip b{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.note{color:var(--ink2);font-size:12px;max-width:900px}
</style></head><body>
<header><h1>RL scalping episode viewer</h1><div class="sub" id="meta"></div></header>
<main>
<div class="bar"><button id="prev" title="previous episode (left arrow)">&larr;</button><select id="pick" aria-label="episode"></select>
<button id="next" title="next episode (right arrow)">&rarr;</button><span class="muted" id="epinfo"></span></div>
<div class="wrap"><div class="charts" id="charts"></div>
<aside class="side card"><h3 id="sidehead">Hover a chart</h3><table id="side"></table></aside></div>
<h2>All episodes</h2>
<div class="grid2">
<div class="card"><h3>Policy map: agent's action by L1 imbalance and 30 s delta</h3>
<div class="bar">Position held before the decision: <select id="held"><option value="all">any</option><option value="1">flat</option><option value="2">long</option><option value="0">short</option></select></div>
<div class="legend"><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--short)"></span>mostly short</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--neutral);border:1px solid var(--axis)"></span>mostly flat / mixed</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--long)"></span>mostly long</span><span class="muted">colour = share long &minus; share short; faint = under 10 decisions</span></div>
<div id="pmap"></div></div>
<div class="card"><h3>Action share by signal bucket</h3><div class="legend"><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--short)"></span>short</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--neutral);border:1px solid var(--axis)"></span>flat</span><span><span class="sw" style="background:var(--long)"></span>long</span></div>
<div id="share1"></div><div id="share2"></div></div>
<div class="card"><h3>Holding time per round trip</h3><div class="legend" id="lg1"></div><div id="hold"></div></div>
<div class="card"><h3>P&amp;L per round trip (ticks, net of fees)</h3><div class="legend" id="lg2"></div><div id="trip"></div></div>
</div>
<div class="card"><h3>Round trips</h3><table class="sum" id="tripsum"></table></div>
<div class="card"><h3>Episodes (click a row)</h3><table class="sum" id="epsum"></table></div>
<p class="note">Market columns are the agent's own path; the rule and the oracle trade on the same seeds in their own copies of the market (their orders move it slightly). The fair value is hidden from the agent and shown for reference only; the oracle trades on it (gap &gt; 2 ticks). Visualization seeds (960M+): never select or score anything on them.</p>
</main><div id="tip"></div>
<script>
"use strict";
const D=/*DATA*/null;
const NS="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",STR=[["agent","pos","pnl"],["rule","rule_pos","rule_pnl"],["oracle","oracle_pos","oracle_pnl"]];
const NAMES={agent:"RL agent",rule:"30 s delta rule",oracle:"fair-value oracle"},ACT=["short","flat","long"];
const css=v=>getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(v).trim();
function el(tag,attrs,parent){const e=document.createElementNS(NS,tag);for(const k in attrs)e.setAttribute(k,attrs[k]);if(parent)parent.appendChild(e);return e}
function h(tag,parent,text,cls){const e=document.createElement(tag);if(text!=null)e.textContent=text;if(cls)e.className=cls;if(parent)parent.appendChild(e);return e}
function lin(d0,d1,r0,r1){const k=(r1-r0)/((d1-d0)||1);return v=>r0+(v-d0)*k}
function nice(lo,hi,n){if(!(hi>lo)){lo-=1;hi+=1}const raw=(hi-lo)/n,p=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(raw))),m=raw/p,st=(m<1.5?1:m<3?2:m<7?5:10)*p;
 const out=[];for(let v=Math.ceil(lo/st)*st;v<=hi+1e-9;v+=st)out.push(+v.toFixed(10));return out}
const f=(x,d=2)=>x==null?"–":(+x).toFixed(d),sg=(x,d=2)=>x==null?"–":(x>0?"+":"")+(+x).toFixed(d);
function clock(s){if(s==null)return"–";s=Math.round(s)+9.5*3600;const hh=Math.floor(s/3600),mm=Math.floor(s/60)%60,ss=s%60;return`${hh}:${String(mm).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(ss).padStart(2,"0")}`}
const tip=document.getElementById("tip");
function showTip(ev,rows){tip.replaceChildren();for(const [k,v,c] of rows){const d=h("div",tip);if(c){const s=h("span",d,null,"key");s.style.borderColor=c}h("b",d,v);d.append(" "+k)}
 tip.style.display="block";const x=Math.min(ev.clientX+14,innerWidth-tip.offsetWidth-8);tip.style.left=x+"px";tip.style.top=(ev.clientY+14)+"px"}
function hideTip(){tip.style.display="none"}

// ---------- per-episode charts ----------
const M={l:52,r:12,t:6,b:18};let cur=0,cross=[],hoverStep=null,lastPanel=null;
function panel(host,title,height,lo,hi,legend){
 const card=h("div",host,null,"card");h("h3",card,title);if(legend){const lg=h("div",card,null,"legend");for(const [n,c,dash] of legend){const s=h("span",lg);const k=h("span",s,null,"key");k.style.borderColor=c;if(dash)k.style.borderTopStyle="dashed";s.append(n)}}
 const W=Math.max(360,card.clientWidth-20),svg=el("svg",{viewBox:`0 0 ${W} ${height}`,height},card);
 const ep=D.episodes[cur],n=ep.step.length,x=lin(0,n-1,M.l,W-M.r),y=lin(lo,hi,height-M.b,M.t);
 for(const v of nice(lo,hi,4)){el("line",{x1:M.l,x2:W-M.r,y1:y(v),y2:y(v),stroke:css("--grid")},svg);const t=el("text",{x:M.l-6,y:y(v)+4,"text-anchor":"end"},svg);t.textContent=+v.toFixed(3)}
 el("line",{x1:M.l,x2:W-M.r,y1:height-M.b,y2:height-M.b,stroke:css("--axis")},svg);
 for(const s of nice(0,n-1,6)){if(s>n-1)continue;const t=el("text",{x:x(s),y:height-4,"text-anchor":"middle"},svg);t.textContent=clock(ep.tod_s[s])}
 const g=el("g",{},svg),cl=el("line",{y1:M.t,y2:height-M.b,stroke:css("--ink2"),"stroke-width":1,visibility:"hidden"},svg);cross.push({cl,x});
 const hit=el("rect",{x:M.l,y:0,width:W-M.l-M.r,height,fill:"transparent"},svg);
 hit.addEventListener("pointermove",ev=>{const r=svg.getBoundingClientRect(),px=(ev.clientX-r.left)*W/r.width;const i=Math.max(0,Math.min(n-1,Math.round((px-M.l)/(W-M.l-M.r)*(n-1))));setHover(i,ev)});
 hit.addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>{hideTip()});
 lastPanel={svg:g,x,y,W,H:height,n};return lastPanel}
function path(p,ys,attrs){let d="",pen=false;for(let i=0;i<ys.length;i++){const v=ys[i];if(v==null){pen=false;continue}d+=(pen?"L":"M")+p.x(i).toFixed(1)+","+p.y(v).toFixed(1);pen=true}
 return el("path",Object.assign({d,fill:"none","stroke-width":2,"stroke-linejoin":"round"},attrs),p.svg)}
function ext(arrs){let lo=Infinity,hi=-Infinity;for(const a of arrs)for(const v of a)if(v!=null){if(v<lo)lo=v;if(v>hi)hi=v}return[lo,hi]}
function posBands(p,pos,y0,y1){let s=0;for(let i=1;i<=pos.length;i++){if(i==pos.length||pos[i]!=pos[s]){if(pos[s]!=0){const xa=p.x(s),xb=i<pos.length?p.x(i):p.x(i-1);
 el("rect",{x:xa,y:Math.min(y0,y1),width:Math.max(1,xb-xa),height:Math.abs(y1-y0),fill:pos[s]>0?css("--longbg"):css("--shortbg")},p.svg)}s=i}}}
function render(){
 const host=document.getElementById("charts");host.replaceChildren();cross=[];const ep=D.episodes[cur],n=ep.step.length,m0=ep.mid[0];
 const rel=a=>a.map(v=>v==null?null:v-m0);
 // price
 const [plo,phi]=ext([rel(ep.bid),rel(ep.ask),rel(ep.fair_value)]);
 const pp=panel(host,"Price (ticks from the episode's first mid) with the agent's position shaded",230,plo-0.5,phi+0.5,[["mid",css("--ink")],["bid / ask",css("--axis")],["hidden fair value",css("--fv"),1],["buy ▲ / sell ▼ fills",css("--ink2")]]);
 posBands(pp,ep.pos,pp.y(phi+0.5),pp.y(plo-0.5));
 let d="";for(let i=0;i<n;i++)d+=(i?"L":"M")+pp.x(i).toFixed(1)+","+pp.y(ep.ask[i]-m0).toFixed(1);for(let i=n-1;i>=0;i--)d+="L"+pp.x(i).toFixed(1)+","+pp.y(ep.bid[i]-m0).toFixed(1);
 el("path",{d:d+"Z",fill:css("--band"),stroke:"none"},pp.svg);
 path(pp,rel(ep.mid),{stroke:css("--ink"),"stroke-width":1.5});path(pp,rel(ep.fair_value),{stroke:css("--fv"),"stroke-dasharray":"5 3"});
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const dp=ep.pos[i]-(i?ep.pos[i-1]:0);if(!dp&&!(i==n-1&&ep.pos[i-1]))continue;
  const buy=dp>0||(dp==0&&ep.pos[i-1]<0),px=ep.fill_px[i]!=null?ep.fill_px[i]:ep.mid[i],X=pp.x(i),Y=pp.y(px-m0);
  el("path",{d:buy?`M${X-5},${Y+7}L${X+5},${Y+7}L${X},${Y-1}Z`:`M${X-5},${Y-7}L${X+5},${Y-7}L${X},${Y+1}Z`,fill:buy?css("--long"):css("--short"),stroke:css("--surface"),"stroke-width":1.5},pp.svg)}
 // positions
 const sp=panel(host,"Position (after each decision): long ▮ blue, short ▮ red",84,0,3,null);
 sp.svg.parentNode.querySelectorAll("text").forEach((t,i)=>{if(t.getAttribute("text-anchor")=="end")t.remove()});
 STR.forEach(([s,pc],k)=>{const y0=sp.y(3-k)+3,y1=sp.y(2-k)-3,a=ep[pc];let st=0;
  for(let i=1;i<=n;i++){if(i==n||a[i]!=a[st]){if(a[st]!=0)el("rect",{x:sp.x(st),y:y0,width:Math.max(1,(i<n?sp.x(i):sp.x(n-1)+1)-sp.x(st)),height:y1-y0,fill:a[st]>0?css("--long"):css("--short"),rx:1},sp.svg);st=i}}
  const t=el("text",{x:M.l-6,y:(y0+y1)/2+4,"text-anchor":"end",class:"lab"},sp.svg);t.textContent=s});
 // signals
 const gp=panel(host,"Signals the policy map uses",120,-1,1,[["L1 imbalance (raw, −1..1)",css("--agent")],["30 s delta (normalized ÷ 4)",css("--rule")]]);
 el("line",{x1:M.l,x2:gp.W-M.r,y1:gp.y(0),y2:gp.y(0),stroke:css("--axis")},gp.svg);
 path(gp,ep.imb_l1,{stroke:css("--agent"),"stroke-width":1.2});path(gp,ep.f_delta30.map(v=>v==null?null:v/4),{stroke:css("--rule"),"stroke-width":1.5});
 // Q
 const relq=document.getElementById("relq")?document.getElementById("relq").checked:true;
 const qs=[ep.q_short,ep.q_flat,ep.q_long].map(a=>relq?a.map((v,i)=>v-ep.q_flat[i]):a);const [qlo,qhi]=ext(qs);
 const qp=panel(host,relq?"Q-values relative to flat (advantage of short / long over flat)":"Q-values",150,qlo,qhi,[["short",css("--short")],["flat",css("--muted")],["long",css("--long")]]);
 const qc=[css("--short"),css("--muted"),css("--long")];qs.forEach((a,k)=>path(qp,a,{stroke:qc[k],"stroke-width":k==1?1:1.5}));
 const cb=h("label",qp.svg.closest(".card").querySelector("h3"));cb.style.cssText="font-weight:400;margin-left:12px;color:var(--ink2)";
 const inp=h("input",cb);inp.type="checkbox";inp.id="relq";inp.checked=relq;cb.append(" relative to flat");inp.onchange=render;
 // P&L
 const [lo,hi]=ext([ep.pnl,ep.rule_pnl,ep.oracle_pnl,[0]]);
 const lp=panel(host,"Cumulative net P&L (ticks)",170,lo,hi,STR.map(([s])=>[NAMES[s],css("--"+s)]));
 el("line",{x1:M.l,x2:lp.W-M.r,y1:lp.y(0),y2:lp.y(0),stroke:css("--axis")},lp.svg);
 STR.forEach(([s,,pl])=>path(lp,ep[pl],{stroke:css("--"+s)}));
 STR.forEach(([s,,pl])=>{const v=ep[pl][n-1],t=el("text",{x:lp.W-M.r+2,y:lp.y(v)+4,class:"lab"},lp.svg);t.textContent=sg(v,1)});
 if(hoverStep!=null)setHover(Math.min(hoverStep,n-1));
 document.querySelectorAll("#epsum tr.ep").forEach(r=>r.classList.toggle("cur",+r.dataset.i==cur));
 const e=D.episodes[cur];document.getElementById("epinfo").textContent=`seed ${e.seed[0]} · ${clock(e.tod_s[0])}–${clock(e.tod_s[n-1])} · agent ${sg(e.pnl[n-1])}, rule ${sg(e.rule_pnl[n-1])}, oracle ${sg(e.oracle_pnl[n-1])} ticks · ${e.orders[n-1]} orders`}
function setHover(i,ev){hoverStep=i;const ep=D.episodes[cur];for(const c of cross){const X=c.x(i);c.cl.setAttribute("x1",X);c.cl.setAttribute("x2",X);c.cl.setAttribute("visibility","visible")}
 document.getElementById("sidehead").textContent=`Step ${i} · ${clock(ep.tod_s[i])}`;const t=document.getElementById("side");t.replaceChildren();
 const row=(k,v)=>{const r=h("tr",t);h("td",r,k);h("td",r,v)};const m0=ep.mid[0];
 row("bid / ask",`${ep.bid[i]-m0} / ${ep.ask[i]-m0}`);row("fair value − mid",sg(ep.fair_value[i]-ep.mid[i]));row("L1 sizes bid / ask",`${ep.bid_sz1[i]} / ${ep.ask_sz1[i]}`);row("L1 imbalance",sg(ep.imb_l1[i],3));
 for(const k of D.features)row(k.replace("f_","feat "),sg(ep[k][i],2));row("open P&L",sg(ep.open_pnl[i]));
 row("Q short / flat / long",`${f(ep.q_short[i])} / ${f(ep.q_flat[i])} / ${f(ep.q_long[i])}`);row("action",ACT[ep.action[i]]);row("position after",ep.pos[i]);
 row("fill price",ep.fill_px[i]==null?"–":sg(ep.fill_px[i]-m0));row("orders / fees",`${ep.orders[i]} / ${f(ep.fees[i])}`);
 row("P&L agent / rule / oracle",`${sg(ep.pnl[i],1)} / ${sg(ep.rule_pnl[i],1)} / ${sg(ep.oracle_pnl[i],1)}`);row("rule / oracle pos",`${ep.rule_pos[i]} / ${ep.oracle_pos[i]}`);
 if(ev)showTip(ev,[["action",ACT[ep.action[i]]],["Q long − flat",sg(ep.q_long[i]-ep.q_flat[i])],["Q short − flat",sg(ep.q_short[i]-ep.q_flat[i])],["agent P&L",sg(ep.pnl[i],1),css("--agent")]])}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""real_vs_sim.py -- OF12: the same order-flow statistics, from the same code, on real ES
(Sierra Chart data) and on the ES simulator (of_calibrate export ticks).

usage (Python 3.12, standard library only; -I keeps the run isolated):
  python -I tools/real_vs_sim.py --bars ES_continuous_1min.csv --scid-dir C:/SierraChart/Data
      --depth ESZ26_FUT_CME.2026-11-03.depth [more .depth files]
      --sim discovery=build-avx512/tune/of12/discovery_*.csv --sim default_warm=... --sim default=...
      [--jobs 16] [--out experiments/of12_real_vs_sim.txt]
The first --sim market is the one the verdict column judges. experiments/of12_regen.sh runs it all.

The real data is only read (opened read-only; a Sierra file still being written is read as a
snapshot of its current size). The output holds aggregate statistics only.

Three data shapes, each built from both sides and then measured by ONE function:
  1-min bars    real: the 1-min CSV (unadjusted prices; returns never cross a contract change);
                sim: its trades aggregated per minute of the session.
  1-s bundles   real: Sierra .scid records (one per second with trades: trade count, volume,
                bid/ask volume by aggressor, OHLC of trade prices), front month by RTH volume per
                day; sim: its trades aggregated per whole second, bid volume = sell-aggressor lots.
  book          real: the L2 .depth event stream replayed into a book and sampled every 100 ms
                (the state after every event up to that instant); sim: its 100 ms Q lines (the
                simulator's own step). Levels are price levels 1..5 ticks from the best (0 if empty).
Standard errors: delete-one-block jackknife; real blocks = trading days (book: 5-min blocks of
the one RTH window, 30-min blocks overnight), sim blocks = sessions.
Time: Sierra stores UTC; US Central is computed here (second Sunday of March 02:00 to the first
Sunday of November 02:00 local is CDT, UTC-5; otherwise CST, UTC-6). RTH = 08:30-15:00 CT.

import glob
import math
import multiprocessing as mp
import os
import struct
import sys
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone

UTC = timezone.utc

SC_EPOCH_US = 25569 * 86400 * 1000000  # Sierra time zero (1899-12-30) to the Unix epoch, microseconds
GRID_US = 100000                       # book sampling step (the simulator's dt)
NAN = float("nan")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- time ---
_dst = {}


def _nth_sunday(y, m, n):
    first = (6 - datetime(y, m, 1).weekday()) % 7 + 1
    return first + 7 * (n - 1)


def ct_offset_h(unix_s):
    """US Central offset from UTC in hours at a Unix time (CDT -5, CST -6)."""
    y = datetime.fromtimestamp(unix_s, UTC).year
    if y not in _dst:
        _dst[y] = (datetime(y, 3, _nth_sunday(y, 3, 2), 8, tzinfo=UTC).timestamp(),   # 02:00 CST
                   datetime(y, 11, _nth_sunday(y, 11, 1), 7, tzinfo=UTC).timestamp())  # 02:00 CDT
    a, b = _dst[y]
    return -5 if a <= unix_s < b else -6


def ct_local(unix_s):
    return unix_s + 3600 * ct_offset_h(unix_s)


def rth_open_unix(ct_day):
    """Unix time of 08:30 CT on a CT calendar day (days since 1970-01-01)."""
    local = ct_day * 86400 + 30600
    return local - 3600 * ct_offset_h(local + 6 * 3600)


def day_str(ct_day):
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(ct_day * 86400, UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

# An accumulator is a flat dict of sums (str keys; histograms use (name, value) keys), so
# blocks add and a leave-one-out total is the sum minus one block.
def addv(a, k, v):
    a[k] = a.get(k, 0.0) + v

    if not xs:

    addv(a, k + ".n", len(xs))
    addv(a, k + ".sx", sum(xs))
    addv(a, k + ".sy", sum(ys))
    addv(a, k + ".sxx", sum(map(mul, xs, xs)))
    addv(a, k + ".syy", sum(map(mul, ys, ys)))
    addv(a, k + ".sxy", sum(map(mul, xs, ys)))

    if not xs:

    def f(a):
        n = a.get(k + ".n", 0.0)
        if n < 4:
            return NAN
        m, e2, e3, e4 = a[k + ".s1"] / n, a[k + ".s2"] / n, a[k + ".s3"] / n, a[k + ".s4"] / n
        m2 = e2 - m * m
        m4 = e4 - 4 * m * e3 + 6 * m * m * e2 - 3 * m ** 4

        tot = sum(c for _, c in items)

            return NAN
        cum = 0.0
        for v, c in items:
            cum += c
            if cum >= q * tot - 1e-9:

def jackknife(blocks, funcs):
    """[(estimate, SE)] per function; SE = delete-one-block jackknife (nan with < 2 blocks)."""
    tot = merge(blocks)
    est = [f(tot) for f in funcs]
    B = len(blocks)
    if B < 2:
        return [(e, NAN) for e in est]
    loo = []

    s = [float((x > 0) - (x < 0)) for x in d]
    for lag in (1, 10, 100):
        pair_lists(a, "sac%d" % lag, s[:-lag], s[lag:])
    return a

# ----------------------------------------------------------- shape: book ---
# samples: book states every 100 ms, index i at second t0 + i / 10; each None (no valid book)
# or (bid, ask [ticks], bid sizes x5, ask sizes x5, bid orders x5 or None, ask orders x5 or None).
# keys[i]: (label, block) or None (excluded). bundles: {second: (trades, volume, bid vol, ask vol)}.
def book_stats(samples, keys, t0, bundles):
    accs = {}
    N = len(samples)
    y = [None] * N  # mid at the next mid change after i minus mid now (ticks), as of10_discovery's event corr
    nxt, lab = None, None
    for i in range(N - 1, -1, -1):
        s, k = samples[i], keys[i]
        if s is None or k is None:
            nxt, lab = None, None
            continue
        if k[0] != lab:
            nxt, lab = None, k[0]
        mid = s[0] + s[1]
        if nxt is not None:
            y[i] = (nxt - mid) / 2
        if i > 0:
            p = samples[i - 1]
            if p is not None and keys[i - 1] is not None and p[0] + p[1] != mid:
                nxt = mid
    prev = None
    for i in range(N):
        s, k = samples[i], keys[i]
        if s is None or k is None:
            prev = None
            continue
        a = accs.get(k)
        if a is None:
            a = accs[k] = {}
        bid, ask, b5, a5, ob5, oa5 = s
        addv(a, "k.n", 1)
        if ask - bid == 1:
            addv(a, "k.sp1", 1)
        addv(a, "k.l1b", b5[0])
        addv(a, "k.l1a", a5[0])
        addv(a, ("l1", b5[0]), 1)
        addv(a, ("l1", a5[0]), 1)
        for j in range(1, 5):
            addv(a, "k.l%d" % (j + 1), b5[j] + a5[j])
        if ob5 is not None:
            addv(a, "k.on", 1)
            addv(a, "k.o1lots", b5[0] + a5[0])
            for j in range(5):
                addv(a, "k.o%d" % (j + 1), ob5[j] + oa5[j])
        s1 = b5[0] + a5[0]
        i1 = (b5[0] - a5[0]) / s1 if s1 > 0 else 0.0
        sb, sa = sum(b5), sum(a5)
        i5 = (sb - sa) / (sb + sa) if sb + sa > 0 else 0.0
        yi = y[i]
        if yi is not None:
            for key, x in (("ev1", i1), ("ev5", i5)):
                addv(a, key + ".n", 1)
                addv(a, key + ".sx", x)
                addv(a, key + ".sy", yi)
                addv(a, key + ".sxx", x * x)
                addv(a, key + ".syy", yi * yi)
                addv(a, key + ".sxy", x * yi)
            if i1 != 0 and yi != 0:
                addv(a, "k.hitn", 1)
                if (i1 > 0) == (yi > 0):
                    addv(a, "k.hit", 1)
        if prev is not None and prev[1][0] == k[0]:
            p = prev[0]
            addv(a, "k.pairs", 1)
            if p[0] + p[1] != bid + ask:
                addv(a, "k.midchg", 1)
                if p[1] - p[0] == 1 and ask - bid == 1:
                    addv(a, "k.midchg1", 1)  # a whole-book tick, not a spread opening or closing
            dep = 0
            pb, pb5 = p[0], p[2]  # bid side: same price -> net decrease; lower -> the levels above are gone
            if bid == pb:
                dep += max(0, pb5[0] - b5[0])
            elif bid < pb:
                m = pb - bid
                dep += sum(pb5[:min(m, 5)])
                if m < 5:
                    dep += max(0, pb5[m] - b5[0])
            pa, pa5 = p[1], p[3]
            if ask == pa:
                dep += max(0, pa5[0] - a5[0])
            elif ask > pa:
                m = ask - pa
                dep += sum(pa5[:min(m, 5)])
                if m < 5:
                    dep += max(0, pa5[m] - a5[0])
            addv(a, "k.dep", dep)
        prev = (s, k)
    # 1-s bundles against the book: traded volume in the window, and markouts of the second's
    # delta (ask - bid volume) on the mid at the end of the second.
    def mid_at(e):
        if 0 <= e < N and samples[e] is not None and keys[e] is not None:
            return samples[e][0] + samples[e][1], keys[e]
        return None, None
    for X in range(t0, t0 + N // 10):
        e = 10 * (X + 1 - t0)
        m0, k = mid_at(e)
        if m0 is None:
            continue
        a = accs[k]
        bd = bundles.get(X)
        addv(a, "k.tsec", 1)
        if bd is None:
            continue
        addv(a, "k.tvol", bd[1])
        d = bd[3] - bd[2]
        if d == 0:
            continue
        sg = 1 if d > 0 else -1
        for h in (-1, 1, 5, 30):
            m1, k1 = mid_at(e + 10 * h)
            if m1 is None or k1[0] != k[0]:
                continue
            yy = (m1 - m0) / 2 if h > 0 else (m0 - m1) / 2
            tag = "c" if h < 0 else str(h)
            addv(a, "mk%s.sum" % tag, sg * yy)
            addv(a, "mk%s.cnt" % tag, 1)
            for key, xv, yv in (("mkc%s" % tag, float(d), yy),):
                addv(a, key + ".n", 1)
                addv(a, key + ".sx", xv)
                addv(a, key + ".sy", yv)
                addv(a, key + ".sxx", xv * xv)
                addv(a, key + ".syy", yv * yv)
                addv(a, key + ".sxy", xv * yv)
    return accs


def f_dep_per_side(a):
    return a["k.dep"] / (a["k.pairs"] * 0.1) / 2 if a.get("k.pairs", 0) > 0 else NAN


def f_traded_share(a):
    dep = a.get("k.dep", 0.0) / (a["k.pairs"] * 0.1) if a.get("k.pairs", 0) > 0 else 0.0
    tv = a.get("k.tvol", 0.0) / a["k.tsec"] if a.get("k.tsec", 0) > 0 else NAN
    return tv / dep if dep > 0 else NAN

# ------------------------------------------------------------- real I/O ---
def read_snapshot(path, header, rec):
    """The whole file as bytes (a snapshot: the size is fixed at open), whole records only."""
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        size = os.fstat(f.fileno()).st_size
        data = f.read(size)
    hsize = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 4)[0]
    if hsize != header:
        raise ValueError("%s: header size %d, expected %d" % (path, hsize, header))
    n = (len(data) - hsize) // rec
    return data, hsize, n


def first_at_or_after(data, hsize, rec, n, t):
    lo, hi = 0, n
    while lo < hi:
        m = (lo + hi) // 2
        if struct.unpack_from("<q", data, hsize + rec * m)[0] < t:
            lo = m + 1
        else:
            hi = m
    return lo


def scid_range(data, hsize, n, t0_us, t1_us):
    """scid records with Sierra time in [t0_us, t1_us)."""
    i = first_at_or_after(data, hsize, 40, n, t0_us)
    j = first_at_or_after(data, hsize, 40, n, t1_us)
    return struct.iter_unpack("<q4f4I", data[hsize + 40 * i:hsize + 40 * j])


def ticks(p100):
    return int(p100 + 0.5) // 25  # Sierra price x 100 -> 0.25-point ticks


def task_scid_days(args):
    """One .scid file: per RTH day, (volume, contract, 1-s bundle statistics)."""
    path, contract, days = args
    data, hsize, n = read_snapshot(path, 56, 40)
    out = {}
    for d in days:
        o = rth_open_unix(d)
        o_us = o * 1000000 + SC_EPOCH_US
        N = [0] * SESSION
        V, BV, AV = [0] * SESSION, [0] * SESSION, [0] * SESSION
        C = [None] * SESSION
        tot = 0
        for t, _o, _h, _l, c, nt, vol, bv, av in scid_range(data, hsize, n, o_us, o_us + SESSION * 1000000):
            s = (t - o_us) // 1000000
            N[s] += nt
            V[s] += vol
            BV[s] += bv
            AV[s] += av
            C[s] = ticks(c)
            tot += vol
        if tot > 0:
            out[d] = (tot, contract, bundle_stats(N, V, BV, AV, C))
    return out


def task_depth(args):
    """One .depth file: the book every 100 ms, the matching 1-s bundles from the .scid, statistics
    per (label, block): RTH 5-min blocks, ETH 30-min blocks, the 16:00-17:00 CT halt excluded."""
    path, scid_path, until_us = args
    data, hsize, n = read_snapshot(path, 64, 24)
    if until_us is not None:  # a fixed end for a file Sierra is still writing
        n = first_at_or_after(data, hsize, 24, n, until_us)
    bids, asks = {}, {}
    samples = []
    first_t = struct.unpack_from("<q", data, hsize)[0]
    g = (first_t // 1000000 + 1) * 1000000  # the first whole second after the first event
    t0 = (g - SC_EPOCH_US) // 1000000
    crossed = 0

    def snap():
        nonlocal crossed
        if not bids or not asks:
            return None
        bb, ba = max(bids), min(asks)
        if ba <= bb:
            crossed += 1
            return None
        bl = [bids.get(bb - j) for j in range(5)]
        al = [asks.get(ba + j) for j in range(5)]
        b5 = tuple(x[0] if x else 0 for x in bl)
        a5 = tuple(x[0] if x else 0 for x in al)
        ob5 = tuple(x[1] if x else 0 for x in bl)
        oa5 = tuple(x[1] if x else 0 for x in al)
        if ob5[0] == 0 and oa5[0] == 0:
            ob5 = oa5 = None
        return (bb, ba, b5, a5, ob5, oa5)

    for t, cmd, _fl, nord, price, qty, _r in struct.iter_unpack("<qBBHfII", data[hsize:hsize + 24 * n]):
        if t > g:
            s = snap()
            while g < t:
                samples.append(s)
                g += GRID_US
        if cmd == 1:
            bids.clear()
            asks.clear()
        elif cmd == 2 or cmd == 4:
            bids[ticks(price)] = (qty, nord)
        elif cmd == 3 or cmd == 5:
            asks[ticks(price)] = (qty, nord)
        elif cmd == 6:
            bids.pop(ticks(price), None)
        elif cmd == 7:
            asks.pop(ticks(price), None)
    keys = []
    for i in range(len(samples)):
        u = t0 + i // 10
        tod = ct_local(u) % 86400
        if 30600 <= tod < 54000:
            keys.append(("RTH", u // 300))
        elif 57600 <= tod < 61200:
            keys.append(None)
        else:
            keys.append(("ETH", u // 1800))
    sd, sh, sn = read_snapshot(scid_path, 56, 40)
    bundles = {}
    for t, _o, _h, _l, _c, nt, vol, bv, av in scid_range(sd, sh, sn, t0 * 1000000 + SC_EPOCH_US,
                                                          (t0 + len(samples) // 10 + 2) * 1000000 + SC_EPOCH_US):
        u = (t - SC_EPOCH_US) // 1000000
        b = bundles.get(u, (0, 0, 0, 0))
        bundles[u] = (b[0] + nt, b[1] + vol, b[2] + bv, b[3] + av)
    accs = book_stats(samples, keys, t0, bundles)
    cover = Counter(k[0] for s, k in zip(samples, keys) if s is not None and k is not None)
    rth_span = [t0 + i // 10 for i, k in enumerate(keys) if k is not None and k[0] == "RTH"]
    return {"accs": accs, "cover": dict(cover), "crossed": crossed, "events": n, "t0": t0, "t1": t0 + len(samples) // 10,
            "rth": (min(rth_span), max(rth_span) + 1) if rth_span else None, "path": os.path.basename(path)}


def depth_rth_seconds(path, until_us=None):
    """Seconds of RTH (from 08:30 CT) a .depth file covers: the simulator's matched book window."""
    data, hsize, n = read_snapshot(path, 64, 24)
    if until_us is not None:
        n = first_at_or_after(data, hsize, 24, n, until_us)
    if n == 0:
        return 0, None
    t_first = struct.unpack_from("<q", data, hsize)[0]
    t_last = struct.unpack_from("<q", data, hsize + 24 * (n - 1))[0]
    a, b = (t_first - SC_EPOCH_US) // 1000000, (t_last - SC_EPOCH_US) // 1000000
    day = ct_local(a) // 86400
    o = rth_open_unix(day)
    lo, hi = max(a, o), min(b, o + SESSION)
    return max(0, hi - lo), (lo, hi)


def read_bars(path):
    """RTH bars per CT day (full sessions only), ETH bars per trade date, and data checks."""
    rth, eth = {}, {}
    ct_mismatch = rows = 0
    with open(path, "r", newline="") as f:
        head = f.readline().strip().split(",")
        col = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(head)}
        for line in f:
            p = line.rstrip("\r\n").split(",")
            if len(p) < len(head):
                continue
            rows += 1
            u = int(datetime.strptime(p[col["time_utc"]], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S").replace(tzinfo=UTC).timestamp())
            loc = ct_local(u)
            if datetime.fromtimestamp(loc, UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") != p[col["time_ct"]]:
                ct_mismatch += 1
            bar = (round(float(p[col["open"]]) * 4), round(float(p[col["high"]]) * 4), round(float(p[col["low"]]) * 4),
                   round(float(p[col["close"]]) * 4), int(p[col["volume"]]), int(p[col["trades"]]),
                   int(p[col["bid_volume"]]), int(p[col["ask_volume"]]), p[col["contract"]])
            day, tod = divmod(loc, 86400)
            if 30600 <= tod < 54000:
                rth.setdefault(day, {})[(tod - 30600) // 60] = bar
            else:
                eth.setdefault(p[col["trade_date"]], {})[u // 60] = (bar, day, tod)
    full = {d: [m[i] for i in range(390)] for d, m in rth.items() if len(m) == 390}
    eth_lists = {}
    for td, m in eth.items():
        ks = sorted(m)
        eth_lists[td] = [m[k][0] if k in m else None for k in range(ks[0], ks[-1] + 1)]
    return full, eth_lists, {"rows": rows, "ct_mismatch": ct_mismatch, "rth_days": len(rth), "full_days": len(full)}


# -------------------------------------------------------------- sim I/O ---
def task_sim(args):
    """One simulator session (of_calibrate export from the open): statistics of all three shapes."""
    market, path, window_s = args
    N, V, BV, AV = [0] * SESSION, [0] * SESSION, [0] * SESSION, [0] * SESSION
    O, H, Lo, C = [None] * SESSION, [None] * SESSION, [None] * SESSION, [None] * SESSION
    samples = [None] * (SESSION * 10 + 1)
    bundles = {}
    with open(path, "r") as f:
        for line in f:
            c0 = line[0]
            if c0 == "T":
                _, t, p, sz, side = line.split(",")
                ms = round(float(t) * 1000)
                s = (ms - 1) // 1000  # a step's trades happen in (t - 0.1, t]
                if s >= SESSION:
                    continue
                pt, q = round(float(p) * 4), int(sz)
                N[s] += 1
                V[s] += q
                if side[0] == "B":
                    AV[s] += q
                else:
                    BV[s] += q
                if O[s] is None:
                    O[s] = H[s] = Lo[s] = pt
                H[s] = max(H[s], pt)
                Lo[s] = min(Lo[s], pt)
                C[s] = pt
            elif c0 == "Q":
                f_ = line.split(",")
                k = round((float(f_[1]) - 0.0005) * 10)
                if 0 <= k < len(samples):
                    b5 = tuple(int(x) for x in f_[4:9])
                    a5 = tuple(int(x) for x in f_[9:14])
                    samples[k] = (round(float(f_[2]) * 4), round(float(f_[3]) * 4), b5, a5, None, None)
    bars = []
    for m in range(SESSION // 60):
        sl = range(60 * m, 60 * m + 60)
        tr = [s for s in sl if N[s] > 0]
        if not tr:
            bars.append(None)
            continue
        bars.append((O[tr[0]], max(H[s] for s in tr), min(Lo[s] for s in tr), C[tr[-1]], sum(V[s] for s in sl),
                     sum(N[s] for s in sl), sum(BV[s] for s in sl), sum(AV[s] for s in sl), "SIM"))
    for s in range(SESSION):
        if N[s]:
            bundles[s] = (N[s], V[s], BV[s], AV[s])
    win = [("W", 0) if 0 < i <= window_s * 10 else None for i in range(len(samples))]
    full = [("F", 0) if i > 0 else None for i in range(len(samples))]
    return {"market": market, "path": os.path.basename(path), "bars": bar_stats(bars, True),
            "sec": bundle_stats(N, V, BV, AV, C), "bookw": book_stats(samples, win, 0, bundles).get(("W", 0), {}),
            "bookf": book_stats(samples, full, 0, bundles).get(("F", 0), {}), "trades": sum(N)}


# ------------------------------------------------------------- report ---
def fmt(v, se, f):
    if v is None or math.isnan(v):
        return "-"
    s = f % v
    if se is not None and not math.isnan(se):
        s += " +- " + (f.replace("+", "") % se)
    return s


def verdict(r, se_r, s, se_s, floor=0.0):
    if any(x is None or math.isnan(x) for x in (r, s)):
        return "-"
    d = s - r
    sec = math.sqrt((0 if math.isnan(se_r) else se_r) ** 2 + (0 if math.isnan(se_s) else se_s) ** 2)
    if abs(d) <= 2 * sec:
        return "within 2 SE"
    if abs(d) <= 0.2 * abs(r):
        return "within 20%"
    if abs(r) >= floor and r != 0 and s / r > 0:  # a ratio only when real is clearly away from zero
        return "off x%.2f" % (s / r)
    return ("off by %+.3f" if abs(d) < 10 else "off by %+.0f") % d


def table(lines, title, rows, cols, judge, ref=0):
    """cols: [(header, blocks or None)]; judge: index of the judged column (vs column ref)."""
    res = [jackknife(b, [r[1] for r in rows]) if b else None for _, b in cols]
    w0 = max(len(r[0]) for r in rows) + 2
    widths = [max(len(h), 20) + 2 for h, _ in cols]
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(title)
    hdr = "statistic".ljust(w0) + "".join(h.rjust(w) for (h, _), w in zip(cols, widths))
    if judge is not None:
        hdr += "  verdict (%s vs %s)" % (cols[judge][0], cols[ref][0])
    lines.append(hdr)
    lines.append("-" * len(hdr))
    out = {}
    for i, r in enumerate(rows):
        cells = []
        for j, ((h, _), w) in enumerate(zip(cols, widths)):
            cells.append((fmt(*res[j][i], r[2]) if res[j] else "-").rjust(w))

            v = verdict(res[ref][i][0], res[ref][i][1], res[judge][i][0], res[judge][i][1], r[3])
            line += "  " + v
            out[r[0]] = (res[ref][i], res[judge][i], r[3], r[2], v)
        lines.append(line)
    return out

def ranked(lines, judged, n=10):
    best = {}
    for name, (ref, sim, floor, f, v) in judged.items():
        r, s = ref[0], sim[0]
        if math.isnan(r) or math.isnan(s) or v in ("within 2 SE", "within 20%"):
            continue
        group, text = DRIVERS.get(name, (name, "(no single parameter)"))
        sev = abs(s - r) / max(abs(r), floor)
        cur = best.get(group)
        if cur is None:
            best[group] = [sev, name, r, s, f, v, text, []]
        elif sev > cur[0]:
            best[group] = [sev, name, r, s, f, v, text, cur[7] + [cur[1]]]
        else:
            cur[7].append(name)
    items = sorted(best.values(), key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1]))
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("Biggest real-vs-v3 mismatches: the worst row of each group, ranked by |v3 - real| / max(|real|, floor) (floors in")
    lines.append("the tool: 1 for counts and sizes, 0.03-0.05 for correlations); the driver is the simulator parameter that most")
    lines.append("plausibly causes it, read off simulator.hpp (discovery_market()), not fitted. Real = RTH (book: the Nov 3 morning).")
    for k, (sev, name, r, s, f, v, text, others) in enumerate(items[:n], 1):
        lines.append("%2d. %s: real %s, v3 %s (%s)" % (k, name.strip(), f % r, f % s, v))
        if others:
            lines.append("    also off in this group: " + "; ".join(o.strip() for o in sorted(others)))
        lines.append("    driver: " + text)


def tails_note(lines, label, blocks, names, unit):
    """Per-block 1-min excess kurtosis and largest |1-min return| (outliers that dominate pooled moments)."""
    ks = sorted((f_kurt("r")(b), i) for i, b in enumerate(blocks))
    mx = sorted((b.get("_rmax", 0.0), i) for i, b in enumerate(blocks))
    lines.append("  %s: per-%s 1-min excess kurtosis median %.1f (min %.1f, max %.1f: %s); largest |1-min return| per %s:"
                 " median %.0f ticks, max %.0f (%s)" % (label, unit, ks[len(ks) // 2][0], ks[0][0], ks[-1][0], names[ks[-1][1]],
                                                        unit, mx[len(mx) // 2][0], mx[-1][0], names[mx[-1][1]]))

def _run(job):
    kind, name, x = job
    return globals()[name](x)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""research_crawler.py - collect reinforcement-learning trading research.

Searches public research APIs for papers and articles on RL for trading
(order flow, limit order books, market making, tick scalping, execution,
futures), ranks them for relevance, and writes a corpus the RAG engine can
index:

  OUT/papers.jsonl        one JSON record per paper/article (merged, deduplicated)
  OUT/digest.md           ranked list: title, year, venue, citations, link, abstract
  OUT/docs/<id>.md        one text document per item (title, metadata, abstract,
                          article text): `rag_pdf index corpus.ragidx OUT/docs`
  OUT/pdfs/<id>.pdf       open-access PDFs (with --pdfs)
  OUT/cache/              raw responses, so re-runs don't re-download

Sources (no accounts or API keys):
  arxiv       export.arxiv.org API (q-fin and cs categories)
  openalex    api.openalex.org (journals, conferences, SSRN and more)
  s2          api.semanticscholar.org (with citation counts)
  hn          hn.algolia.com: Hacker News stories (blog posts, articles);
              --fetch-articles also downloads the linked pages' text

Anonymous by design: the requests carry a generic user agent
("research-crawler/1.0"), no email address, no API key, no cookies and no
referrer, so nothing identifies who runs it. It is also polite: it checks
robots.txt before fetching any web page or PDF, waits between requests to the
same host (arXiv asks for 3 s), backs off on 429/5xx, and caches everything.
It does not rotate IPs or disguise itself to get past blocks: a source that
refuses it is skipped.

Usage:
  python3 tools/research_crawler.py                      # all sources, default queries
  python3 tools/research_crawler.py --since 2018 --max-per-query 50 --pdfs
  python3 tools/research_crawler.py --sources arxiv,s2 --query "deep reinforcement learning limit order book"
  python3 tools/research_crawler.py --queries my_queries.txt --fetch-articles

def slug(key: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha1(key.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]


def abstract_from_inverted_index(inv: dict | None) -> str:
    """OpenAlex stores abstracts as {word: [positions]}."""
    if not inv:
        return ""
    pos = {}
    for word, places in inv.items():
        for p in places:
            pos[p] = word
    return " ".join(pos[i] for i in sorted(pos))


def lexicon_score(text: str, terms) -> float:
    return sum(w for pat, w in terms if re.search(pat, text))


def relevance(item: Item, now_year: int) -> float:
    """Keyword relevance (title 3x), boosted by citations and recency; items
    without both an RL term and a market term are pushed down."""
    title, body = item.title.lower(), (item.abstract + " " + item.text[:5000]).lower()
    rl = 3 * lexicon_score(title, RL_TERMS) + lexicon_score(body, RL_TERMS)
    mk = 3 * lexicon_score(title, MARKET_TERMS) + lexicon_score(body, MARKET_TERMS)
    va = lexicon_score(title + " " + body, VALIDATION_TERMS)
    s = rl + mk + va
    if rl == 0 or mk == 0:
        s *= 0.3
    if item.citations:
        s += 1.5 * math.log1p(item.citations)
    if item.year:
        s += max(0.0, 3.0 - 0.3 * max(0, now_year - item.year))
    return round(s, 2)


class TextExtractor(html.parser.HTMLParser):
    """Visible text of an HTML page (scripts, styles and navigation dropped)."""
    SKIP = {"script", "style", "noscript", "nav", "header", "footer", "svg", "form"}

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.parts: list[str] = []
        self.depth = 0
        self.title = ""
        self._in_title = False

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in self.SKIP:
            self.depth += 1
        if tag == "title":
            self._in_title = True
        if tag in ("p", "br", "li", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "tr", "div"):
            self.parts.append("\n")

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in self.SKIP and self.depth:
            self.depth -= 1
        if tag == "title":
            self._in_title = False

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self._in_title:
            self.title += data
        elif not self.depth:
            self.parts.append(data)

    def text(self) -> str:
        t = "".join(self.parts)
        t = re.sub(r"[ \t\r\f\v]+", " ", t)
        return re.sub(r"\n\s*\n+", "\n\n", t).strip()


def html_to_text(page: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    p = TextExtractor()
    p.feed(page)
    return p.title.strip(), p.text()


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ HTTP
class Fetcher:
    """Anonymous, polite HTTP: generic user agent, no cookies/referrer/keys;
    per-host delay, robots.txt for pages, retries with backoff, disk cache."""

    API_HOSTS = {"export.arxiv.org", "api.openalex.org", "api.semanticscholar.org", "hn.algolia.com"}

    def __init__(self, cache: Path, delays: dict[str, float] | None = None, default_delay: float = 1.0, timeout: float = 30):
        self.cache = cache
        self.cache.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.delays = delays or {"export.arxiv.org": 3.1, "arxiv.org": 3.1, "api.semanticscholar.org": 1.2}
        self.default_delay = default_delay
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.last: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.robots: dict[str, urllib.robotparser.RobotFileParser | None] = {}
        # No cookie processor is installed: urllib sends no cookies.
        self.opener = urllib.request.build_opener()
        self.opener.addheaders = [("User-Agent", USER_AGENT), ("Accept-Encoding", "gzip")]

    def _wait(self, host: str):
        delay = self.delays.get(host, self.default_delay)
        dt = time.monotonic() - self.last.get(host, -1e9)
        if dt < delay:
            time.sleep(delay - dt)
        self.last[host] = time.monotonic()

    def allowed(self, url: str) -> bool:
        parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
        if parts.hostname in self.API_HOSTS:
            return True  # documented public APIs for automated access
        base = f"{parts.scheme}://{parts.netloc}"
        if base not in self.robots:
            rp = urllib.robotparser.RobotFileParser()
            try:
                raw = self.get(base + "/robots.txt", check_robots=False, cache=True, quiet=True)
                rp.parse(raw.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines() if raw is not None else [])
                self.robots[base] = rp
            except Exception:
                self.robots[base] = None  # unreachable robots.txt: treat as allowed
        rp = self.robots[base]
        return True if rp is None else rp.can_fetch(USER_AGENT, url)

    def get(self, url: str, check_robots: bool = True, cache: bool = True, quiet: bool = False, retries: int = 4) -> bytes | None:
        path = self.cache / (hashlib.sha1(url.encode()).hexdigest() + ".bin")
        if cache and path.exists():
            return path.read_bytes()
        if check_robots and not self.allowed(url):
            if not quiet:
                print(f"  robots.txt disallows {url}; skipped", file=sys.stderr)
            return None
        host = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url).hostname or ""
        for attempt in range(retries + 1):
            self._wait(host)
            try:
                with self.opener.open(urllib.request.Request(url), timeout=self.timeout) as r:
                    data = r.read()
                    if r.headers.get("Content-Encoding") == "gzip":
                        data = gzip.decompress(data)
                if cache:
                    path.write_bytes(data)
                return data
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                if e.code in (429, 500, 502, 503, 504) and attempt < retries:
                    wait = float(e.headers.get("Retry-After") or 0) or 5 * 2**attempt
                    time.sleep(min(wait, 120))
                    continue
                if not quiet:
                    print(f"  HTTP {e.code} for {url}", file=sys.stderr)
                return None
            except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as e:
                if attempt < retries:
                    time.sleep(3 * 2**attempt)
                    continue
                if not quiet:
                    print(f"  failed {url}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
                return None
        return None


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ sources
def parse_arxiv(atom: bytes, query: str) -> list[Item]:
    ns = {"a": "http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom", "arxiv": "http://arxiv.org/schemas/atom"}
    root = ET.fromstring(atom)
    out = []
    for e in root.findall("a:entry", ns):
        aid = (e.findtext("a:id", "", ns) or "").rsplit("/abs/", 1)[-1]
        title = " ".join((e.findtext("a:title", "", ns) or "").split())
        if not title:
            continue
        pdf = next((l.get("href", "") for l in e.findall("a:link", ns) if l.get("title") == "pdf"), "")
        doi = e.findtext("arxiv:doi", "", ns) or ""
        year = (e.findtext("a:published", "", ns) or "")[:4]
        out.append(Item(
            key=make_key(doi=doi, arxiv_id=aid, title=title), source="arxiv", kind="paper", title=title,
            year=int(year) if year.isdigit() else None,
            authors=[a.findtext("a:name", "", ns) for a in e.findall("a:author", ns)],
            venue=e.findtext("arxiv:journal_ref", "", ns) or "arXiv",
            abstract=" ".join((e.findtext("a:summary", "", ns) or "").split()),
            url=f"https://arxiv.org/abs/{aid}", pdf_url=pdf.replace("http://", "https://"), doi=doi, arxiv_id=aid,
            sources=["arxiv"], queries=[query]))
    return out


def parse_openalex(data: bytes, query: str) -> list[Item]:
    out = []
    for w in json.loads(data).get("results", []):
        title = w.get("title") or w.get("display_name") or ""
        if not title:
            continue
        doi = (w.get("doi") or "").removeprefix("https://doi.org/")
        loc = w.get("primary_location") or {}
        src = loc.get("source") or {}
        oa = w.get("open_access") or {}
        out.append(Item(
            key=make_key(doi=doi, title=title), source="openalex", kind="paper", title=title,
            year=w.get("publication_year"),
            authors=[(a.get("author") or {}).get("display_name", "") for a in w.get("authorships", [])][:20],
            venue=src.get("display_name") or "", abstract=abstract_from_inverted_index(w.get("abstract_inverted_index")),
            url=loc.get("landing_page_url") or (f"https://doi.org/{doi}" if doi else w.get("id", "")),
            pdf_url=oa.get("oa_url") or "", doi=doi, citations=w.get("cited_by_count"),
            sources=["openalex"], queries=[query]))
    return out


def parse_s2(data: bytes, query: str) -> list[Item]:
    out = []
    for p in json.loads(data).get("data", []) or []:
        title = p.get("title") or ""
        if not title:
            continue
        ext = p.get("externalIds") or {}
        doi, aid = ext.get("DOI") or "", ext.get("ArXiv") or ""
        out.append(Item(
            key=make_key(doi=doi, arxiv_id=aid, title=title), source="s2", kind="paper", title=title, year=p.get("year"),
            authors=[a.get("name", "") for a in p.get("authors") or []][:20], venue=p.get("venue") or "",
            abstract=p.get("abstract") or "", url=p.get("url") or "", pdf_url=(p.get("openAccessPdf") or {}).get("url") or "",
            doi=doi, arxiv_id=aid, citations=p.get("citationCount"), sources=["s2"], queries=[query]))
    return out


def parse_hn(data: bytes, query: str) -> list[Item]:
    out = []
    for h in json.loads(data).get("hits", []):
        url, title = h.get("url") or "", h.get("title") or ""
        if not url or not title:
            continue
        out.append(Item(
            key="url:" + url.split("#")[0].rstrip("/"), source="hn", kind="article", title=title,
            year=int((h.get("created_at") or "0000")[:4]) or None, venue=urllib.parse.urlsplit(url).hostname or "",
            url=url, citations=h.get("points"), sources=["hn"], queries=[query]))
    return out


def search(fetcher: Fetcher, source: str, query: str, n: int, since: int) -> list[Item]:
    q = urllib.parse.quote
    if source == "arxiv":
        terms = " AND ".join(f'all:"{w}"' if " " in w else f"all:{w}" for w in split_query(query))
        cats = "(cat:q-fin.* OR cat:cs.LG OR cat:cs.AI OR cat:stat.ML)"
        url = (f"https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query={q(f'({terms}) AND {cats}')}"
               f"&start=0&max_results={n}&sortBy=relevance")
        data = fetcher.get(url)
        items = parse_arxiv(data, query) if data else []
    elif source == "openalex":
        url = (f"https://api.openalex.org/works?search={q(query)}&per-page={min(n, 200)}"
               f"&filter=from_publication_date:{since}-01-01")
        data = fetcher.get(url)
        items = parse_openalex(data, query) if data else []
    elif source == "s2":
        fields = "title,abstract,year,venue,citationCount,externalIds,openAccessPdf,url,authors"
        url = (f"https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/search?query={q(query)}"
               f"&limit={min(n, 100)}&fields={fields}&year={since}-")
        data = fetcher.get(url)
        items = parse_s2(data, query) if data else []
    elif source == "hn":
        url = f"https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?query={q(query)}&tags=story&hitsPerPage={min(n, 100)}"
        data = fetcher.get(url)
        items = parse_hn(data, query) if data else []
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown source {source}")
    return [i for i in items if not i.year or i.year >= since]


def split_query(query: str) -> list[str]:
    """Keep known multi-word phrases together for arXiv's field search."""
    phrases = ["reinforcement learning", "deep reinforcement learning", "order flow", "limit order book", "order book",
               "market making", "high-frequency trading", "optimal execution", "queue position", "market microstructure",
               "deep learning", "price prediction", "agent-based"]
    rest, found = query.lower(), []
    for ph in sorted(phrases, key=len, reverse=True):
        if ph in rest:
            found.append(ph)
            rest = rest.replace(ph, " ")
    return found + [w for w in rest.split() if len(w) > 2]


def merge(into: dict[str, Item], items: list[Item]) -> None:
    for it in items:
        cur = into.get(it.key)
        if cur is None:
            # Also merge a title match against an existing doi/arxiv record.
            tkey = "title:" + normalize_title(it.title)
            cur = next((v for v in into.values() if normalize_title(v.title) == tkey[6:]), None) if it.kind == "paper" else None
            if cur is None:
                into[it.key] = it
                continue
        for f in ("abstract", "pdf_url", "doi", "arxiv_id", "venue", "url"):
            if not getattr(cur, f) and getattr(it, f):
                setattr(cur, f, getattr(it, f))
        if it.citations is not None and (cur.citations is None or it.citations > cur.citations):
            cur.citations = it.citations
        cur.year = cur.year or it.year
        cur.authors = cur.authors or it.authors
        cur.sources = sorted(set(cur.sources) | set(it.sources))
        cur.queries = sorted(set(cur.queries) | set(it.queries))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ output
def write_outputs(out: Path, items: list[Item]) -> None:
    (out / "docs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(out / "papers.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for it in items:
            f.write(json.dumps(asdict(it), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    lines = [f"# RL trading research digest ({len(items)} items)", "",
             "Ranked by keyword relevance (RL x market-microstructure terms), citations and recency.", ""]
    for n, it in enumerate(items, 1):
        meta = ", ".join(x for x in [str(it.year or ""), it.venue, f"{it.citations} citations" if it.kind == "paper" and it.citations is not None
                                     else (f"{it.citations} points" if it.citations is not None else "")] if x)
        lines.append(f"{n}. **{it.title}** ({meta}) score {it.score}  ")
        lines.append(f"   {it.url}" + (f" · [pdf]({it.pdf_url})" if it.pdf_url else ""))
        if it.abstract:
            lines.append(f"   > {it.abstract[:400]}{'...' if len(it.abstract) > 400 else ''}")
        lines.append("")
    (out / "digest.md").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    for it in items:
        body = [f"# {it.title}", "", f"- kind: {it.kind}", f"- year: {it.year or ''}", f"- authors: {', '.join(it.authors[:12])}",
                f"- venue: {it.venue}", f"- link: {it.url}", f"- citations: {it.citations if it.citations is not None else ''}",
                f"- relevance: {it.score}", ""]
        if it.abstract:
            body += ["## Abstract", "", it.abstract, ""]
        if it.text:
            body += ["## Text", "", it.text, ""]
        (out / "docs" / f"{slug(it.key)}.md").write_text("\n".join(body), encoding="utf-8")


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="research_corpus", help="output directory")
    ap.add_argument("--sources", default="arxiv,openalex,s2,hn", help="comma-separated: arxiv,openalex,s2,hn")
    ap.add_argument("--query", action="append", help="a search query (repeatable); default: built-in list")
    ap.add_argument("--queries", help="file with one query per line")
    ap.add_argument("--max-per-query", type=int, default=40)
    ap.add_argument("--since", type=int, default=2015, help="earliest publication year")
    ap.add_argument("--min-score", type=float, default=4.0, help="drop items below this relevance")
    ap.add_argument("--fetch-articles", action="store_true", help="download the text of linked articles (hn)")
    ap.add_argument("--pdfs", action="store_true", help="download open-access PDFs of the top items")
    ap.add_argument("--max-pdfs", type=int, default=100)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    out = Path(args.out)
    fetcher = Fetcher(out / "cache")
    queries = args.query or []
    if args.queries:
        queries += [l.strip() for l in Path(args.queries).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.startswith("#")]
    queries = queries or DEFAULT_QUERIES
    found: dict[str, Item] = {}
    for source in [s.strip() for s in args.sources.split(",") if s.strip()]:
        for query in queries:
            items = search(fetcher, source, query, args.max_per_query, args.since)
            print(f"{source:9s} {len(items):4d}  {query}", file=sys.stderr)
            merge(found, items)
    now_year = time.gmtime().tm_year
    if args.fetch_articles:
        for it in found.values():
            if it.kind == "article":
                raw = fetcher.get(it.url)
                if raw:
                    _, it.text = html_to_text(raw.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
                    it.text = it.text[:50_000]
    for it in found.values():
        it.score = relevance(it, now_year)
    ranked = sorted((i for i in found.values() if i.score >= args.min_score), key=lambda i: -i.score)
    write_outputs(out, ranked)
    if args.pdfs:
        (out / "pdfs").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        got = 0
        for it in ranked:
            if got >= args.max_pdfs:
                break
            if it.pdf_url:
                dest = out / "pdfs" / f"{slug(it.key)}.pdf"
                if dest.exists() and dest.read_bytes()[:4] == b"%PDF":  # already downloaded: don't fetch again
                    got += 1
                    continue
                url = it.pdf_url.replace("://arxiv.org/", "://export.arxiv.org/")  # arXiv asks bulk clients to use export
                data = fetcher.get(url, cache=False)
                if data and data[:4] == b"%PDF":
                    dest.write_bytes(data)
                    got += 1
        print(f"downloaded {got} PDFs", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"{len(found)} items found, {len(ranked)} kept (score >= {args.min_score}); wrote {out / 'digest.md'}", file=sys.stderr)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

            self.assertIn("Market Making", (Path(d) / "digest.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            self.assertEqual(len(list((Path(d) / "docs").glob("*.md"))), 2)


class Helpers(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_html_to_text_drops_scripts_and_navigation(self):
        title, text = rc.html_to_text("<html><head><title>T</title><script>var x=1;</script></head>"
                                      "<body><nav>menu</nav><p>Order flow &amp; RL.</p><p>Second.</p></body></html>")
        self.assertEqual(title, "T")
        self.assertIn("Order flow & RL.", text)
        self.assertNotIn("var x", text)
        self.assertNotIn("menu", text)

    def test_split_query_keeps_phrases(self):
        self.assertEqual(rc.split_query("reinforcement learning limit order book"), ["reinforcement learning", "limit order book"])

    def test_requests_are_anonymous(self):
        f = rc.Fetcher(Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()))
        headers = dict(f.opener.addheaders)
        self.assertEqual(headers["User-Agent"], "research-crawler/1.0")
        self.assertNotIn("From", headers)
        self.assertNotIn("Cookie", headers)
        self.assertNotIn("Referer", headers)
        self.assertFalse(any("@" in v for v in headers.values()))

    def test_robots_txt_is_respected_for_web_pages(self):
        f = rc.Fetcher(Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()))
        rp = urllib.robotparser.RobotFileParser()
        rp.parse(["User-agent: *", "Disallow: /private/"])
        f.robots["https://blog.example.com"] = rp
        self.assertTrue(f.allowed("https://blog.example.com/post"))
        self.assertFalse(f.allowed("https://blog.example.com/private/x"))
        self.assertIsNone(f.get("https://blog.example.com/private/x", quiet=True))  # skipped without a request
        self.assertTrue(f.allowed("https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?x"))  # documented public API


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
